title: Account Executive
description:
We're Hiring | Accountant - Accounts, GST & Taxation

Company: Starke Aquacare Technologies

Location: Sector 21, Gurugram, Haryana

Job Type: Full-Time | Work from Office

Experience: 3–6 Years Preferred

Working Days: Monday to Saturday

Working Hours: 9:30 AM – 6:00 PM

About the Company

Starke Aquacare Technologies is an Indian manufacturer and supplier of water treatment filtration media, serving domestic and international markets.

We are looking for a skilled, detail-oriented, and independently working Accountant who can manage day-to-day accounting operations, taxation compliance, financial reporting, and export-related documentation.

Key Responsibilities

1. Accounting & Financial Management

Maintain accurate daily accounting entries in Tally.

Manage accounts payable, accounts receivable, and general ledger.

Prepare supplier, transporter, and other vendor payment statements.

Maintain proper purchase bills, sales invoices, vouchers, and expense records.

Perform fortnightly bank reconciliation and reconcile customer and supplier accounts.

Monitor outstanding payments, collections, and vendor balances.

2. Quarterly Profit & Loss & Financial Reporting

Prepare quarterly Profit & Loss (P&L) statements.

Calculate gross profit, operating expenses, and net profitability.

Prepare Balance Sheets and financial summaries for management review.

Reconcile inventory, purchases, sales, and expenses before quarterly closing.

Analyze quarterly financial performance and identify significant variations.

3. Advance Income Tax & TDS

Calculate estimated annual taxable income based on quarterly financial results.

Prepare quarterly advance income tax calculations and coordinate timely payments.

Maintain TDS deductions, payments, returns, and reconciliations.

Coordinate with the Chartered Accountant for income tax compliance and annual finalization.

4. GST Compliance

Prepare and file GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B within prescribed deadlines.

Reconcile GSTR-2B with purchase records and input tax credit.

Maintain GST records for domestic and export transactions.

Assist in annual GST reconciliation and return filing.

Ensure proper GST treatment of sales, purchases, and expenses.

5. Export & Domestic Sales Accounting

Prepare domestic and export sales invoices.

Generate e-way bills and applicable e-invoices.

Maintain export-related accounting records and documentation.

Coordinate with banks for export document submission and e-BRC-related requirements.

Reconcile export customer payments and outstanding receivables.

6. Inventory, Payroll & Other Responsibilities

Perform daily stock reconciliation through the Inventory Management System (IMS).

Verify factory, godown, labour, and transporter bills.

Prepare monthly salary sheets based on attendance, overtime, and deductions.

Maintain monthly accounting checklists and financial documentation.

Assist with GeM tender submissions and other accounting-related administrative tasks.

Required Qualifications & Skills

B.Com / M.Com / CA Inter preferred.

Minimum 3 years of practical accounting experience.

Strong proficiency in Tally Prime, Microsoft Excel, and Google Sheets.

Hands-on experience with GST returns, TDS, and income tax compliance.

Practical knowledge of quarterly P&L preparation and advance income tax calculation is essential.

Experience preparing Balance Sheets and reconciling financial statements.

Familiarity with export accounting and documentation will be an added advantage.

Ability to independently manage accounting deadlines with minimal supervision.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

✓ Can independently manage company accounts in Tally.

✓ Have personally handled GST and TDS compliance.

✓ Can prepare and explain quarterly P&L statements.

✓ Understand advance income tax calculations and payment deadlines.

✓ Are accurate, organized, responsible, and deadline-oriented.

✓ Have experience working with manufacturing, trading, or export companies.

How to Apply

Interested candidates may apply through LinkedIn or share their updated resume with Starke Aquacare Technologies.

Please mention your current salary, expected salary, notice period, and experience with Tally, GST, P&L reporting, and advance tax calculations.

title: Sales And Service Associate
description:
**Company Description**
VNS Scientific Instruments is a growing provider of scientific and laboratory equipment, serving clients across research, education, healthcare, and industrial sectors. The organization focuses on delivering reliable instruments, responsive technical support, and efficient after-sales service to help customers maintain high-quality operations. VNS Scientific Instruments values collaboration, integrity, and customer satisfaction, and encourages team members to contribute ideas that improve service quality. The company offers opportunities to learn about new technologies, engage with a variety of clients, and develop practical skills in sales and technical support. Team members are supported with training and a structured environment that promotes professional growth.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales and Service Associate is a full-time, on-site role based in Ghaziabad. This role involves engaging with existing and prospective customers, explaining product features and benefits, and providing guidance on suitable scientific instruments for their needs. The associate will prepare quotations, follow up on inquiries, process orders, and coordinate deliveries in collaboration with internal teams. Day-to-day tasks include basic installation support, routine maintenance visits, and assisting with troubleshooting under the guidance of senior technical staff. The role also entails maintaining customer records, documenting service activities, and contributing to sales targets through proactive communication and relationship building.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Ability to understand and explain technical product information, with an interest in scientific instruments or laboratory equipment.
* Customer-focused mindset, with strong interpersonal skills for building and maintaining client relationships.
* Clear verbal and written communication skills to present product details, prepare quotations, and document service activities.
* Basic problem-solving and troubleshooting abilities to support installations and routine service tasks.
* Organizational and time-management skills to handle multiple inquiries, follow-ups, and service visits efficiently.
* Comfort using office productivity tools (e.g., email, spreadsheets, CRM or customer databases).
* Relevant education in science, engineering, or a related field is an advantage; prior experience in sales or technical service is preferred but not mandatory.
* Willingness to travel locally for client visits and the ability to work on-site in Ghaziabad.

title: Expert Business Development Manager
description:
**Job Description**
**Role: Expert Business Development Manager**
**Location: Gurugram or Mumbai, India**
**Work Model: Hybrid – 4 days in the office**
**Work Timings: Monday – Friday, 10.00 AM to 7:00 PM IST**
**Reports to: Managing Director, Head of Markets, Asia Pacific**
**Introduction**
Are you a seasoned commercial leader with deep expertise in corporate services, fund administration, and entity management and a strong track record of shaping complex client solutions? Join CSC’s Markets team within the Global Financial Solutions (GFS) team in India as a Market Director where you will lead high-impact pursuits, influence strategic client engagements, and drive growth across our multinational client base.
  
  
In this senior role, you’ll collaborate with sales executives, service delivery leaders, and fellow subject matter experts to design innovative solutions, strengthen client relationships, and position CSC as a trusted advisor in the corporate and fund administration services space, and be a key driver of revenue growth, client satisfaction, and market expansion.
  
  
**What You’ll Be Doing:**

* Define and drive the India commercial strategy.
* Identify, develop, and win new business mandates targeting new and existing client accounts across corporate, fund administration, and entity management services in India and the broader APAC region, both individually and as part of the wider APAC Markets team, driving new sales and revenue.
* Develop and maintain strong, client-centric relationships with corporate clients, banks, asset managers, law firms, intermediaries, and referral partners in India and key cross-border markets.
* Leverage a strong local and regional network to build a high-value pipeline of opportunities, with a focus on cross-border business and strategic accounts.
* Lead complex sales opportunities across India, from qualification through close, ensuring alignment with client needs and CSC’s service capabilities.
* Shape and deliver strategic proposals that address multinational corporate and governance requirements, collaborating with senior stakeholders across the business.
* Act as a trusted advisor in client engagements, presenting CSC’s GFS solutions at a senior level and advising on best practices, delivery approaches, and value-added services.
* Oversee commercial structuring, including pricing strategy, negotiation support, and contractual considerations, ensuring both client value and commercial sustainability.
* Partner with Sales Leadership to drive pipeline strategy, conduct win/loss reviews, and identify opportunities to expand client relationships.
* Engage with cross-functional stakeholders — Business Operations and Commercial teams — to ensure seamless implementation and delivery readiness.
* Contribute to market positioning, leveraging industry insights and competitor analysis to influence strategic business development initiatives.
* Represent CSC in local and regional client forums, industry events, and senior-level planning sessions.
* Keep applicable marketing technology (e.g., Microsoft Dynamics, Salesforce) updated on leads, pipeline and through to closure, as well as relevant market intelligence.

**What We’re Looking For:**
Required Qualifications:
  
  

* 12–15 years of experience in sales, business development, or client solutions in corporate services with a demonstrated ability to generate and grow revenue.
* Proven track record leading complex, multi-jurisdictional client engagements and securing significant commercial wins.
* Strong background in corporate governance, fund administration, entity management, or legal compliance services.
* Exceptional communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage and influence senior client stakeholders.
* Experience developing tailored proposals, leading RFP responses, and structuring complex commercial arrangements.
* Skilled at working within complex global, matrixed organizations and managing cross-border teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with the ability to balance client needs and operational delivery requirements.
* Fluent in English.
* Advanced proficiency with CRM platforms (Salesforce preferred) and commercial analytics tools (Power BI).

Preferred Qualifications:
  
  

* University degree in Law, Business, Finance, or a related discipline.
* Established network within the corporate, funds, and banking services industry.

**About Us**
CSC is a global business, legal, and financial services company based in Wilmington, Delaware, USA, providing knowledge-based solutions to clients worldwide. We have offices and capabilities in over 140 jurisdictions in the Americas, Europe, Asia Pacific, and the Middle East, and more than 8,000 colleagues. We are the business behind business.®
  
  
Visit our careers site to learn more about CSC and our commitment to our clients, communities, and each other.
  
  
CSC is committed to creating a feeling of belonging through a diverse and growth-oriented environment where everyone is valued.
  
  
CSC colleagues have global career opportunities and excellent benefits, including annual success-sharing bonuses or commission plans based on individual performance. To learn more, visit cscglobal.com/service/careers .
  
  
We offer a range of support to colleagues with disabilities, ensuring people have the necessary resources to thrive in their roles. We encourage candidates to work closely with our talent acquisition partners to convey their specific needs. Our commitment to accessibility reflects our broader dedication to diversity and belonging,
  
  
CSC only accepts resumes from employment agencies that are part of our approved supplier program. Resumes submitted from other agencies either to talent acquisition, our hiring leaders, employees, or through any other mechanism other than our supplier process, will not be eligible to claim related fees and the submitted resumes will be considered property of CSC.
  
  
We encourage candidates to apply directly to our website and not through third-party sources.
  
  
*Disclaimer: The information above describes the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not intended to describe all duties, responsibilities, and qualifications.*
**About The Team**
At CSC®, we’re always looking ahead, finding ways to innovate, challenge the status quo, and anticipate the needs of our clients. We exceed expectations by adapting client ambitions and goals as our own. This Fierce Client Spirit has helped us adapt and create solutions that have enabled businesses to run smoother and smarter for more than 125 years. It’s also the reason we’re the trusted partner of many of the world’s most successful organizations.
  
  
CSC is committed to attracting, developing, and retaining talented people whose values align with ours. We empower our colleagues to bring the right solutions to market to meet client demand. That’s why we are the leading provider of business administration and compliance solutions.
  
  

* CSC is a great place to work with smart and dedicated people.

description:
**Client - Fast growing AI Solutions setup focused on SAP; helping CFO save millions**

**The role**

You run the funnel from first meeting to signed contract: you lead customer calls alongside our sellers, shape the solution with our technical pre-sales lead, and build the deck, proposal or RFP (Request for Proposal) response that wins the deal. You also own how the market sees us, through our capability story, case studies, events and social media. You will work directly with our Chief Business Officer and founders as we scale from our first customers in India, the US and Europe, and you will build the pre-sales and growth function as it grows. The pace is fast, and the ownership is real.

**What you will do**

* **Own the funnel:**
  track every opportunity from first meeting to signed contract, keep the CRM (customer relationship management system) and forecast honest, and find and fix where deals stall.
* **Run customer calls:**
  lead discovery and follow-up calls with CIOs (Chief Information Officers) and SAP leaders alongside our sellers, and drive the next steps to closure.
* **Win RFPs:**
  own our responses end to end, from the bid or no-bid call, plan and compliance matrix to the commercial sections and final submission, with our technical pre-sales lead on the technical answers.
* **Shape every proposal:**
  tailored customer decks within 24 hours of a call; proposals, statements of work and pricing within 48 hours.
* **Own our story:**
  the capability deck, case studies and follow-up packs, kept sharp and backed by evidence.
* **Run events:**
  plan and deliver presence at SAP user-group meetings, webinars, CIO roundtables and partner events, from invitations and content to the follow-up that turns attendees into meetings.
* **Build the engine:**
  reusable content, templates and AI-assisted workflows that make every next deal faster; bring what you learn from customers back into product and pricing.

**What you bring**

* 4–7 years in pre-sales, bid and proposal work, or consulting, at an IT (Information Technology) services firm, SAP partner, consulting firm or software company.
* Confidence leading client calls with senior IT leaders, and a track record of moving deals forward, not just documenting them.
* Strong business writing and storytelling: answer first, then evidence. You build clean, well-structured and impactful slides quickly.
* Working knowledge of SAP: what ECC and S/4HANA are, why custom code and testing matter in a migration, and how SAP programmes are bought.
* Comfort with Excel for pricing and effort tables.
* Daily use of AI writing tools (such as Claude or Microsoft Copilot) to work faster, while checking every fact.
* The ability to juggle several deadlines at once and still deliver on time.

**Nice to have:**
proposals for US or European clients; an SAP functional background (Finance, Sales and Distribution, or Materials Management); an MBA (Master of Business Administration); experience of new-age design tools.

**Why join**

* Shape how a new kind of SAP company tells its story to CIOs (Chief Information Officers) in India, the US and Europe.
* Work directly with the founders, and room to build and lead the pre-sales function.

**How we hire**

A portfolio conversation about decks or proposals you have built, a 24-hour customer-deck exercise, a short live working session, and an SAP conversation with our technical pre-sales lead. We aim to decide within a week and prefer candidates who can join within 30–60 days.

* Bachelor Degree (preferably in Business Management, Marketing, or other related fields)

We are looking for people who are willing to consistently achieve results, even under tough circumstances, employees who create a climate where everyone is motivated to do their best to help the organization achieve its objectives. To deliver better for our customers, our future colleagues build strong customer relationships and deliver customer-centric solutions. Are you someone who applies knowledge of business and the marketplace to advance the organization's goals? Are you someone who can create new and better ways for the organization to be successful? SIG is the place for you to build something incredible. We offer competitive compensation and an opportunity to partially work from home. Job description:
  
  
About us
  
  
We are a Gurugram-based group building products across EdTech, B2B SaaS and deep technology. Our team is small, fast and close to the founders, so interns work on real targets and see the impact of their work every day.
  
  
Each selected intern is assigned to one of the products below. The final assignment is decided during selection, based on your strengths, interests and our business needs.
  
  
About the role and daily KRAs
  
  
Your core job is to start conversations with new prospects every day and keep every conversation moving until it becomes a meeting, a sign-up or a clear no. You will own the top of the sales pipeline for your assigned product.
  
  
Key responsibilities
  
  
Lead research: Find and qualify new prospects that match the target customer profile of your assigned product, using LinkedIn, company websites, directories and other sources.
  
Daily outreach: Reach out to at least 100 fresh leads every day through email, LinkedIn, WhatsApp, phone calls or other approved channels.
  
Follow-ups: Follow up with every lead you have contacted, on a regular cadence, until they respond or are closed out.
  
Personalized messaging: Adapt approved message templates to each prospect's role, company and needs, so outreach feels relevant and not generic.
  
Qualifying interest: Understand each prospect's need, answer first-level questions about the product and move interested leads to a meeting, demo, trial, sign-up or enrollment as per the product's sales process.
  
Pipeline management: Keep the CRM or lead tracker accurate and up to date with every touchpoint, response and next step.
  
Reporting: Share a daily activity report and join weekly reviews on outreach numbers, reply rates and conversions.
  
Feedback loop: Share objections, common questions and market feedback with the team to improve messaging, targeting and the product.
  
Coordination: Work with the marketing, product and leadership teams on campaigns, events and partner opportunities for your product.

: Customers who value exceptional customer experiences have what they need on our single unified platform, built with an operating system approach on a single codebase. That means that everything — and everyone — can work together to service, respond, sell, and market to customers on the channels they prefer. While Unified Customer Experience Management (Unified-CXM) as a category is just getting started, we are well on our way to creating a no-compromise, unified approach to better customer experiences for the world’s leading enterprise brands.

To learn more about employee benefits by region, click here.
  
  
To learn more about all-things-Sprinklr, visit our candidate resource hub here.

: Our goal is to ensure every employee feels like they belong and are operating in a collaborative environment. We fervently believe every employee matters and should be respected and heard. We believe we are stronger when we belong because collectively, we’re more innovative, creative, and successful.
  
  
Sprinklr is proud to be an equal-opportunity workplace and complies with all applicable federal, state, and local fair employment practices laws. We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, religion, creed, national origin or ancestry, ethnicity, sex (including gender, pregnancy, sexual orientation, and gender identity), age, physical or mental disability, citizenship, past, current, or prospective service in the uniformed services, genetic information, or any other characteristic protected under applicable law.

**Warning about Recruiting Scams:**

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
Job Description – Field Sales Executive (Education Sales)
  
Department: Business Development & Sales
  
Employment Type: Full-Time
  
Work Location: Field-Based – Delhi NCR / Assigned Territory
  
Reporting To: Business Development Lead / Sales Manager
  
Compensation: Up to ₹40,000 per month, subject to the applicable compensation structure, experience and performance
  
Travel Requirement: Regular local travel for customer visits and home sessions
  
Mandatory Requirement: Personal two-wheeler or four-wheeler and a valid driving licence for the vehicle used
  
About EaseToLearn
  
EaseToLearn is an education-focused organisation offering technology-driven learning solutions designed to make learning more accessible, engaging and effective.
  
Role Overview
  
EaseToLearn is seeking a target-oriented and customer-focused Field Sales Executive to drive revenue through customer conversion and sales closures.
  
The role involves contacting assigned prospects and enquiries, conducting follow-up calls, understanding customer requirements, delivering in-person demonstrations and home sessions, addressing objections, and converting prospects into paying customers.
  
The primary responsibility is revenue generation through sales conversion and closures, not lead generation. The candidate must be comfortable with regular field travel, direct customer interaction and performance-based sales targets.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
1. Calling and Customer Conversion
  
Contact assigned prospects and customer enquiries through outbound calls and follow-ups.
  
Explain the company's products, services, pricing and value proposition accurately.
  
Understand customer requirements, address queries and resolve sales objections.
  
Follow up with interested prospects and guide them towards a purchase decision.
  
2. Field Sales and Home Sessions
  
Conduct customer visits, product demonstrations and home sessions within the assigned territory.
  
Explain relevant educational solutions based on customer requirements.
  
Build customer confidence, address concerns and negotiate within approved company guidelines.
  
Close sales through effective customer engagement and consultative selling.
  
Maintain professional conduct during customer visits and represent the company appropriately.
  
3. Revenue Generation and Sales Closures
  
Achieve assigned daily, weekly and monthly sales and revenue targets.
  
Convert assigned enquiries and prospects into paying customers.
  
Drive closures through calling, follow-ups, demonstrations and in-person meetings.
  
Maintain accurate records of sales opportunities, conversions, payments and closure status, wherever applicable.
  
Monitor sales performance and conversion rates to identify opportunities for improvement.
  
4. Customer Relationship Management
  
Maintain professional relationships with prospective and existing customers.
  
Provide accurate product information and support a smooth customer experience throughout the sales process.
  
Coordinate with internal teams regarding customer onboarding, payment confirmation and post-sale requirements.
  
Escalate customer concerns and share relevant feedback with the reporting manager.
  
5. Sales Reporting and Compliance
  
Update the CRM or designated reporting system with call outcomes, follow-up status, customer visits, home sessions, closures and revenue generated.
  
Submit daily sales and activity reports within prescribed timelines.
  
Plan customer visits and follow-ups efficiently to maximise productive selling time.
  
Follow approved pricing, sales processes, customer communication standards and company policies.
  
Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
  
Performance will be assessed against defined, measurable targets, including:
  
Achievement of assigned sales and revenue targets.
  
Number of successful sales closures and paying customers.
  
Conversion rate from assigned prospects to paying customers.
  
Effectiveness of follow-up calls and customer visits.
  
Number and quality of completed home sessions.
  
Accuracy and timeliness of sales reporting.
  
Customer experience and compliance with company policies.
  
Eligibility Criteria
  
Graduation in any discipline.
  
Freshers with strong communication skills, sales aptitude and a willingness to learn may apply.
  
Prior experience in field sales, direct sales, education sales, consultative selling or customer conversion will be an advantage.
  
Good verbal communication, persuasion, negotiation and objection-handling skills.
  
Ability to manage follow-ups, interact confidently with customers and work towards sales targets.
  
Basic proficiency in smartphones and digital reporting tools; familiarity with CRM systems or spreadsheets is an advantage.
  
Mandatory Requirements
  
Must own and have regular access to a personal two-wheeler or four-wheeler suitable for field visits.
  
Must hold a valid driving licence for the vehicle used.
  
Must be comfortable with regular travel across Delhi NCR or the assigned territory.
  
Must be willing to conduct customer visits and home sessions.
  
Must be comfortable with outbound calling, follow-ups, direct selling and revenue-based performance targets.
  
Important Clarification About the Role
  
This is a field-based sales conversion and revenue-generation position, not a lead-generation role.
  
The company will assign prospects or customer enquiries for follow-up and conversion, as per its operational process. The executive will be responsible for engaging these prospects, conducting customer interactions and home sessions, following up consistently, and converting them into paying customers.
  
Independent lead sourcing is not the primary responsibility of this position.
  
Ideal Candidate Profile
  
The ideal candidate is proactive, persuasive, disciplined and comfortable with field mobility. They should be capable of managing the sales conversion process from the initial assigned customer contact through follow-up, home session and final closure. A strong focus on customer needs, sales discipline and measurable revenue outcomes is essential.
  
Compensation and Benefits
  
Compensation may be offered up to ₹50,000 per month, depending on the approved fixed-pay and incentive structure, relevant experience and performance.
  
The applicable fixed salary, performance incentives, travel reimbursement and other benefits, if any, will be communicated during the recruitment process.
  
Application Process
  
Interested candidates should complete the application form using the link below:
  
Application Form: https://tally.so/r/o99D7P
  
Shortlisted candidates will be assessed on communication skills, sales aptitude, customer handling, field readiness and ability to convert assigned prospects into paying customers.

* Conduct online research to build target account databases, identify decision-makers, and validate stakeholder contact details.
* Maintain lead pipelines and report clearly on leads, follow-ups, competitor activity, and business development progress.

* Communicate effectively in spoken and written English and Hindi during outreach, follow-up, and prospect relationship-building.

**Additional Plus**

* A Bachelor of Business Administration, Bachelor of Marketing, Associate of Business Administration, or Bachelor of International Business is relevant preparation for this work.
* A Doctor of Business Administration or Executive Master of Business Administration may complement practical business development skills.

**What You'll Bring**

* A business administration foundation and interest or study in B2B lead generation, inside sales, or business development.
* Zero to two years of relevant experience; candidates with no prior experience are considered for this entry-level position.
* Clear, professional English and Hindi communication skills for cold outreach, listening, and prospect follow-up.
* An organized, proactive approach and readiness to work on-site in Bengaluru or Gurugram, reporting to the Client Solutions team.

**Why Join Us**

Join Rassense Private Limited, a food services company focused on workplace experiences and the role of technology in food production and service. The company aims to serve clients across sectors and geographies, drawing on technological expertise in India and AI tools to enhance customer experience. Its vision also emphasizes relationships with production communities, including Farmer Producer Organizations, and its Indian heritage. In this role, your account research, outreach, and relationship-building will help develop opportunities across food and beverage services, higher education, hospitals and health care, and manufacturing. Working with the Client Solutions team, you will take part in lead generation, prospect engagement, meeting coordination, and pipeline management. The company’s “Together is More” philosophy centers on collaboration among employees, clients, and partners, as well as ethics, quality, shared growth, and trusted long-term relationships. This entry-level opportunity offers practical involvement in business development and exposure to prospective clients across several sectors, contributing to the company’s growth ambitions.

**Sales Engineer**

📍
**Location:**
Delhi (On-site)

💼
**Job Type:**
Full-time

💰
**Salary:**
₹30,000–₹40,000 per month

**🏢 About ThinkRobotics**

ThinkRobotics.com, the e-commerce division of Atlantis Robotics Pvt. Ltd., provides advanced robotics and electronic components to innovators, engineers, and businesses across India. We are committed to delivering high-quality products, innovative solutions, and exceptional customer support.

**🎯 Role Overview**

We are looking for a technically skilled and customer-focused
**Sales Engineer**
with an interest in electronics, robotics, and industrial products. The ideal candidate will combine technical knowledge with sales expertise to understand customer requirements, recommend suitable products, develop new business opportunities, and build long-term client relationships.

The candidate will work closely with customers and internal teams to provide appropriate technical solutions while achieving sales targets and contributing to business growth.

**🔹 Key Responsibilities**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities in robotics, electronics, and industrial products.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable technical products and solutions.
* Explain product features, technical specifications, and applications to customers.
* Handle B2B sales enquiries and manage leads through platforms such as IndiaMART and the GEMS portal.
* Prepare quotations, respond to Requests for Quotations (RFQs), and provide technical product information.
* Assist customers in selecting appropriate components and solutions based on their technical and commercial requirements.
* Conduct product demonstrations and technical presentations when required.
* Follow up with prospective and existing customers to convert enquiries into sales.
* Negotiate pricing and commercial terms while maintaining customer satisfaction.
* Coordinate with internal teams for product availability, order processing, and timely delivery.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with clients, engineers, distributors, and business partners.
* Maintain customer records, sales reports, and lead updates using CRM tools or internal systems.
* Monitor market trends, competitor offerings, and new developments in robotics, electronics, and IoT.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and contribute to the company's overall revenue growth.

**🔹 Required Qualifications & Skills**

* Bachelor's degree in Electronics Engineering, Electrical Engineering, Mechatronics, Instrumentation, or a related technical field.
* Minimum
  **2 years of experience**
  in technical sales, sales engineering, B2B sales, or industrial product sales.
* Basic understanding of electronic components, robotics, automation, or related technical products.
* Ability to understand technical specifications and recommend appropriate products based on customer requirements.
* Familiarity with IndiaMART and the GEMS portal.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and customer-handling skills.
* Ability to prepare quotations, handle RFQs, and explain technical information clearly.
* Strong problem-solving, follow-up, and relationship-building abilities.
* A target-oriented mindset with the ability to manage multiple customer enquiries.

**🔹 Preferred Qualifications**

* Master's degree in Engineering, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Knowledge of robotics, IoT, embedded systems, sensors, microcontrollers, and electronic components.
* Experience with CRM tools, technical documentation, and sales reporting.
* Exposure to technical demonstrations, product presentations, trade shows, or industry exhibitions.
* Experience working with engineering companies, manufacturers, system integrators, or industrial clients.

**🎁 What We Offer**

✨ Opportunity to work with innovative robotics, electronics, and automation products.

✨ A collaborative and technology-driven work environment.

✨ Professional development and career growth opportunities.

✨ Exposure to diverse B2B customers and technical applications.

Interested candidates can share their updated resumes at:

📧
**Email:**
mkumar@thinkrobotics.com

**Thanks & Regards,**

**Monika**

title: Business Development Manager – IT Services & Global Business Expansion Engineer
description:
**Company:**
Spaising Technologies

**Location:**
Remote/Hybrid

**Experience:**
5–8 years (preferred)

**Employment Type:**
Full-time

**Compensation:**
Competitive fixed salary + performance-based incentives

About Spaising Technologies

Spaising Technologies is a technology consulting and software engineering company helping businesses solve real-world challenges through software engineering, enterprise technology, system integration and emerging AI capabilities.

With 10+ years of experience, 120+ projects delivered and clients across India, the US, UK and Canada, we build practical, scalable technology solutions that help businesses innovate and grow.

Our key service areas include:

* Agentic AI and intelligent business automation
* Microsoft Solutions – Power Apps, Power Automate, SharePoint and Power BI
* Systems and B2B Integration
* Enterprise Applications and Custom Software Development
* System Integration and Security
* Open Source Technologies

We work with businesses across construction, garment and textile, supply chain, e-commerce, education and logistics.

We are now looking for an ambitious and result-oriented
**Business Development Manager**
to expand our domestic and international business.

Role Overview

The Business Development Manager will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, developing strategic relationships, acquiring new clients and generating revenue for Spaising Technologies.

The candidate will drive business development activities across India and international markets, with a particular focus on the US, UK and Canada.

This role requires someone who understands IT services sales, can communicate confidently with business decision-makers and has the ability to convert business opportunities into long-term client relationships.

Key Responsibilities

**1. New Business Development**

* Identify and acquire new clients in India and international markets.
* Generate qualified business opportunities through LinkedIn, email outreach, networking, referrals, business platforms and other channels.
* Identify companies that need custom software, AI solutions, Microsoft services, Systems integration and enterprise application development.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline.

**2. International Business Expansion**

* Develop business opportunities in the US, UK, Canada and other international markets.
* Connect with founders, CEOs, CTOs, CIOs, IT Directors, procurement heads and business owners.
* Explore partnerships with IT consulting firms, software agencies, technology partners and system integrators.
* Build relationships that generate recurring projects and long-term engagements.

**3. Consultative Selling**

* Understand clients' business requirements and technology challenges.
* Present Spaising's services and capabilities through meetings, presentations and proposals.
* Work with the technical team to understand requirements and prepare project estimates and solutions.
* Position Spaising as a technology partner rather than just a software development vendor.

**4. Lead Management & Sales Conversion**

* Manage the complete sales lifecycle, from prospecting to deal closure.
* Conduct discovery calls, client meetings, follow-ups and negotiations.
* Prepare proposals, quotations, presentations and commercial offers.
* Maintain CRM records, sales reports, forecasts and pipeline updates.
* Ensure timely follow-ups and successful conversion of opportunities.

**5. Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify opportunities through technology partnerships, referral networks and business associations.
* Build relationships with consultants, agencies and companies looking for reliable development partners.
* Explore subcontracting, white-label development and dedicated development team opportunities.

**6. Coordination & Account Growth**

* Coordinate with internal technical and delivery teams during pre-sales.
* Ensure smooth handover of projects after closure.
* Identify opportunities for repeat business, additional services and long-term client engagements.

Required Skills & Experience

* 5–8 years of experience in B2B business development or sales, preferably in IT services or software development.
* Proven experience in acquiring new clients and closing software development or technology projects.
* Experience in international client acquisition, particularly the US, UK or Canada, will be highly preferred.
* Strong understanding of IT services such as custom software development, Microsoft technologies, cloud, AI, integrations or enterprise applications.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship-building skills.
* Ability to independently identify prospects and generate qualified leads.
* Experience with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, CRM tools, email outreach and sales prospecting platforms.
* Ability to prepare proposals, manage commercial discussions and close deals.
* Self-driven, target-oriented and comfortable working in a growing technology company.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistent generation of qualified business opportunities.
* Acquisition of new domestic and international clients.
* Successful closure of software development and technology projects.
* Development of strategic partnerships and referral channels.
* Growth in recurring revenue and long-term client relationships.
* A predictable and measurable sales pipeline.

What We Offer

* Opportunity to lead business expansion for a growing technology company.
* Exposure to international clients and diverse technology projects.
* Opportunity to work across Agentic AI, Microsoft, enterprise applications and integration solutions.
* Performance-based incentives linked to business development achievements.
* A collaborative environment with direct access to the leadership and technical teams.

**If you are passionate about technology sales, building relationships and creating business opportunities globally, we would love to hear from you.**

**Apply:**
info@spaising.com

**Website:**
www.spaising.com

title: Sr. Business Development Manager- Open Access
description:
**Informa**
is a leading academic publishing, business intelligence, knowledge and events business, creating unique content and connectivity for customers all over the world. It is listed on the London Stock Exchange and is a member of the FTSE 100.

**Taylor & Francis Group**
produces high quality, peer reviewed books and journals. We produce unique, trusted content by expert authors, spreading knowledge and promoting discovery globally. We aim to broaden thinking and advance understanding, providing academics and professionals with a platform to share ideas and realise their individual potential.

**What we offer in return:**

At Taylor & Francis we care about our colleagues, promoting work-life balance, wellbeing, and flexible working. You will be joining a thriving business, working alongside an exceptional group of people. We believe that the skills and experience you bring to Taylor & Francis are invaluable. We want you to have the opportunity to develop your abilities, and to innovate and develop in areas which you are passionate about.

* 30 days annual leave
* 4 volunteering days annually
* Day off for your birthday
* Pension contributions
* Medical insurance for self and dependents; life cover and personal accident cover for self
* Seasonal social and charitable events
* Training and development

**Job Description**

We currently have an opportunity for a Sr. Business Development Manager to join Pay to Publish - Open Research India commercial team.

**This is an individual contributor role.**

Looking for a Sr. Business Development Manager for Open Access Publication for Taylor and Francis Group Division. Responsibilities involve Account Management, hunting new accounts maximize sales pipeline by representing Open Research Publication Avenues to Research Organizations, Leading Higher Education Institutions & Societies, Corporate & Research Funders engaged in Research Grants.

**Closing date for applications:**
Monday, 30th November 2026

**Applications are shortlisted on a rolling basis and we will be interviewing alongside advertising. We therefore encourage you to apply at the earliest opportunity.**

**Key Accountabilities:**

* Deliver sales targets by selling Open Access Research Publishing Solutions to the leading Research Institutions, Universities, Societies, and drive APC (Article Processing Charges) revenue onto open access/research platforms.
* Develop Account Management Strategy from the target customers/segments in the region in adherence to Open Research Publishing global commercial strategy with core focus to sell Open Access memberships, F1000 Platforms, Gateways, and Pre-paid APC packages.
* Develop & manage relationships with key stakeholders including but not limited to Head of Organizations, Research Heads, Directors, Vice Chancellors, Heads of departments/Academic Dean of key academic institutions having sizable Gold OA output in the region.
* Periodically reporting to manager on sales progress and the business environment, thus ensuring responsiveness to both the micro and macro business environments.
* Work closely with the Customer Success team to extend a robust post-sales support to existing clients.
* Actively liaise with stakeholder departments or groups within the business to enhance seamless service delivery to customers – includes credit control, editorial, marketing and sales support
* Attending relevant conferences and events to build relationships and prospect for new customers.

* Travelling to potential sales opportunities in the respective region.

**When applying, please include a covering letter with your CV explaining why you are interested in this role and working for Taylor & Francis.**

**Qualifications**

**The ideal candidate will have:**

* Good & Proven knowledge of selling B2B Solutions.
* Prior experience engaging with academic institutions/universities is highly desirable
* Good Knowledge of Research Publishing solutions, Open Access/Open research publishing services
* Understanding of the research and Higher Education domain in India, covering Public & Private funded Institutions/Universities, Research Centers, corporates, research societies & related community
* Consultative sales skills and a customer-focused approach
* The ability to work independently and proactively
* Willingness to travel extensively on territory and to conferences, as required
* Target driven approach and the skills to manage sales budgets
* Excellent negotiation skills, written and oral communication and presentation skills
* A collaborative and flexible approach to working both internally and externally
* Excellent commercial and financial awareness
* Good analytical, decision making and problem-solving skill
* Competent user of core MS Office package

**Additional Information**

**Location:**

* You must have the right to work and live in India.
* The successful candidate will be able to utilise our balanced working model. We ask that candidates live within a commutable distance of our
  **New Delhi**
  office to ensure that as a balanced worker they can make it to our office location to collaborate as required. There is an expectation for a
  **minimum of 3 days per week in-person time**
  .
* We believe that great things happen when people connect face-to-face. That's why we work in-person with each other, or with customers and partners, three days a week or more. When you’re not spending time together in one of our offices or other workplaces – like at conference – you get the flexibility and support to work from home or remotely.

We want all our candidates to shine in our recruitment process. Please let us know if there is anything we can do to ensure you are able to show us your best self. This could include having the application form in a different format, more time for questions, or anything else – please ask us, we are happy to be flexible! Please contact recruitment@tandf.co.uk

title: Direct Sales Manager - Mumbai/ Delhi/Vizag
description:
**Work Schedule**
Standard (Mon-Fri)
  
  
**Environmental Conditions**
Various outside weather conditions
  
  
As part of the Thermo Fisher Scientific team, you'll discover meaningful work that makes a positive impact on a global scale. Join our colleagues in bringing our Mission to life every single day to enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer. We provide our global teams with the resources needed to achieve individual career goals while helping to take science a step beyond by developing solutions for some of the world's toughest challenges, like protecting the environment, making sure our food is safe or helping find cures for cancer.
  
  
**Description**
Join our collaborative sales team at Thermo Fisher Scientific and contribute as an Area Sales Manager. You will increase revenue and build lasting relationships with customers while representing our comprehensive portfolio of scientific products and services. Working in a supportive environment that values achievement and innovation, you'll help enable our customers to make the world healthier, cleaner and safer.
  
  
**Location-Specific Focus Areas:**

* Mumba/ Delhi (1 position): focused on Capex sales - Chemical Analysis or Analytical/Scientific Instrumentation, and/or Safety & Security related instrumentation.
* Vizag (1 position): Focused on a Capex sales with emphasis on molecular techniques, including PCR, qPCR, Sanger Sequencing, and Next-Generation Sequencing (NGS), and their applications across research, clinical, and forensic workflows

How you will make an impact:
  
  

* Drive business growth across all market verticals, including Pharma, Biopharma, Life Sciences Research, Healthcare, Industrial, CTLs, Academia, government accounts, and the Food market
* Develop and implement strategic sales plans, manage key account relationships, and ensure customer satisfaction through consultative selling
* Lead and grow the sales funnel for assigned market verticals and product lines to ensure long-term business sustainability
* Focus on achieving business targets for direct bookings and revenue, aligning with overall organizational growth goals
* Collaborate closely with cross-functional teams (Product Managers, Service, Application, Supply Chain, Finance, and Marketing) to achieve organizational business objectives
* Take full responsibility for managing and growing your assigned sales territory
* Provide tailored solutions that meet customer needs while achieving sales targets through a combination of customer visits and virtual engagement
* Ensure high levels of customer satisfaction by fostering positive relationships and addressing client needs, serving as a trusted advisor to help customers advance their scientific goals
* Prepare accurate sales forecasts, perform trend analysis, and achieve results to meet targets
* Diligently follow up on leads from other departments and keep the Lead Portal, Opportunity Funnel, and CRM systems updated
* Identify new key accounts, distributors/channel partners, and direct sales opportunities, and map the assigned area
* Stay informed about competitor activities, including pricing, offers, systems, and procedures, to maintain a competitive edge
* Implement marketing and advertising strategies in alignment with the plans set by the Marketing team

title: Medical Business Associate -  Delhi

You will create and deliver a territory plan that reflects local needs and customer insights. Working closely with colleagues across teams, you will help solve challenges and improve patient access. We seek curious, honest, and practical thinkers who want to learn and grow. This role offers strong learning opportunities, meaningful career growth, and a chance to unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.

* Build and maintain respectful, professional relationships with doctors, pharmacists, and other healthcare partners across your territory.

* Share clear and accurate science-based information to support healthcare professionals’ decision-making.
* Record and report activities, outcomes, and customer insights accurately using company systems and tools.
* Collaborate with colleagues across functions to address customer needs and improve patient access.
* Continuously expand your knowledge of clinical evidence, market trends, and ways to enhance your performance.

Why You?
  
  
Work type
  
  
This is an on-site role based in Delhi, requiring regular travel within the assigned territory. You will be part of a supportive team that provides coaching and practical feedback. We encourage applicants from all backgrounds and perspectives to apply. We value inclusion and strive to create a workplace where everyone can contribute and grow.
  
  
Basic Qualification
  
  
We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals:
  
  

* Bachelor’s degree from a recognised institution.
* Minimum 1 year of customer-facing experience in field sales, medical business, or territory management roles.
* Valid driver’s licence and willingness to travel regularly within the territory.
* Good verbal and written communication skills in English and Hindi; knowledge of local languages spoken in Delhi is a plus.
* Basic digital skills, including Microsoft Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.

**Preferred Qualification**

* Prior experience in pharmaceutical, medical, or healthcare-related roles.
* Comfortable discussing clinical evidence and explaining scientific concepts to healthcare professionals.
* Strong planning, organisation, and time management skills.
* Ability to use customer insight and simple data to guide your activities and priorities.
* Fluency in local languages spoken in and around Delhi.
* High motivation to learn, adapt, and take on increasing responsibility.

Ready to apply?
  
  
If this role matches your skills and career goals, we would love to hear from you. Apply now and take the next step in your career while helping us unite science, technology, and talent to get ahead of disease together.
  
  
**Job Location - Delhi**
**Skills**
Customer Centric Selling, Data to Insights, Digital Fluency, Omnichannel, Sales Territory Management, Scientific Literacy
  
  
**Why GSK?**
**Uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together.**
GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
  
  
People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most. Our culture of being ambitious for patients, accountable for impact and doing the right thing is the foundation for how, together, we deliver for patients, shareholders and our people.

Please contact our Recruitment Team at IN.recruitment-adjustments@gsk.com to discuss your needs.

Vermeillo is a design-led home décor and lifestyle brand that brings together editorial, retail, and interior design in a unified experience. The brand curates a thoughtful selection of objects, ideas, and visual stories that reflect contemporary living. Vermeillo explores diverse perspectives across interiors, architecture, art, and lifestyle, offering customers distinctive and inspiring spaces. Team members are part of a creative environment that values aesthetics, storytelling, and meaningful customer engagement.

We are looking for a confident, articulate, and customer-focused Store Sales Executive who can represent our brand, build meaningful customer relationships, and contribute to the growth of our retail business.

Key Responsibilities

\* Drive in-store sales by understanding customer preferences and recommending suitable products.

\* Deliver a premium, personalised shopping experience to every customer.

\* Build strong customer relationships and encourage repeat purchases and referrals.

\* Maintain excellent product knowledge and effectively communicate product features, craftsmanship, and design value.

\* Actively contribute to achieving individual and store sales targets.

\* Maintain attractive product displays, visual merchandising standards, and overall store presentation.

\* Participate in brand-led marketing activities, PR events, customer engagement initiatives, and promotional events.

\* Assist in lead follow-ups, client relationship management, and other sales-related activities.

\* Coordinate with the team to ensure smooth day-to-day store operations.

Requirements

\* Prior experience in sales is essential, preferably in premium retail, lifestyle, furniture, or home and living brands.

\* Experience in the home and living or luxury retail segment will be an added advantage.

\* Strong verbal communication skills with fluency and confidence in spoken English.

\* A presentable, professional demeanour with a positive and proactive attitude.

\* Strong interpersonal skills and the ability to engage with discerning customers.

\* A sales-driven mindset with a focus on customer satisfaction and business growth.

\* Willingness to participate in marketing, networking, and PR events organised by the brand.

What We Offer

\* The opportunity to work with an emerging premium D2C lifestyle brand.

\* International exposure through overseas business trips to explore global design markets, discover emerging trends, and gain first-hand insights into the world of design and lifestyle.

\* Opportunities to travel internationally for sourcing, product discovery, and design exploration as part of the brand’s growth journey.

\* Exposure to international sourcing platforms, research tools, global design trends, and contemporary lifestyle concepts.

\* Hands-on learning in product curation, sourcing, visual merchandising, customer engagement, and brand development.

\* Opportunities to participate in exclusive brand-led marketing, networking, and PR events.

\* A creative work environment with opportunities to learn, develop new skills, and grow alongside the brand.

\*Compensation & Perks: Initial monthly salary of ₹25,000 -₹30,000+ quarterly performance-based incentives, with opportunities for international travel, global design exposure, and career growth in the premium lifestyle industry.

Who Should Apply?

We are looking for someone who enjoys interacting with people, understands the importance of customer experience, and has the confidence to sell through conversation, product knowledge, and genuine enthusiasm.

If you have a passion for sales, an eye for design, and the drive to grow with a premium lifestyle brand, we would love to hear from you.

📩 Apply now with your updated resume and contact details.

title: Sales And Application Engineer Or Manager - Robotics And Industrial Automation
description:
**Company Description**
BARD ROBOTICS AND AUTOMATION is a trusted provider of comprehensive automation solutions for diverse industries. The company delivers services that include robot programming for leading brands, off-line simulation for process validation, and advanced spot and arc welding automation tailored to complex manufacturing needs. Its expertise extends to machine tending and process optimization, helping clients improve productivity, quality, and uptime. Using state-of-the-art tools and engineering know-how, BARD ROBOTICS AND AUTOMATION designs and implements solutions that align with each customer’s unique operational goals.
  
**Role Description**
The Sales and Application Engineer or Manager – Robotics and Industrial Automation is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram. This position focuses on identifying customer needs, presenting automation solutions, and managing the technical and commercial aspects of sales opportunities. Daily responsibilities include preparing proposals, conducting product and solution demonstrations, visiting client sites, and collaborating with engineering teams to design and validate robot-based and automation systems. The role also involves providing application support, troubleshooting technical issues, training customer teams on deployed solutions, and maintaining long-term relationships to drive repeat business. The individual will work closely with internal stakeholders to ensure timely project execution and high customer satisfaction.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Sales skills for solution selling, opportunity management, and customer engagement.
* Candidates should possess Technical Support skills to handle pre-sales and post-sales queries, troubleshooting, and customer training.
* Candidates should possess Electrical Engineering and Mechanical Engineering skills to understand, design, and evaluate robotic and automation systems.
* Experience in robotics, industrial automation, welding cells, and machine tending applications is highly beneficial.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering (Mechanical, Electrical, Mechatronics, or related field) or equivalent practical experience is preferred.
* Ability to interpret technical drawings, layouts, and specifications, and to coordinate effectively with design and project teams.
* Strong communication, negotiation, and presentation skills, with the ability to interact confidently with technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Comfort working on-site in industrial environments in Gurugram and willing to travel to customer locations as needed.

**Company Description**
Fares Saver is a growing travel services company focused on delivering cost-effective flight and holiday solutions to individual and corporate travelers. Based in New Delhi, the organization aims to simplify travel planning by offering competitive fares, transparent pricing, and responsive customer support. The team works closely with major airlines, travel portals, and service partners to provide tailored itineraries and reliable booking options. Fares Saver values professionalism, integrity, and customer-centric service, and offers opportunities for team members to learn, grow, and build a career in the travel industry.

VBB Infra Pvt. Ltd. is an infrastructure solutions provider supporting India’s growth since 2010. The company executes critical projects across Power Transmission, Railways, Telecom, Underground Utilities, and Civil Infrastructure.

With a team of over 400 professionals, VBB Infra combines engineering expertise, skilled manpower, and operational excellence to deliver complex infrastructure projects. The organization is committed to maintaining high standards of quality, safety, and reliability while building the connections that power India’s progress.

Position Overview

VBB Infra Pvt. Ltd. is looking for a detail-oriented and experienced
**General Accounts Executive**
to join its Accounts & Finance team. The ideal candidate should have strong knowledge of general accounting, accounts payable and receivable, bank reconciliation, financial reporting, and statutory compliance.

The candidate will be responsible for maintaining accurate accounting records, processing vendor invoices and payments, supporting financial closing activities, and ensuring compliance with applicable financial and statutory requirements.

Key Responsibilities

**1. General Accounting**

* Record and maintain day-to-day accounting transactions in Nway ERP.
* Prepare and post journal entries, payment vouchers, and receipt vouchers.
* Maintain accurate accounting records and supporting documentation.
* Ensure the accuracy and completeness of financial transactions.

**2. Accounts Payable & Receivable**

* Process and verify vendor invoices against supporting documents and applicable approvals.
* Ensure timely processing of vendor payments as per agreed payment terms.
* Monitor accounts payable and accounts receivable balances.
* Track outstanding payments and receivables and coordinate with relevant stakeholders for timely resolution.

**3. Reconciliation & Financial Control**

* Perform regular bank account reconciliations.
* Reconcile vendor ledgers and customer accounts.
* Investigate and resolve discrepancies in accounting records.
* Ensure proper documentation and accuracy of financial entries.

**4. Financial Reporting & MIS**

* Prepare periodic MIS reports and expense analysis.
* Assist in the preparation of financial statements and supporting schedules.
* Support monthly, quarterly, and annual financial closing activities.
* Provide relevant accounting data and reports to management as required.

**5. Taxation & Statutory Compliance**

* Ensure accurate accounting treatment and compliance with applicable GST and TDS requirements.
* Assist in the preparation of GST and TDS-related data, reconciliations, and supporting documentation.
* Maintain records required for statutory audits and internal reviews.
* Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants, as required, for compliance-related matters.

Educational Qualification

* Additional accounting or taxation qualifications will be an advantage.

Experience & Skills Required

* Experience in the construction, infrastructure, or service industry is preferred.

* Good understanding of accounting principles, GST, TDS, and financial documentation.

* High attention to detail, accuracy, and organizational skills.
* Ability to coordinate effectively with vendors, internal departments, and other stakeholders.

* Inspire and develop the team: Supervise and support team members, monitor performance, provide coaching, and foster a positive and productive work environment

A passion for spreading the light and warmth of
**Hospitality**
. Acting with
**Integrity**
and always doing the right thing. Inspiring others through
**Leadership**
. A belief that
**Teamwork**
drives the best outcomes. A sense of
**Ownership**
and accountability. And a focus on the
**Now**
, bringing urgency and discipline to every moment, knowing it can make a lasting impact.

* Diploma or degree in Hospitality, Business, or related field

* Proven track record in driving revenue and managing key accounts
* Strong negotiation, presentation, and relationship-building skills
* Technical proficiency in hotel systems (e.g., Delphi, Salesforce, OnQ, Market Planner Survey)

* Excellent communication and leadership skills with a collaborative mindset

At Hilton, we don’t just deliver exceptional experiences for our guests—we build an exceptional workplace for the Team Members who make it all possible. title: Aggregate/Grit/Building Material Field Sales Manager
description:
**Job Description – Field Sales Manager (Grit / Aggregates/Building Material), Delhi NCR**

We are hiring a field Sales Manager to build and grow our B2B customer base for crushed stone grit(aggregates and stone dust) across Delhi NCR, supplied from our manufacturing plant in Alwar, Rajasthan.

**Department:**
Sales & Business Development

**Reporting:**
Director / Head of Sales

**Location:**
Gurugram (field role), with regular visits to the Alwar plant

**Targeted Area:**
Territory Delhi, Gurugram, Faridabad, Noida, Greater Noida, Jewar, Ghaziabad, Sonipat, Rewari, Bhiwadi, Dharuhera and Neemrana

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, permanent

**Experience**
: 4–8 years in B2B sales of construction materials (Travel 70–80% field work; own two-wheeler or car preferred)

**About us and the role**

**MPG Group**
runs a grit manufacturing plant in
**Alwar, Rajasthan**
, producing graded crushed stone
**(6 mm, 10 mm, 20 mm, 40 mm)**
, stone dust and manufactured sand. Our plant sits within 120–160 km of most NCR construction sites, which gives us a delivery-time and freight advantage.

**The Field Sales Manager**
will open new accounts in Delhi NCR, win repeat bulk orders, and make sure every order is delivered, invoiced and paid on time. This is a hunting role first: you will build the market for us, not inherit a ready client list.

**Key responsibilities**

**Business development**

• Identify and map RMC plants, builders, infrastructure contractors and other bulk buyers across the territory.

• Generate leads through site visits, cold calls, references, tender portals and industry networks.

• Meet purchase heads, project managers and site engineers to present our grit grades, quality and delivery terms.

• Convert leads into trial orders, then into rate contracts and repeat monthly supply.

**Pricing and negotiation**

• Prepare quotations on a delivered (FOR site) basis, factoring freight, royalty and GST.

• Negotiate rates, volumes, payment terms and credit limits within approved policy.

• Track competitor rates and supply sources in NCR and report market prices weekly.

**Order and logistics coordination**

• Pass confirmed orders to the plant and dispatch team with grade, quantity, site and delivery schedule.

• Coordinate with transporters so trucks reach site on time, with correct weighbridge slips and e-way bills.

• Resolve customer complaints on quality, quantity or delay within 24–48 hours.

**Collections and account management**

• Own receivables for your accounts and keep outstanding within agreed credit days.

• Do KYC, credit checks and documentation before extending credit to new customers.

• Visit key accounts regularly to protect volumes and grow share of their requirement.

**Reporting**

• Maintain daily visit reports, lead pipeline and order data in CRM or the shared tracker.

• Share monthly sales, collections and market-intelligence reports with management.

**Must have**

• Graduate in any discipline; BBA, MBA (Sales/Marketing) or Diploma/B.Tech in Civil Engineering is a plus.

• 4–8 years of field B2B sales in aggregates, cement, RMC, steel, bricks or other construction materials.

• An existing network of RMC plants, builders or contractors in Delhi NCR.

• Working knowledge of aggregate grades, IS 383 specifications, freight costing, GST, e-way bills and royalty documents.

• Proven record of collecting payments and managing credit risk.

• Fluent Hindi; working English for emails and quotations.

• Comfortable with MS Excel, WhatsApp Business and a CRM or sales tracker.

• Valid driving licence and willingness to travel daily across NCR.

**Good to have**

• Experience with government or PSU tenders (NHAI, DMRC, PWD, CPWD).

• Contacts with transporters and fleet operators on the Alwar–NCR route.

**Personal qualities**

• Self-driven hunter who is comfortable building a market from scratch.

• Strong negotiator who protects margins and payment terms.

• Reliable follow-through on delivery and customer issues.

title: BDE, MSE
description:
**About this role:**
Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust-based relationships with C-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities and uncover opportunities to deliver client-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure and transition of new accounts to the account management team.
  
  
**About Gartner Midsize Enterprise (MSE):**
MSE represents one of Gartner’s largest sales populations across the US, Europe, and Asia-Pacific. This high-growth sales organization acquires and supports our High Tech and End User client accounts with annual revenue targets between $10 million and $1 billion per year.
  
  
**Understanding The Work Environment & Standards Across MSE:**
Gartner MSE operates in a hybrid work environment. This means working virtually and in the office. We have in-office experiences which can be as often as several times each week like 1:1’s with your manager, team meetings, and upskilling sessions. Coming together with colleagues in our Gartner office is a great way to build relationships across the business while collaborating, learning, and growing together.
  
  
At Gartner MSE, our sales associates play a key role in partnering with C-Level executives. We believe a professional appearance and workspace play a big part in building trust and credibility. As such, we maintain a business casual dress code.
  
  
**What you will do:**
Business Development Executives will be given a territory of Midsize Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. Other role highlights include:
  
  

* Build trust-based value-added relationships with C-Level prospects to quickly uncover the mission critical priorities and determine how Gartner can support success.
* Drive high-quality activity to build pipeline with multi-touch prospecting outreach and campaigns.
* Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.
* Conduct calls with C-Level prospects to qualify, showcase capabilities and close the business.
* Partner with internal partners across the business to bring Gartner to life through portal walkthroughs and proof of concepts.
* Transition new accounts to account management to ensure a fast start to new client value.
* Deliver against assigned annual quota for your territory.

**What you will need:**

* 3-4+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.
* Experience selling to and/or influencing C-Level Executives.
* Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.
* Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.
* Willingness to live within a commutable distance to the location required for this role.
* Relocation assistance is available for qualifying candidates.
* Bachelor's degree desired

**What you will get:**

* We'll invest in you. At Gartner, you'll get more than just a job. You'll get everything you need to build an exciting, rewarding career.
* Career growth starts here. Take your growth into your own hands by tapping into individual development plans, mentorships, and career progression opportunities.
* Uncapped earnings potential. Our sellers' success is recognized and rewarded accordingly.
* Comprehensive onboarding. All new hires begin their time at Gartner by going through Expedition, a robust training program to help them succeed.
* Rewards and recognition. Annual "Winners Circle" event, an all-expense paid trip for our top performers each year.
* Consistent quarter over quarter growth. Gartner is purposefully built to adjust, adapt and pivot our strategy when macro-environmental shifts occur.

**Who are we?**
At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
  
  
Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission-critical priorities.
  
  
Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in ~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
  
  
**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
  
  
We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
  
  
Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
  
  
We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
  
  
**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
  
  
It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
  
  
**What do we offer?**
Gartner offers world-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
  
  
In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
  
  
Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

Qualifications & Skills

\* Sales and business development experience, preferably in art, luxury retail, real estate, interior design, or creative industries.

\* Ability to generate leads, pitch services, negotiate effectively, and close sales.

\* Customer service skills and the ability to understand and fulfil client requirements.

\* Experience in lead management, follow-ups, CRM tools, and sales reporting.

\* Ability to identify potential buyers and develop relationships with collectors, architects, interior designers, and corporate clients.

\* Comfortable working with digital platforms, social media, and basic sales tools.

Join Artisthu and help connect exceptional art with the people who will value it.**
