title: Operations & Brand Partnerships Executive (Health | Wellness | K-Beauty | Retail | E-Commerce)
description:
**Company:**
Ivy & Prime

**Location:**
Civil Lines, Delhi NCR

**Employment Type:**
Full-Time | In-Office + Field Operations

**Experience:**
1–3 Years (Entrepreneurial and Startup Experience Preferred)

**Compensation:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month + Performance-Linked Incentives

**About Ivy & Prime**

**Ivy & Prime is a next-generation venture studio and global ecosystem built to engineer the future of health and wellness.**
As a hands-on venture studio, we bring together a powerhouse network of global partners, deep operational expertise, and strategic capital to transform early-stage concepts into market-defining health solutions. By pairing visionary founders with unfair advantages in capital, distribution, and clinical insights, we don’t just back the next big health innovation-we build it from the ground up. We actively co-build alongside our portfolio companies, delivering day-one operational support and built-in commercial distribution to accelerate innovations from inception to enterprise scale.

We have an integrated network of:

**Retailers | Clinics | Distributors | Brand Partners | Founders**

We are creating a platform where brands, professionals, operators, and consumers connect to create sustainable commercial opportunities.

**Role Overview**

We are looking for a highly proactive and
**Entrepreneurial Operations & Brand Partnerships Executive**
to work closely with Ivy & Prime's founding team.

This is a hands-on role combining business operations, international brand onboarding, vendor management, strategic partnerships, retail execution, and business development.

The selected candidate will help coordinate and execute Ivy & Prime's expanding business verticals, particularly K-Beauty retail stores, clinical skincare, wellness partnerships, and e-commerce operations.

You will work with Korean and international brands, distributors, sourcing partners, airport stakeholders, clinic operators, doctors, service providers, and internal teams to convert business opportunities into functioning operations.

This is not a conventional sales, marketing, or administrative position. It requires someone who can manage relationships, coordinate stakeholders, organize operational workflows, solve problems, and take ownership of execution.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Business Development & Commercial Execution**

* Identify business opportunities across retail, e-commerce, clinics, distribution, and founder networks.
* Generate qualified leads, conduct outreach, arrange meetings, and prepare partnership proposals.
* Support commercial negotiations, partnership structures, onboarding agreements, and revenue opportunities.
* Develop business presentations, partner decks, research summaries, and commercial comparisons.

**2. Operations & Retail Store Management**

* Support the setup, launch, and daily management of K-Beauty, skincare, wellness, and specialty retail stores, including airport retail locations.
* Coordinate store infrastructure, vendors, fixtures, merchandising, inventory, staffing, and operational readiness.
* Coordinate with store managers, beauty advisors, suppliers, and external service providers.
* Monitor stock availability, replenishment, product displays, customer feedback, and store performance.

**3. Brand Onboarding & International Partnerships**

* Identify, approach, and onboard Korean, Asian, and international beauty, skincare, health, and wellness brands.
* Manage brand onboarding requirements, including product catalogs, commercial terms, documentation, product information, pricing, and marketing assets.
* Support discussions regarding product selection, inventory arrangements, distribution opportunities, consignment models, and promotional commitments.

**4. Vendor, Sourcing & Strategic Partnerships**

* Identify and develop relationships with relevant vendors, distributors, logistics providers, retail operators, agencies, and business partners.
* Coordinate vendor quotations, commercial proposals, negotiations, agreements, and execution timelines.
* Support sourcing of products, retail fixtures, displays, testers, promotional materials, and operational services.
* Build partnerships with airport operators, specialty retailers, clinics, salons, spas, wellness centers, and professional networks.

**5. Clinic, Healthcare & Wellness Partnerships**

* Identify and coordinate partnerships with dermatologists, aesthetic doctors, cosmetologists, clinics, pharmacies, salons, spas, and wellness professionals.
* Assist with the development of clinic, beauty, and wellness service concepts and pilot locations.
* Coordinate clinical partners, service providers, brands, and operating teams.

**6. E-Commerce, Community & Marketing Coordination**

* Support product listings, marketplace coordination, online brand activation, and e-commerce operational workflows.
* Assist with product launches, sampling programs, brand showcases, community events, and B2B networking activities.
* Maintain engagement with distributors, creators, buyers, professionals, and business communities.
* Coordinate social media and promotional deliverables without making content creation the primary responsibility of the role.

**Ideal Candidate Profile**

We are looking for an execution-oriented professional who enjoys building new business opportunities and can manage multiple stakeholders in a fast-moving startup environment.

**Experience & Professional Background**

* 1–3 years of relevant experience in operations, brand partnerships, business development, retail, e-commerce, vendor management, or startups.
* Prior experience in a Founder’s Office, entrepreneurial venture, or early-stage business is advantageous.
* Ability to communicate with international partners across different time zones.
* Willingness to attend field meetings, visit retail locations, and coordinate with vendors independently.

**Preferred Educational Qualifications**

Bachelor's degree in a relevant discipline. Preferred backgrounds include:

* B.Tech / B.E.
* B.Pharm / Pharmacy
* BBA / MBA
* Healthcare, Life Sciences, Beauty, Retail, or related disciplines
* MBBS / BDS candidates interested in business and operations roles may also apply.

Relevant professional experience and demonstrated execution ability will be considered alongside formal qualifications.

**Compensation & Growth Opportunities**

**Fixed Salary:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month, depending on experience and capabilities.

**Incentives:**
Performance-linked incentives based on brand onboarding, partnership conversions, revenue contribution, and operational milestones.

**Career Growth:**
Opportunity to progress into Brand Partnerships Manager, Retail Operations Manager, Business Operations Manager, or a broader Founder’s Office leadership role as Ivy & Prime expands.

**We are looking for someone who can connect the right partners, coordinate the right resources, and turn business opportunities into operational results.**

**Location:**
Civil Lines, Delhi

**Job Type:**
Full-Time, In-Office

**Salary:**
₹20,000–₹40,000 per month + Incentives

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Supra Craft Packaging is a fast paced growing packaging solutions provider serving a diverse range of industries with custom, high-quality packaging products. The company focuses on innovation, durability, and design to help clients enhance product presentation and protection. The Company leadership emphasizes reliable service, timely delivery, and long-term partnerships with its customers. Team members collaborate closely with clients and internal stakeholders to develop packaging solutions that meet specific functional and branding requirements. The organization values integrity, accountability, and continuous improvement in all aspects of its operations.

This position will be responsible for identifying new business opportunities, building and expanding the company’s presence in key markets; national and international. B2B clients across target industries such as e-commerce, food & beverage, cosmetics, electronics, and retail are to be pursued. The Business Development Manager will collaborate with the operations and design teams to ensure that client requirements are clearly understood and delivered effectively. The role also includes monitoring market trends, competitor activities, and customer feedback to inform sales strategies and support revenue growth.

Qualifications

* Ability to understand packaging products and solutions, with aptitude for explaining technical or design features to clients in clear, practical terms.
* Proficiency in basic office and productivity tools (such as spreadsheets, presentations, and CRM or sales tracking software).
* Excellent communication and presentation skills, with the ability to engage confidently with clients at different organizational levels.
* Demonstrated organizational and time management skills, including the ability to handle multiple opportunities and deadlines simultaneously.
* Previous experience in packaging, manufacturing, printing, or related industries is an advantage.
* Bachelor’s or Masters in Business, Marketing, or a related field is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Willingness to work hard and extend oneself beyond the ordinary will be appreciated.
* It is a 6 day working position with responsibility oriented working hours

We’re on a mission to become the world’s most requested PPE and Safety Wear Brand.

As the Area Sales Manager for India. You will bring your P.P.E and/or workwear experience to sell Portwest products to distributors reporting into the Regional Sales Manager. * Build quality business relationships with new and existing accounts.
* Conduct daily face-to-face sales meetings to maintain and develop relationships with distributors, resellers, and agents.
* Identify existing customers with high growth potential and create a roadmap for their further development.
* Identify new business opportunities and complete sales planning schedule.
* Utilise strategies to win new business on a continuous and consistent basis.
* Engage in consultative selling by identifying customers’ needs and provide a Portwest solution to meet those needs.
* Develop clear and effective written proposals/quotations for current and prospective customers.

* 3–5 years' field sales experience with strong B2B industrial sales experience, preferably in PPE or industrial safety products, with good knowledge of the assigned markets
* Proven track record of sales experience with manufacturers, distributors, resellers, or agents.

* Valid driving licence and willingness to travel extensively throughout the assigned territory as well as to Haryana and Punjab
* Excellent relationship-building, communication and negotiation skills.
* Self-motivated and comfortable managing a field-based territory independently.
* Team player with a collaborative approach to achieving goals.

* Private Irish Business of the year – Export Industry Awards 2025
* Gold Ecovadis Sustainability Rating 2026

title: Strategic Account Executive - India
description:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100\* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.
  
  
The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.
  
  

* Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

As a Strategic Account Executive for our Mumbai territory, you'll drive GitLab's growth across large Banking, Financial Services and Insurance (BFSI) institutions, alongside leading enterprises and conglomerates headquartered in the city. It will be a blended territory of Enterprise and Conglomerates slightly more BFSI heavy. You'll help these organisations adopt, implement, and expand their use of our AI-powered DevSecOps platform, guiding them through modernisation and DevSecOps transformations while building a pipeline that translates into measurable Net ARR and long-term expansion.
  
  
You'll bring an understanding of the software development lifecycle, including continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) automation, secure development practices, and infrastructure modernisation. You'll apply it to the realities of regulated industries, where security, compliance, auditability, and data residency shape every technology decision. You'll connect customer stakeholders with GitLab's field organisation so GitLab is seen as a trusted, long-term partner across the full sales cycle.
  
  
In your first year, you'll be expected to build a strong BFSI and Enterprise portfolio across your territory, create repeatable sales motions aligned to how regulated financial institutions and large enterprises buy and adopt platforms, and consistently forecast and report on deal progress and account health.
  
  
**What You'll Do**

* Lead and grow GitLab's largest and most strategic BFSI, Enterprise, and Conglomerate prospects and customers in Mumbai, focusing on organisations that run mission-critical software delivery at scale
* Drive the full enterprise sales cycle, from prospecting and pipeline generation through qualification, evaluation, negotiation, and close, including the longer procurement, vendor risk, and security review processes typical of regulated financial institutions
* Provide hands-on account leadership throughout the pre- and post-sales process to ensure a smooth customer experience and strong adoption of GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform
* Position GitLab against regulatory and compliance priorities (for example RBI, IRDAI, and SEBI guidelines on IT governance, outsourcing, cyber resilience, and data localisation), working with Solutions Architects and Security specialists on deployment options such as self-managed and GitLab Dedicated
* Partner closely with Sales Development Representatives, Solutions Architects, Customer Success, system integrators, and strategic channel partners to generate qualified opportunities, co-sell, and execute account strategies that drive new business and expansion
* Develop and maintain detailed account plans for priority customers, including opportunity mapping, stakeholder alignment, and multi-threaded engagement across engineering, security, risk and compliance, platform, infrastructure, procurement, and business leaders
* Tailor your approach to each segment: a compliance- and risk-led value story for BFSI, and a modernisation-, productivity-, and consolidation-led story for enterprises and conglomerates with multiple business units
* Coordinate and facilitate the involvement of cross-functional GitLab team members, including sales leadership, marketing, product, legal, and support, to progress opportunities and deliver an excellent customer experience
* Prepare activity and forecast reports, contribute to forecasting and pipeline reviews, and share root cause analysis and lessons learned from wins and losses with account managers, marketing, and technical teams
* Act as the voice of the customer by contributing product ideas to our public issue tracker, and by preparing and delivering customer-facing and internal presentations, quotes, proposals, and formal sales documents that address BFSI and enterprise business challenges and clearly communicate long-term value and outcomes.

**What You'll Bring**

* Deep experience driving complex B2B software sales cycles with large enterprise customers, ideally in DevSecOps, software development tools, or adjacent SaaS and infrastructure solutions that support the software development lifecycle
* A track record selling into BFSI institutions in India, with an understanding of their buying behaviour, long evaluation cycles, vendor risk assessments, and procurement processes (experience across both BFSI and large enterprises or conglomerates is a strong plus)
* Ability to prospect, build pipeline, and close new business while expanding strategic relationships within large accounts across Mumbai
* Strong understanding of modern software delivery, including CI/CD, secure development practices (DevSecOps, supply chain security), and cloud and infrastructure modernisation, with the ability to connect platform capabilities to customer outcomes
* Working familiarity with the regulatory and compliance landscape for Indian financial institutions, including data residency, audit, and security expectations, and comfort discussing on-premises, private cloud, and hybrid deployment models
* Proven ability to navigate and influence complex organisations, building trusted relationships with senior stakeholders such as CIOs, CTOs, CISOs, heads of engineering, and technology risk and compliance leaders
* Experience creating and executing account plans for priority accounts, including opportunity mapping, multi-threaded engagement, and disciplined deal and account management
* Experience working with system integrators and channel partners to co-sell and deliver in the Indian market
* Effective communication and interpersonal skills, including comfort leading customer presentations, negotiations, and executive-level conversations, and coordinating internal resources to move opportunities forward
* Capacity to work autonomously and asynchronously in a fully remote environment while staying aligned to shared goals, processes, and forecasting expectations across the broader GitLab team, with the flexibility to meet customers in person across Mumbai
* Familiarity with forecasting, pipeline hygiene, and reporting, including sharing learnings from wins and losses to improve repeatable sales motions

**Some examples of our projects**

* Building and growing a territory plan for Mumbai that balances large BFSI institutions (banks, NBFCs, insurers, asset managers, payments and fintech) with high-potential enterprises and conglomerates, from new logo prospecting through long-term expansion on GitLab's AI-powered DevSecOps platform
* Leading complex, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and partnering with Solutions Architects, Sales Development, Customer Success, system integrators, and channel partners to position GitLab as a trusted platform for modern software delivery, security, and compliance in regulated and large-scale environments
* Helping BFSI customers consolidate fragmented toolchains and modernise legacy delivery pipelines while meeting regulatory, audit, and data-residency expectations

**About The Team**
The Strategic Account Executive will join our enterprise sales team, which focuses on driving GitLab adoption with large customers in the India market. The team is responsible for the full relationship lifecycle with enterprise accounts, from initial engagement through long-term expansion and advocacy, ensuring customers realize value from GitLab’s DevSecOps platform. Team members work in an all-remote, distributed environment and collaborate asynchronously across time zones with sales leadership, solutions architects, customer success, marketing, and channel partners. The team is currently focused on maintaining and growing our existing footprint in the region, executing a consistent global sales motion while adapting to local customer needs and partnering closely with strategic channel organizations to reach and support key accounts.
  
  
**How GitLab Supports Full-Time Employees**

* Benefits to support your health, finances, and well-being
* Flexible Paid Time Off
* Team Member Resource Groups
* Equity Compensation & Employee Stock Purchase Plan
* Growth and Development Fund
* Parental Leave

Please note that we welcome interest from candidates with varying levels of experience; many successful candidates do not meet every single requirement. Additionally, studies have shown that people from underrepresented groups are less likely to apply to a job unless they meet every single qualification. If you're excited about this role, please apply and allow our recruiters to assess your application.
  
  
**Country Hiring Guidelines:**
GitLab hires new team members in countries around the world. All of our roles are remote, however some roles may carry specific location-based eligibility requirements. Our Talent Acquisition team can help answer any questions about location after starting the recruiting process.

title: Sales Manager

Sales Growth & Business Development

* Develop strategic accounts and create new business opportunities across academic and government research institutes, semiconductor and electronics organizations, advanced materials laboratories, and industrial customers.

Opportunity & Account Management
  
  

* Lead opportunity qualification, value proposition development, demonstrations, commercial proposals, negotiations, and contract closure in collaboration with Product Sales Managers and application specialists.
* Maintain disciplined CRM records, account plans, opportunity stages, visit reports, and reliable monthly forecasts.
* Track market developments, government and private investment programs, competitor activity, pricing trends, and emerging applications, and provide actionable insights to management.

* Monitor public and institutional tenders and coordinate compliant bid submissions.
* Manage technical and commercial documentation with local partners and internal teams.
* Manage distributors, agents, and other channel partners where applicable, including goal setting, opportunity reviews, training, performance management, and compliance.

Cross-Functional Collaboration
  
  

* Partner closely with service, applications, finance, legal, logistics, and factory teams to ensure accurate commitments, successful installations, customer acceptance, and satisfaction.
* Escalate commercial, technical, service, regulatory, or contractual risks promptly and safeguard CAMECA’s business interests throughout the sales and project lifecycle.

Industry Representation & Compliance
  
  

* Represent CAMECA at customer workshops, scientific conferences, trade events, and industry forums across India.
* Conduct business in accordance with CAMECA and AMETEK policies, the Foreign Corrupt Practices Act (FCPA), the UK Bribery Act, applicable Indian laws, and the highest standards of business ethics.
* Demonstrated ability and willingness to use AI tools to improve productivity, decision-making, work quality, and to reduce costs. The successful candidate must be able to identify appropriate AI use cases and critically evaluate AI-generated outputs.

**Requirements**
Education & Experience
  
  

* Master’s degree in Physics, Chemistry, Materials Science, Engineering, or a related scientific discipline.
* A business qualification is an advantage.
* Proven experience selling high-value scientific instruments, semiconductor equipment, analytical systems, or other complex capital equipment in India.
* Proven experience selling microscopy technologies and positioning their applications for scientific research and industrial customers.
* Established network within Indian academic institutions, government research organizations, semiconductor and electronics companies, advanced materials laboratories, or industrial accounts.
* Strong knowledge of consultative selling, key account development, project management, tendering, contract negotiation, and international trade.
* Proven experience applying complex sales methodologies, including Miller Heiman Strategic Selling.
* Practical understanding of Indian institutional and public procurement processes, including tender compliance and the Government e-Marketplace (GeM), where applicable.

Technical & Business Skills
  
  

* Proficiency with CRM systems, Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and ERP systems.
* Strong analytical discipline in pipeline management, forecasting, pricing, margin protection, and competitive intelligence.
* Ability to translate scientific requirements into compelling business value.
* Skilled in navigating complex stakeholder groups, long sales cycles, institutional approvals, and competitive negotiations.

Communication & Leadership Competencies
  
  

* Fluent written and spoken English; proficiency in Hindi and/or another Indian language is an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation, listening, and objection-handling skills with both technical and executive audiences.
* Strong autonomy, ownership, planning, and prioritization skills across a large national territory.
* Collaborative team player with the ability to work effectively across cultures, functions, partners, and international time zones.
* High integrity, sound judgment, resilience, and tact in managing sensitive commercial situations.
* Willingness to travel frequently throughout India and occasionally internationally.

**About The Business Unit**
CAMECA is a world leader in the design and manufacture of scientific instruments for elemental and isotopic microanalysis. CAMECA is a business unit of AMETEK, Inc., with offices located in Paris, France, and Madison, WI. CAMECA is committed to continuously broadening our product offerings and expanding the range of applications each instrument and technique can address through sustained, long-term R&D investments and close collaborations with leading academic research units. Today, our products serve a broad range of laboratory and process control applications in end markets that include semiconductor, nanoscience, environment, geology, nuclear, and material sciences.
  
  
For more information, visit www.ametek.com/ and www.cameca.com/
  
  
**About The Materials Analysis Division**
The Materials Analysis Division is a leader in advanced laboratory and analytical instruments used by academia, government and industry to conduct elemental analysis, nanotechnology and materials research and to perform onsite quality assurance, analysis and inspection. It also is a leader in ultrahigh-speed digital cameras used in defense, automotive, engineering, research and development, broadcasting and entertainment. Headquartered in Wayne, NJ, Materials Analysis is comprised of six business units and employs about 2,500 colleagues around the world and operates major facilities in France, Germany, Denmark, the United States and the United Kingdom.

**Company Description**
Syntec Airflow Systems is a comprehensive provider of HVAC and cleanroom solutions, focused on delivering amenity, freshness, and cleanliness across diverse industries. The company designs and manufactures air handling units, cleanroom equipment, ducting, modular operation theaters, and cleanroom partitions using modern technology and high-quality materials sourced from certified vendors. The organization serves sectors such as healthcare, pharmaceuticals, medical devices, food, agriculture, electronics, and more, and offers integrated services including ventilation, dehumidification, building automation, electrical, fire safety, and video surveillance.

This is a full-time, on-site role based in Gurugram for a Senior Cost Estimator and Sales Engineer for HVAC and Cleanroom Projects. * Ability to communicate technical concepts clearly to clients, work collaboratively with cross-functional teams, and manage multiple bids and deadlines.
* Proficiency with MS Excel and estimation tools, basic CAD drawing understanding, and familiarity with relevant standards (ASHRAE, SMACNA, ISO 14644).

title: Assistant BM - Direct Sales - Delhi
company: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Company Limited
description:
**About The Health Insurance Industry –**
While the current market sees more than 15 non-life players in the private space and 5 exclusive private players in the health insurance space trying to capture a sizable market share, the nationalised service provider (6) remains a strong competitor. In addition to this the business dynamics are such that the overall market on an annual basis which is to the tune of roughly 10,000 Crs sees close to 85 % of the business renewing with the existing service provider itself. This narrows down the opportunity of the fresh business actually being seriously fought in the market to approximately 1500 odd Crs. With the SME and the start-ups being the driving force of Indian economy, the opportunity to cater to these segments is immense and is increasing manifold year on year. The challenge here therefore remains as to how we capture a larger share of the opportunity by developing specific solutions to cater each segment of the business. Also by creating an inexpensive and standardized solution to increase the reach into the pockets of channel partners across the country to harness on their captive business and explore new opportunities with them.
  
  
Market Opportunities – With the advent of medical advancements, lifestyle changes, change in Indian socio-economic scenario and Indian healthcare space, and the insurers are facing challenges to cater to the needs of this diverse clientele. Increasingly Indian customers have started considering health insurance partners as ententions of health advisers. In this scenario it becomes extremely important to understand their psyche and then provide tailored solutions with wellness benefits which would help them meet their end objectives and bring in profitable revenue source for the company.
  
  
**About The Aditya Birla Health Insurance –**
Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited (ABHICL) was incorporated in 2015 as a 51:49 joint venture between Aditya Birla Capital Limited (ABCL) and MMI Strategic Investments (Pty) Ltd. ABHICL commenced its operations in October 2016.
  
  
ABHICL has entered the competitive health insurance market with an aim to expand the category to wider customer segments, beyond the ones that health insurance companies traditionally have marketed to. As the 6 th entrant in a category with well-established players, ABHICL is creating differentiation and equity for itself though the unique business proposition of “Health Insurance for All”, a one of a kind proposition in India at the moment. This is a philosophy that is being built through every single consumer touch point and into every single backend process of the company to ensure a customer’s experience of our proposition is continuous and seamless.
  
  
ABHI’s unique offering to market includes proposition includes -
  
  

* A Comprehensive Incentivized Wellness Program that will attract the young and health conscious and will motivate, guide and reward them to stay healthy
* A Chronic Care Management Program to cater to the unmet needs of a growing Indian population of those suffering from chronic lifestyle conditions like Diabetes, Asthma, High Cholesterol and Hypertension from Day 1
* ABHICL serves as an enabler and influencer of health and healthcare choices that customers make, in addition to being a payer of healthcare expenses. Thus, ABHICL would act like a much needed catalyst to grow the prevalent health insurance landscape in India through product innovations and a wider choice of consumer relevant products.
* ABHICL’s vision has always been digital. The company has been successful in adopting paper-less approach right from identifying to on-boarding to delivering seamless experience of its customers & employees.

**Key Challenges for the role –**

* With a new company – and lower product awareness – there is minimal base to receive references from and therefore number of in-house leads generated is much lesser.
* Competition with 5 existing SAHI companies and also with all other 53 insurance players, because RFB is marketed by all insurance companies (including non SAHI)
* Leads are expensive and therefore it is extremely important to maintain a high lead conversion ratio. It is also therefore also important to develop alternate sources of lead generation to optimize cost.
* The natural market is limited and team-members tend to find it extremely difficult to generate sales after exhausting natural market – leading to high attrition
* Manage attrition and ensure higher vintage via upskilling and proper career planning
* Upskill the recruited workforce and enable them to do concept selling as against hitherto habit of price based selling.
* Soft Insurance Market: Considering the soft insurance market in India, offering solutions to price sensitive clients may turn risky. Such clients may negotiate hard on the unique solution offered which eats away the cos profitability and may opt to place the business with other provider/s. It is extremely important to design and customize the right solution for the right set of clients catering to multiple income segments
* Key Result Areas: Write the key results expected from the job and the supporting actions for each of these key result areas (For a majority of jobs typically there could be 4- 7 key result areas)

**Key Result Areas**
Supporting Actions
  
  
Planning & developing monthly, quarterly & annual business plans & accordingly fixing the business strategy for specified region/s
  
  

* Developing of the monthly, quarterly & annual business plans & identification of short & long term focus areas
* Ensure timely communication and discussion on targets assigned
* Conduct periodic review of the plans to identify gaps and incorporate changes due to prevalent market conditions/business performance

Identify business opportunities through market intelligence & penetrate in underdeveloped market to enhance distribution reach and profitability for the channel
  
  

* Understand market dynamics and offering of other providers
* Gain market intelligence
* Put in place strategies to tap market potential
* Ensure recruitment of advisors in the areas having unexploited potential

* Track every active opportunity and ensure no qualified lead is forgotten.
* Maintain visibility into pipeline stages, conversion performance and lost-sale reasons.

**Business Development**

* Identify suitable local outreach and referral opportunities.
* Support lead engagement at schools, residential communities, events and other approved local activities.
* Develop relationships with prospective customers and relevant community contacts.
* Share market feedback, customer objections and competitor observations with the founders.

* Help build effective calling scripts, qualification questions and follow-up practices.
* Recommend improvements based on real customer conversations.
* Work collaboratively with marketing and programme teams to ensure enquiries are handled promptly and accurately.

**Essential Requirements**

* Currently residing in Gurugram/Gurgaon.
* Available to work full-time from our Gurugram office.
  **No work-from-home or hybrid arrangement.**
* **Demonstrated experience in direct customer-facing sales, preferably B2C.**
* **Evidence of converting enquiries or prospects into paying customers.**
* **Strong verbal communication in Hindi and English.**
* **Ability to handle objections, conduct structured follow-ups and ask for the sale.**

* Qualified customer conversations and consultations.
* Follow-up discipline and CRM accuracy.
* Conversion of suitable prospects into paying customers.

* Ownership, reliability, initiative and professional customer handling.

SkillsNCR is an early-stage, pre-revenue business currently testing and validating its market offerings.

* Customer acquisition and predictable sales conversion are being established.

description:
****About The Role****
**Institutional Sales Manager (Government & Institutional Sales)**
**Company:**
Marut Drones
  
  
**Position:**
Institutional Sales Manager
  
  
**Function:**
Government & Institutional Sales
  
  
**Experience:**
5–10 Years

Zonal Sales Manager
  
  
****About The Role****
Marut Drones is looking for an experienced
**Institutional Sales Manager to drive business with Government Departments, PSUs, Defence Organizations, Police & Law Enforcement Agencies, public institutions and other large institutional customers**
. The primary objective of this role is to identify business opportunities, build strong customer relationships, develop key accounts, manage the sales pipeline and convert opportunities into orders and revenue.
  
  
The candidate should have strong experience in Government or Institutional Sales, preferably in drones, agricultural equipment, defence/security solutions, surveillance systems, technology products or related sectors.
  
  
****Key Responsibilities****
**Institutional Sales & Business Development**

* Identify and develop new business opportunities across Government Departments, PSUs and institutional customers.
* Build and maintain relationships with key decision-makers, government officials, procurement stakeholders and technical teams.
* Understand customer requirements and recommend suitable Marut Drones products and solutions.
* Develop new institutional accounts and expand business from existing customers.
* Conduct regular customer meetings, follow-ups and opportunity reviews.
* Manage opportunities from initial engagement through commercial discussion and order closure.
* Build and maintain a healthy sales pipeline aligned with assigned targets.

**Key Account Management**

* Manage strategic Government and Institutional accounts within the assigned territory.
* Develop account-wise business plans and identify opportunities for repeat orders and account expansion.
* Maintain strong long-term relationships with customers and key stakeholders.
* Act as the primary sales contact for assigned institutional customers.
* Ensure regular engagement with customers throughout the sales and order lifecycle.

**Product Presentations & Demonstrations**

* Conduct product presentations, demonstrations, trials and customer meetings.
* Understand operational requirements and propose appropriate drone solutions.
* Coordinate demonstrations and Proof of Concept activities wherever required.
* Gather customer feedback and communicate relevant requirements internally.
* Work closely with technical and operational teams to address customer requirements.

**Commercial & Opportunity Management**

* Prepare and present commercial proposals in coordination with relevant stakeholders.
* Participate in pricing discussions and commercial negotiations.
* Understand Government procurement processes, GeM and institutional purchasing requirements.
* Coordinate required commercial and procurement-related inputs for opportunities.
* Maintain visibility on opportunity value, expected closure dates and customer decision timelines.

**Order Execution & Collections**

* Coordinate with relevant teams after order confirmation to support smooth execution.
* Maintain regular communication with customers regarding order progress and commitments.
* Follow up for timely invoicing, payment realization and outstanding collections.
* Support resolution of customer issues related to order execution and commercial commitments.

**Market Development**

* Identify emerging applications and business opportunities for drone solutions.
* Track market developments, customer requirements and competitor activities.
* Develop new institutional markets and customer segments.
* Provide regular market and customer feedback to management.
* Identify opportunities to increase Marut Drones' presence within key Government and Institutional accounts.

**CRM & Sales Reporting**

* Maintain accurate customer and opportunity information in CRM.
* Update sales pipeline, expected order values and closure timelines regularly.
* Prepare periodic reports on customer meetings, opportunities, orders and collections.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts and account plans.

****Required Qualifications & Experience****

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Technology or a related discipline.
* MBA/PGDM in Sales, Marketing, or Business Management is preferred.
* 5–10 years of relevant experience in Government Sales, Institutional Sales, B2G Sales or Key Account Management.
* Experience dealing with Government Departments, PSUs, Defence, Police, Law Enforcement Agencies or large institutional customers is preferred.
* Experience in drones, defence/security equipment, surveillance solutions, technology products or related industries will be an advantage.
* Proven experience managing high-value institutional sales opportunities.
* Good understanding of Government procurement processes and platforms such as GeM is preferred.
* Experience managing the complete sales cycle from opportunity identification to order closure and payment realization.

****Key Skills Required****

* Government & Institutional Sales
* B2G Business Development
* Key Account Management
* Customer & Stakeholder Relationship Management
* Sales Pipeline Management
* Opportunity Development & Conversion
* Commercial Negotiation
* Product Presentation & Demonstration
* CRM & Sales Forecasting
* Market Development
* Cross-Functional Coordination
* Communication & Presentation Skills
* Order Closure & Payment Follow-Up

****About Marut Drones****
Marut Dronetech Pvt Ltd is a leading Indian drone technology company focused on developing and deploying advanced unmanned aerial solutions across agriculture, public safety, disaster response, logistics, and environmental restoration. With a strong emphasis on indigenous innovation and real-world problem solving, Marut Drones combines engineering excellence with field-driven insights to create scalable and reliable drone ecosystems.

title: Vice President Enterprise Sales (ID # 906)
description:
**About the Company**

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India’s full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India’s leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

**About the Role**

The role owns the commercial relationship and ensures each account is getting real value from Sarvam’s products, expanding into new use cases, and renewing with conviction. You are the single point of commercial accountability for your book of business. You will work at the intersection of the client, the delivery team (FDSEs, CSEs, CSMs), and Sarvam’s product and GTM leadership. What you learn in the field shapes how the company prioritises product improvements, structures pricing, and designs its post-sales playbooks. If you are someone who combines commercial sharpness with genuine curiosity about how AI products create value for enterprise clients, this role is for you.

**Responsibilities**

* Own the full commercial relationship across a portfolio of Sarvam’s enterprise accounts: renewals, expansion, cross-sell, and net revenue retention
* Build and maintain trusted relationships with key stakeholders across your accounts, from operational teams running Sarvam products daily to CXO-level sponsors
* Drive account expansion by identifying new use cases, business units, and product lines where Sarvam can deliver incremental value
* Lead renewal negotiations end-to-end, including pricing, scope, and contract structuring, in close coordination with GTM leadership
* Run structured account reviews (QBRs, health checks, success plans) that demonstrate measurable business impact and align both sides on next steps
* Use product usage data, delivery metrics, and client feedback to proactively identify health signals, adoption gaps, and churn risk
* Work closely with FDSEs, CSEs, and CSMs to ensure delivery quality remains high and client expectations are met throughout the engagement lifecycle
* Translate client feedback, feature requests, and competitive intelligence back to product teams with enough context and specificity to be actionable
* Contribute to building Sarvam’s post-sales playbook: account segmentation frameworks, expansion motions, health scoring models, and renewal processes

**Qualifications**

* 8-20 years of experience in enterprise sales, account management, customer success, or post-sales roles within B2B SaaS, enterprise technology, or AI/ML products
* Proven track record of owning and exceeding revenue targets

**Required Skills**

* Commercial instinct: you segment your book by expansion potential, keep active expansion conversations going, and build business cases that land with economic buyers
* Ability to hold a technical conversation with an engineering or product team on the client side. You do not need to write code, but you need to understand how APIs, integrations, and AI workflows connect
* Strong communication skills: you can move fluidly between an operational lead, a technical counterpart, and a procurement team within the same account
* Comfort using product data and analytics to drive account decisions rather than relying on gut feel alone
* Experience working in a fast-moving environment where you build process as you go, not inherit it from a mature org

**Preferred Skills**

* Prior experience managing accounts in conversational AI, voice technology, language technology, or document intelligence
* Familiarity with the Indian enterprise buying landscape: procurement cycles, compliance requirements, multi-stakeholder decision-making, and government contracting norms
* Experience working alongside Forward Deployed Engineering, professional services, or delivery teams in a post-sales capacity
* Background in consulting, solutions engineering, or customer success before moving into account management
* Hands-on experience with CRM and customer health tools (Salesforce, HubSpot, Gainsight, or equivalent)

**Pay range and compensation package**

Note: We are looking for people who can own the outcomes described here, not people who match every line of this specification. If this problem excites you and you believe you can do this work, we want to hear from you.

**Equal Opportunity Statement**

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact. Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar. High ownership and high impact, from day one. Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems. You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates. If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.

title: Manager – Business Development & Debt Syndication
description:
**Company:**
Growthally Advisors
  
  
**Job Type:**
Full-Time
  
  
**Experience:**
3–9 Years
  
  
**Department:**
Corporate Finance / Debt Syndication
  
  
**Reporting To:**
Team Leader / Senior Management
  
  
**Role Overview**
Growthally is looking for a highly driven
**Manager – Business Development & Debt Syndication**
to drive client acquisition, deal origination, and revenue generation for its AIF & Credit Fund platform.
  
  
This is a
**front-end, target-driven role with focus on Business Development and Debt Syndication Execution**
. The ideal candidate will be responsible for independently sourcing new clients, building a strong deal pipeline, developing referral networks, and converting funding requirements into successful debt transactions.
  
  
The role requires a strong hunter mindset, established industry relationships, commercial acumen, and the ability to originate and close corporate and SME debt deals, including structured debt, growth capital, and refinancing opportunities.
  
  
**Key Responsibilities**

* Business Development & Client Acquisition
* New Client Acquisition: Independently identify, approach, and onboard corporates, SMEs, business owners, and promoters seeking debt funding, structured credit, growth capital, or refinancing solutions.
* Lead Generation & Deal Origination: Build and maintain a strong pipeline of self-sourced business opportunities through direct outreach, networking, referrals, and market intelligence.
* Promoter & CFO Relationships: Develop and maintain relationships with promoters, CFOs, founders, business owners, family offices, and corporate decision-makers.
* Channel Partner Development: Establish and strengthen referral networks with Chartered Accountants (CAs), consultants, investment bankers, financial advisors, brokers, and other intermediaries.
* Funding Solutions & Pitching: Understand clients’ financial requirements and pitch suitable AIF, Credit Fund, and structured debt solutions based on their funding needs.
* Revenue Generation: Achieve business development targets through successful client acquisition, deal sourcing, transaction closures, and fee generation.
* Market Mapping: Identify potential sectors, companies, and emerging businesses with debt funding requirements aligned with Growthally’s investment strategy.
* Relationship Management: Build long-term client relationships to generate repeat business, referrals, and cross-selling opportunities.
* Networking & Brand Building: Represent Growthally at industry events, CFO forums, business conferences, and networking platforms to strengthen market presence and generate leads.
* Market Intelligence: Track competitor activity, prevailing interest rates, credit market trends, lender appetite, and structured debt opportunities.
* Debt Syndication & Deal Execution
* Initial Deal Assessment: Gather preliminary financial information and assess the client’s funding requirement, business profile, repayment capacity, and broad transaction feasibility.
* Deal Structuring Support: Coordinate with internal credit and investment teams to evaluate suitable debt structures, funding options, and potential transaction terms.
* Documentation & Due Diligence: Coordinate the collection of financial statements, business information, KYC documents, and other necessary documentation from clients.
* Internal Coordination: Act as the primary point of contact between clients and Growthally’s credit, investment, legal, compliance, and operations teams.
* Transaction Progress Monitoring: Follow up on credit evaluation, due diligence, internal approvals, documentation, and other execution milestones to facilitate timely closure.
* Negotiation & Closure Support: Assist in coordinating commercial discussions, term negotiations, and transaction documentation through disbursement or deal closure.
* Compliance & Deal Quality: Ensure that sourced opportunities meet preliminary fund eligibility criteria and adhere to internal processes and applicable compliance requirements.
* Post-Closure Relationship Support: Maintain client engagement after transaction closure to identify additional funding requirements and future business opportunities.

**Key Skills & Competencies**

* Strong business development, sales, and client acquisition capabilities.
* Proven experience in sourcing and converting corporate or SME debt opportunities.
* Good understanding of debt syndication, structured finance, corporate finance, and credit products.
* Strong network among promoters, CFOs, business owners, CAs, consultants, and financial intermediaries.
* Excellent communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship management skills.
* Ability to independently generate leads, develop a pipeline, and achieve revenue targets.
* Commercial awareness and the ability to identify viable funding opportunities.
* Strong coordination and follow-up skills to support debt transaction execution.
* High ownership, self-motivation, resilience, and a performance-driven mindset.

**Educational Qualifications**

* Mandatory: Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Commerce, Economics, Business Administration, or a related discipline.
* Preferred: MBA / PGDM in Finance, Marketing, or Strategy.
* Additional Advantage: CFA or other relevant finance certifications.

**Experience & Ideal Candidate Profile**

* 3–9 years of experience in Business Development, Client Acquisition, Debt Syndication, Corporate Banking, Relationship Management, NBFCs, Investment Banking, or Fintech lending.
* Demonstrated ability to independently source clients and generate a healthy pipeline of corporate and SME funding opportunities.
* Existing relationships with promoters, CFOs, founders, CAs, consultants, and other financial intermediaries will be an advantage.
* Experience in structured debt, private credit, AIFs, credit funds, or corporate lending will be preferred.
* Candidates with a strong sales orientation and a proven track record of revenue generation and deal closures are encouraged to apply.

**Compensation & Incentives**

* Competitive fixed compensation with aggressive performance-linked variable incentives.
* Higher incentives for proprietary deal sourcing, successful transaction closures, AIF / Credit Fund opportunities, and structured debt transactions.
* Quarterly performance reviews based on business generation, pipeline quality, fee generation, and deal closures.
* Opportunities for accelerated career growth based on performance and revenue contribution.

**This role is primarily suited for a business development professional who can independently originate debt transactions and drive revenue, while coordinating with internal teams to facilitate execution and closure.**
**How To Apply**
Interested candidates can share their profile or resume at 07506 236023.

visibility.

title: Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)
description:
**About The Role**
**Grade Level (for internal use):**
10
  
  
**The Role**
The
**Sales Compensation Analyst (Compensation & Payroll Operations)**
is a critical technical and operational position within the global Sales Compensation team.
  
  
**The Team**
You will join the global Sales Compensation team — a high-impact, technically sophisticated group at the operational heart of S&P Global's commercial engine. Spanning time zones and geographies, we combine enterprise system precision with financial rigor to ensure 1,500+ salespeople worldwide are paid accurately and on time, every single cycle. We are a team that values methodical problem-solving, cross-functional collaboration, and an unwavering commitment to scalable, auditable, and compliant operations.
  
  
**Responsibilities And Impact**

* Drive end-to-end commission calculation cycles for 1,500+ global payees across all commercial business units — delivering 100% mathematically precise, on-time payroll files to regional Finance and Payroll teams across the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Administer and configure the enterprise Xactly platform (Incent, Connect & Analytics) — owning crediting rule setup, tiered accelerator matrices, split-crediting algorithms, batch ETL pipeline monitoring, and participant security profiles that directly reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Execute the full payee lifecycle — from configuring new hire profiles and quota ramp models, to implementing mid-period role transitions, LOA credit adjustments, and producing audit-ready departure settlement calculations.
* Build and optimize advanced SQL queries and Python/Alteryx automation scripts to perform high-volume ledger-to-payout reconciliations, pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and root-cause remediation of calculation anomalies before file delivery.
* Lead annual platform readiness activities — authoring UAT test scripts, executing calculation logic change validation, managing plan roll-forwards, and maintaining comprehensive SOPs and runbooks that keep operational cycles repeatable and defensible.
* Serve as the frontline operational liaison to the Central Governance & Compliance team — delivering automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and clear mathematical payout explanations to global sales leaders, managers, and representatives across multiple time zones.

**Key Responsibilities**
**Xactly System Administration & Configuration Management**

* Serve as the core hands-on administrator for Xactly Incent, Xactly Connect, and Xactly Analytics, overseeing rule configurations, crediting logic, participant hierarchies, and payout rate tables.
* Configure and maintain crediting rules, plan logic, tiered accelerator matrices, and split-crediting algorithms inside Xactly to reflect published annual compensation plans.
* Manage batch ETL integrations and data sync pipelines between upstream CRM/data warehouse platforms and Xactly Connect, proactively monitoring API sync jobs and resolving ingestion failures.
* Lead platform readiness for annual plan roll-forwards, plan parameter cutovers, and system testing; author test scripts and perform User Acceptance Testing for calculation logic changes.
* Administer participant security profiles, statement release workflows, and audit tracking within Xactly to ensure strict data privacy and system integrity.

**End-to-End Commission Calculation & Payroll Execution**

* Own and execute the monthly and quarterly commission calculation process across all global commercial business units, ensuring 100% timeliness and mathematical precision.
* Lead high-pressure calculation cycles against strict monthly payroll cutoffs, coordinating data freezes, calculation runs, manual adjustment validations, and final payroll sign-offs.
* Generate, reconcile, and format gross-to-net payroll transmission files, ensuring seamless handoffs to regional Payroll and Finance teams in the US, EMEA, and APAC.
* Perform automated pre-payroll sanity checks, distribution curve analyses, and historical variance spot-checks to catch calculation spikes, zero-payout outliers, and crediting bugs before file delivery.
* Execute calculation reruns, retroactive plan corrections, and adjustment batches within established cutover windows.

**Payee Lifecycle Operational Execution**

* New Hires & Onboarding: Configure new payee profiles in Xactly, assign plan rules, set up draw and guarantee schedules, and apply effective-dated quota ramp models based on start dates.
* Mid-Period Role Changes & Promotions: Implement plan transitions, target prorations, and crediting split adjustments for internal transfers and commercial promotions.
* Leaves of Absence (LOA): Adjust quota relief parameters, freeze crediting timelines, and prorate plan targets according to regional statutory and corporate policy guidelines.
* Departures & Offboarding: Calculate final commission settlements, review trailing pipeline revenues, verify recovery and clawback schedules, and deliver audit-ready exit calculations.
* HRIS-to-Engine Roster Reconciliation: Run scheduled automated reconciliations between Workday/HRIS and Xactly to identify roster deltas, missing employee IDs, and effective-date mismatches before payroll lock.

**Advanced Data Reconciliations, Automation & Quality Assurance**

* Build, maintain, and optimize complex SQL queries to extract, join, and audit high-volume transaction datasets across enterprise databases and calculation engines.
* Develop automated data reconciliation scripts using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or advanced script-based tools to perform automated ledgers-to-payout reconciliations.
* Identify, isolate, and remediate root causes of data anomalies, including duplicate deal bookings, mismatched currency conversions, orphan transactions, and misaligned territory mapping.
* Maintain comprehensive calculation runbooks, process maps, and Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs) to ensure repeatable, documented operational cycles.

**Cross-Functional Collaboration & Governance Liaison**

* Partner with regional Payroll teams to investigate post-payroll discrepancies, off-cycle payment adjustments, and tax or deduction inquiries.
* Collaborate with the global Modeling and Strategic Programs analysts to transition new incentive rules and SPIFF structures into scalable Xactly calculation logic.
* Act as the frontline operational execution partner to the dedicated Central Governance & Compliance team, providing automated calculation logs, approval artifacts, and audit evidence for internal and external reviews.
* Provide clear, step-by-step mathematical explanations to sales managers and representatives regarding payout mechanics, adjustment deductions, and statement reporting.

**Basic Qualifications**

* Experience: 5+ years of technical sales compensation operations, financial systems administration, or payroll calculation experience in a complex, multi-national corporate environment.
* Xactly Platform: Minimum 2 years of hands-on administration and configuration experience with Xactly Incent and Xactly Connect, including crediting rule configuration, plan logic setup, and payout rate table management.
* SQL Proficiency: Demonstrated experience writing complex multi-table JOIN queries, subqueries, indexing, and aggregation scripts to validate high-volume financial transaction datasets.
* Data Automation: Proven experience building automated data validation or reconciliation pipelines using Python (Pandas), Alteryx, or VBA/Power Query in a financial operations context.

**Additional Preferred Qualifications**

* Xactly Certification: Xactly Certified Administrator credential; or equivalent platform certification in Varicent, Anaplan, or SAP Commissions.
* HRIS & CRM: Demonstrated experience using Workday for HRIS roster management and Salesforce for CRM data structures and effective-dating logic in a compensation operations context.
* Advanced Excel: Proven use of dynamic arrays, Power Pivot, nested logic formulas, and complex lookup models for financial reconciliation and compensation modeling.
* Global Payroll Operations: Experience generating, reconciling, and formatting gross-to-net payroll transmission files across multiple regional Finance and Payroll teams.
* Power BI Reporting: Experience reviewing and interpreting Power BI dashboards in a compensation analytics or financial operations environment.
* Audit & Compliance Support: Experience producing calculation logs, change control artifacts, and audit evidence packages for internal or external compliance reviews.
* Stakeholder Communication: Demonstrated ability to communicate complex payout mechanics and calculation adjustments clearly in written and spoken English to international stakeholders across multiple time zones.

title: Paid Media - Account Manager (Meta & Google Ads)
description:
**We’re hiring an Paid Media - Account Manager (Meta & Google) at Neuroid**

Location: Ghitorni, New Delhi

Setup: In-office (4 days WFO)

Type: Full-time

Neuroid is a performance and content agency built for D2C brands - furniture, jewellery, skincare, apparel, F&B - managing ad spend in crores every month. We integrate performance marketing with content and creative, so the ads and the assets behind them are built to work together, not handed across a wall.

We’re hiring an Account Manager to own the relationship side of 8 to 10 D2C accounts. You sit between the founder, the media buyers and the client. The buyers run the ads; you run the account - the numbers, the conversation, the next step, and the renewal. This is not a client-servicing role where you forward emails. If you can’t open Ads Manager and explain why ROAS moved without a buyer in the room, this isn’t for you.

**What you’ll do**

* Weekly performance reviews with every client: what we spent, what it returned, what changes next week, sent before they ask
* The relationship: you are the first call for every account you hold; the founder is the escalation, not the default
* Scope and renewals: track what was promised, flag scope creep, run the renewal conversation 30 days before expiry
* Churn prevention: spot an unhappy account early and fix it with the buyer, not after the client has already decided
* Creative and content coordination: make sure what the buyer needs from the content team is briefed, dated and delivered
* Upsell: know when a client is ready for Google, retention or a creative mandate, and make the case

**Who this is for**

* 2 to 4 years in performance marketing for D2C or ecommerce - ideally a media buyer who now wants to own accounts, or an AM at a performance agency who actually understands the ads
* You know what a healthy D2C P&L looks like: ROAS, CAC, AOV, contribution margin, and why a brand at 2X might be fine and a brand at 4X might not be
* You write clearly, run a meeting without a deck, and are comfortable telling a client something they don’t want to hear
* You’ve managed at least 5 accounts at once and nobody slipped
* Available full-time, in-office at Ghitorni (3rd Floor, 354, 100ft Road, near Ghitorni metro), starting November

**What you get**

* 8 to 10 named accounts from day one, with real authority over how they’re run
* Direct access to the founder, the Head of Ops and the buyers; no layers
* A path to Head of Accounts as the book grows

**How to apply**

Email hr@neuroidmedia.com with the subject “Account Manager”. Tell us in three to five lines about one account you saved or grew, with numbers. No cover letters.

title: Account Manager - Aerospace & Defense
description:

The ideal candidate brings strong domain understanding of Aerospace & Defense programs, experience navigating large and complex organizations, and the ability to collaborate with ecosystem partners to drive long-term business growth.
  
  
This role requires a blend of business development expertise, technical acumen, partner ecosystem management, and executive stakeholder engagement.
  
  
**In This Role, Your Responsibilities Will Be:**

* Own and grow strategic Aerospace & Defense accounts across India
* Drive revenue growth through consultative selling and solution-led engagement
* Develop trusted relationships with government organizations, defense labs, PSUs, private aerospace companies, and ecosystem partners
* Work closely with System Integrators to build scalable go-to-market models and expand business reach
* Identify opportunities across radar, RF & microwave, electronic warfare, avionics, communications, validation, HIL, automated test, and embedded systems
* Collaborate with System Integrators to influence specifications, solution architectures, and large program opportunities
* Lead account planning, pipeline development, forecasting, and executive business reviews
* Coordinate with application engineering, services, partners, and global teams to deliver customer success
* Lead customer presentations, technical discussions, workshops, and commercial negotiations
* Engage technical and leadership stakeholders through workshops, solution presentations, and strategic discussions
* Understand customer roadmaps, procurement cycles, compliance requirements, and program priorities
* Track industry trends, defense modernization initiatives, and competitive activity to shape growth strategies

**Who You Are:**
You are a proactive, strategic problem solver who establishes last relationships and delivers exceptional results. You’re comfortable managing complex accounts and driving account growth at both tactical and strategic levels.
  
  
**For This Role, You Will Need:**

* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering is mandatory (Electronics, Electrical, ECE, Instrumentation, Aerospace, or related disciplines preferred)
* 6–10 years of experience in Aerospace & Defense sales, account management, business development, or technical consulting
* Strong understanding of Aerospace & Defense test, validation, or embedded system workflows
* Proven experience working with or managing System Integrators as business partners
* Ability to build and scale ecosystem-driven business models
* Experience engaging with defense organizations, labs, PSUs, OEMs, or strategic government programs
* Strong communication, commercial negotiation, and executive engagement skills
* Ability to manage long sales cycles and complex stakeholder environments
* Willingness to travel based on business requirements
* Strong ownership mindset and ability to drive strategic growth
* Technical credibility with customer engineering and program teams
* Strong collaboration skills across customers, partners, and internal teams
* Ability to influence complex multi-stakeholder opportunities
* High energy, execution focus, and customer obsession
* Strategic thinker with a bias for action and results

**Preferred Qualifications That Set You Apart:**

* Prior experience with National Instruments / Emerson Test & Measurement solutions will be a strong advantage
* Familiarity with PXI, RF test systems, HIL platforms, modular instrumentation, or automated validation architectures
* Exposure to Aerospace & Defense standards, mission systems, or electronic test systems
* Experience working on large strategic programs through ecosystem and partner-led models
* Knowledge of LabVIEW, TestStand, Python, or automated test software frameworks is an added advantage

**Our Culture & Commitment to You:**
At Emerson, we prioritize a workplace where every employee is valued, respected, and empowered to grow. We foster an environment that encourages innovation, collaboration, and diverse perspectives—because we know that great ideas come from great teams. Our commitment to ongoing career development and growing an inclusive culture ensures you have the support to thrive. Whether through mentorship, training, or leadership opportunities, we invest in your success so you can make a lasting impact. We believe diverse teams, working together are key to driving growth and delivering business results.
  
  
We recognize the importance of employee wellbeing. We prioritize providing competitive benefits plans, a variety of medical insurance plans, Employee Assistance Program, employee resource groups, recognition, and much more. Our culture offers flexible time off plans, including paid parental leave (maternal and paternal), vacation and holiday leave.
  
  
**About Us**
**WHY EMERSON**
**Our Commitment to Our People**

OpenAI’s mission is to build safe artificial general intelligence (AGI) which benefits all of humanity. This long-term undertaking brings the world’s best scientists, engineers, and business professionals into one lab together to accomplish this.
  
  
In pursuit of this mission, our Go To Market (GTM) team is responsible for helping customers learn how to leverage and deploy our highly capable AI products across their business. The team is made of Sales, Solutions, Support, Marketing, and Partnership professionals that work together to create valuable solutions that will help bring AI to as many users as possible.

**In This Role, You'll**

* Partner with solutions and research engineering to build and execute complex customer programs and projects
* Own a revenue target
* Manage revenue forecasts
* Analyze key account metrics to create reports and provide insights to internal and external stakeholders
* Closely monitor the industry landscape (people, competitors, partners, etc.) to contribute to product roadmap and other corporate strategies
* Collaborate with solutions, marketing, communications, business operations, people operations, finance, product management, and engineering
* Support the recruitment and onboarding of other teammates
* Support the development of company culture

* 7+ years selling and renewing platform-as-a-service and/or software-as-a-service
* Designing and executing complex deal strategies
* Supporting the growth of fast-growing, high-performance companies
* Working directly with c-level executives
* Communicating technical concepts to customers and internal stakeholders
* Gathering, distilling, and processing complex market (industry, competitor, customer, prospect) intelligence

* Are customer-centric. You are motivated to deeply understand your customer’s priorities and help them achieve their vision for using our models to improve their products and services. You build strong relationships with executives and professionals across functions and serve as a trusted advisor.
* Have a passion or deep curiosity in artificial intelligence. You embrace the opportunity to help deploy our technology in a way that benefits humanity. You’re excited to educate our customers on AI and how to plan for the future.

title: Business Development Manager
description:
Business Development Manager

**Company:**
Sotase Seatings LLP

**Location:**
Gurgaon / Fatehpur Beri, South Delhi

**Employment Type:**
Full-time, On-site

**Experience:**
3–5 Years

Company Description

Sotase Seatings LLP is a five-year-old, growing company specializing in the design, manufacturing, supply, and installation of seating solutions. Our product portfolio includes cinema chairs, auditorium seating, stadium chairs, school and college furniture, institutional furniture, recliners, and sofas.

We provide customized seating solutions for commercial, institutional, and project-based requirements across India. As a growing business, we offer an entrepreneurial work environment where initiative, accountability, and the ability to build business opportunities are highly valued.

Role Description

We are looking for a proactive, target-oriented Business Development Manager to drive sales growth, generate new business opportunities, and develop long-term client relationships.

The ideal candidate should be comfortable working in a growing company, capable of independently managing the complete sales cycle, and willing to take ownership of business development activities from lead generation to order closure.

This is a hands-on role suited to someone who can lead from the front, work independently with minimal supervision, and adapt to the dynamic requirements of a growing business.

Key Responsibilities

* Generate new business leads through cold calling, networking, email outreach, market research, and client visits.
* Identify and develop business opportunities for auditorium chairs, cinema seating, stadium seating, institutional furniture, recliners, and sofas.
* Build and maintain relationships with architects, interior designers, contractors, consultants, dealers, distributors, corporate clients, and institutions.
* Identify upcoming projects, tender opportunities, and potential customers in relevant markets.
* Manage CRM activities, maintain customer databases, track sales pipelines, and ensure timely follow-ups.
* Prepare quotations, proposals, and commercial offers and follow up to convert enquiries into confirmed orders.
* Conduct client meetings, understand customer requirements, present suitable solutions, and negotiate commercial terms within company guidelines.
* Achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets and contribute to overall business growth.
* Coordinate with design, production, and installation teams to ensure smooth project execution.
* Maintain sales reports, forecasts, customer records, and regular updates on business development activities.

Qualifications & Skills

* 3–5 years of experience in business development, B2B sales, or project sales.
* Strong communication, negotiation, client acquisition, and relationship-management skills.
* Experience in lead generation, CRM management, sales pipeline tracking, and order conversion.
* Ability to independently identify prospective customers and develop new business opportunities.
* Working knowledge of MS Excel, email, CRM tools, and basic sales reporting.
* Ability to manage multiple responsibilities, solve problems, and work with minimal supervision.
* Willingness to travel for client meetings and project visits as required.
* A bachelor's degree in business, marketing, management, or a related field is preferred.

Preferred Industry Experience

Candidates with experience in
**any furniture industry or interior design and interior fit-out sales**
are encouraged to apply.

Relevant backgrounds include office furniture, home furniture, modular furniture, sofas, recliners, commercial furniture, institutional furniture, turnkey interiors, and interior solutions.

Experience in B2B sales, project sales, dealer development, client acquisition, and relationship management will be an added advantage.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* Self-driven, proactive, flexible, and comfortable working in a growing business.
* Willing to take ownership and lead from the front rather than depend entirely on management for direction.
* Capable of handling the complete sales cycle independently, from prospecting and lead generation to negotiations and order closure.
* Comfortable managing multiple responsibilities and adapting to changing business priorities.
* Practical, resourceful, and focused on achieving measurable results.
* Able to communicate directly with management and coordinate effectively with internal teams.
* Comfortable working from either our Gurgaon or Fatehpur Beri, South Delhi office.

Our Work Culture

Sotase Seatings LLP is a growing, entrepreneurial company where initiative, accountability, flexibility, and results matter. We value people who take ownership, work independently, solve problems, and actively contribute to business growth.

We are looking for a hands-on professional who can build business opportunities from the ground up, lead by example, and grow with the company.

* **If you are a self-motivated sales professional who enjoys taking responsibility, developing new markets, and turning opportunities into business, we would like to hear from you.**
