title: National Sales Head
description:
About Qreanova Kitchen Appliances

Qreanova Kitchen Appliances is an emerging premium brand backed by the industrial legacy and manufacturing expertise of the Presco-Mec Group.

With a focus on innovative design, dependable quality, and high performance, Qreanova offers a range of products including chimneys, hobs, and built-in kitchen appliances.

Guided by the vision “A New Perspective on Premium Living,” Qreanova aims to redefine modern kitchen experiences through thoughtful innovation and refined aesthetics. As the brand expands its presence in the premium segment, this is an opportunity to play a pivotal role in shaping its national sales growth and market presence.

Role Overview

We are seeking an accomplished, commercially astute, and growth-oriented National Sales Head to lead Qreanova’s Pan-India sales strategy and execution.

The role will be responsible for driving revenue growth, expanding distribution and channel networks, strengthening dealer and distributor relationships, and building a high-performing national sales organisation aligned with the brand’s premium positioning.

Key Responsibilities

* Develop and execute national sales strategies to achieve revenue, profitability, and market expansion objectives.
* Build and strengthen Pan-India distribution networks across distributors, dealers, retailers, and key accounts.
* Lead, mentor, and drive performance across regional sales managers and field sales teams.
* Expand market presence and strengthen channel partnerships in the premium kitchen appliance segment.
* Drive sales planning, forecasting, budgeting, target setting, and periodic performance reviews.
* Develop strategic relationships with channel partners and key business stakeholders.
* Collaborate with marketing and product teams on product launches, sales campaigns, and brand visibility.
* Analyse market trends, competitor activity, pricing, and emerging business opportunities.
* Establish sales KPIs, monitor execution, and provide strategic performance updates to senior leadership.

Mandatory Candidate Requirements

* 20–25 years of overall sales experience, preferably in consumer durables or related industries.
* Proven Pan-India sales leadership experience is mandatory.
* Demonstrated success in national sales strategy, business growth, and market expansion.
* Extensive expertise in channel sales, distributor and dealer development, and trade management.
* Proven ability to lead regional sales leaders and build high-performing teams.
* Strong commercial acumen with experience in sales forecasting, budgeting, profitability, and market penetration.
* Excellent leadership, negotiation, strategic planning, and stakeholder-management skills.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India.

Preferred industry experience: Kitchen appliances, home appliances, electrical appliances, and related consumer durable categories.

The Opportunity

Join Qreanova at an exciting stage of its growth journey and help shape the next phase of a premium kitchen appliance brand. This role offers the opportunity to build national market reach, strengthen channel partnerships, and contribute meaningfully to the brand’s long-term growth.

How to Apply

Interested professionals who meet the mandatory criteria may share their updated CV/profile directly with me. Further details regarding the opportunity, business vision, and role expectations will be discussed following an initial profile review.

* Know a suitable leader? Referrals and relevant profile recommendations are welcome.

At Zimmer Biomet, we believe in pushing the boundaries of innovation and driving our mission forward. As a global medical technology leader for nearly 100 years, a patient’s mobility is enhanced by a Zimmer Biomet product or technology every 8 seconds.
  
  
As a Zimmer Biomet team member, you will share in our commitment to providing mobility and renewed life to people around the world. To support our talent team, we focus on development opportunities, robust employee resource groups (ERGs), a flexible working environment, location specific competitive total rewards, wellness incentives and a culture of recognition and performance awards. We are committed to creating an environment where every team member feels included, respected, empowered and recognised.
  
  
**Job Summary**
The primary objective of the Zonal Sales Manager ZSM (Capital Equipment) is to ensure achievement of sales objectives by providing excellent service and advice to current customers within an assigned geographic area, whilst also leveraging new and existing business with the aim of growing market share. Additionally, this role acts as a mentor for new Sales Colleagues and Clinical Support Representatives within a designated geographic area. Case support coordination, conversion of new business opportunities and some business analysis are required in this role.
  
  
The role is intended to provide a development pathway for experienced and successful Sales Personnel moving toward a career in sales management.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent within strategic key accounts tertiary care hospitals – Corporate, Stand alone and Government institutes and the incumbent must demonstrate an understanding of B2B and B2G environment. The ZSM is responsible for supporting current business and to actively grow the business by gaining new accounts and increasing Market Share.
  
  
This responsibility involves a significant amount of time spent both enhancing current business and development of future business opportunities.
  
  
The ZSM (Capital Equipment) should possess a strong working knowledge of Zimmer and competitor products. As a pivotal role within the organization, the ZSM acts as a liaison point between the customer and the various internal departments (eg. Marketing, Finance, Operations) whose work impacts or is impacted by field activity.
  
  
As a conduit of information to and from the field, ZSM must also facilitate the flow of information regarding changes in the industry, customer environments, or competitor activity to others within the larger Zimmer organization.
  
  

* Drive sales of Capital Surgical Equipment to hospitals, healthcare institutions, and corporate healthcare groups.
* Develop and manage relationships with key decision-makers, including hospital administrators, procurement teams, biomedical engineers, surgeons, and healthcare professionals.
* Identify new business opportunities and expand the customer base.
* Manage the complete tender lifecycle, including identifying opportunities, preparing documentation, coordinating submissions, participating in bidding processes, and ensuring compliance.
* Handle institutional sales with government hospitals, private hospital chains, medical colleges, defence institutions, and other healthcare organizations.
* Achieve assigned sales targets and revenue objectives.
* Prepare and deliver product presentations, demonstrations, and commercial proposals.
* Coordinate with internal teams for order processing, installation, training, and after-sales support.
* Monitor competitor activities, market trends, pricing, and customer requirements to develop effective sales strategies.
* Maintain accurate sales forecasts, customer records, and pipeline reports using CRM tools.
* Ensure timely collections and maintain healthy customer relationships.

Principal Responsibilities & Duties
  
  
**Support and Review Current Business (40%)**

* Actively contact current and potential customers and attend to resulting customer requests.
* Conduct in-servicing and workshops on products.
* Maintain good relationships with key accounts & seek to continue leverage of existing business relationships.

**Targeting and Conversion of Business (50%)**

* Establish relationships with key decision makers at national level
* Present proposal to decision makers and executive presence to represent Zimmer to CXO level in hospitals
* Responsible for the preparation of quotations for sales query as well as documentation for submission of tenders. To engage in the negotiation of prices in line with the guidelines from management.

**Management Reporting (5%)**

* Completion of reports as required by Business unit director including monthly reports & expenses.
* Prepare ad-hoc reports on an as-required basis.

**Technical Learning and Skill Development (5%)**

* Attendance at relevant workshops and, where required, completion of learning assessment exercises.
* Study relevant clinical articles & data to build knowledge base and provide relevant advice to customers & staff.

***This is not an exhaustive list of duties or functions and may not necessarily comprise all of the "essential functions" for purposes of the ADA.***
Expected Behaviour
  
  
The incumbent will be required to demonstrate behavior in accordance with Zimmer Biomet’s Guiding Principles, as listed below;
  
  
We respect you for your individual contributions and your diverse perspectives. We support your professional growth and provide you with opportunities to share in the company's success.
  
  
Commit to the highest standards of patient safety, quality and integrity.
  
  

* We commit to the highest standards of patient safety and quality in our products and services and to be recognized for world-class integrity and ethical business practices.

Focus our resources in areas where we will make a difference.
  
  

* We focus our resources in areas where we will make the greatest impact for our customers and patients through our collective knowledge of the disease state or market, established infrastructure, relevant engineering expertise and skillsets.

Ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.
  
  

* We innovate to provide value through effective and efficient solutions for customers and improved outcomes for patients to ensure the company's return is equivalent to the value we provide our customers and patients.

Give back to our communities and people in need.
  
  

* We partner with communities where we live and work and support causes and programs that forward our mission for people in need.

**Education/Experience Requirements**
**The successful candidate must possess the following:**

* Qualifications in Business, Commerce, Marketing or Paramedical discipline.
* Qualifications in nursing/pharma/ science or a related discipline or compensating work experience.

**The candidate must have the following level of experience in, or knowledge of:**

* Previous experience in capital equipment sales – Neurology, Capital, Equipment
* Demonstrated sales abilities & a track record of successful selling directly to corporate tertiary care hospital, stand alone tertiary care and tertiary care government institutes

**Expected Areas of Competence**

* Working level of proficiency in English
* B2B and B2G Direct sales
* Product/Technical Knowledge
* Commercial Acumen
* Result Orientation
* Inter-personal and communication skills
* Tenacity

Travel Expectations
  
  
60% of the time
  
  
EOE/M/F/Vet/Disability

title: Specialist, Sales Performance
description:
MongoDB continues to grow incredibly fast. This is the perfect opportunity to have a positive impact at a hyper-growth company. In this high impact role, you will work closely with executives and internal functions including Sales, Sales Operations, Sales Analytics, Deal Desk, Business Systems, Finance and Accounting, and HR to improve and establish processes and systems for our next stage of growth.
  
  
This role sits within a newly created team which will link our sales strategy and our sales commission. This team will be under the global sales commission umbrella, in our Finance and Accounting organization. In this role, you will be responsible to provide analytical analyses and administrative support for compensation programs. Specifically, you will be responsible for contributing to the planning, design and reporting of sales performance metrics, driving the business forward by contributing to improving our sales productivity.
  
  
We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.
  
  
Shift: 2:00 PM – 10:00 PM
  
  
Key Requirements
  
  

* Strong interpersonal skills with a hypothesis-driven mindset, open to feedback in a dynamic business environment
* Excellent communicator, able to simplify complex technical concepts into business terms and KPIs
* Capable of working independently on analytics projects, deriving actionable insights, and coordinating with stakeholders as needed
* Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative field (Economics, Finance, Computer Science, Mathematics, etc.); MBA preferred
* 3–4 years of experience in Consulting, Sales Strategy, or Sales Analytics
* Proficient in SQL and Python with strong spreadsheet skills to analyze large datasets efficiently
* Experience with at least one major BI tool (Tableau, Google Data Studio, Looker)
* Salesforce experience is a plus

**Responsibilities**

* Analyze large datasets and conduct ad-hoc audits to support business programs
* Design, develop, and maintain processes to generate insights into sales KPIs and incentive compensation plans
* Analyze sales performance data, and partner with Sales Operations, Business Operations, and Commissions team to ensure incentives are paid accurately
* Perform periodic audits on sales and develop processes to drive automation efforts
* Develop visibility tools to enhance sales incentives and improve dashboard visualizations
* Maintain collaborations with key business partners within Sales, Finance and HR businesses
* Serve as a sales performance expert, supporting enablement efforts and handling exception cases

**About MongoDB**
MongoDB is built for change, empowering our customers and our people to innovate at the speed of the market. We have redefined the data platform for the AI era, enabling builders to create, transform, and disrupt industries with software. MongoDB’s unified data platform, the most widely available, globally distributed data platform on the market, helps organizations modernize legacy workloads, embrace innovation, and unleash AI. Our cloud-native platform, MongoDB Atlas, is the only globally distributed, multi-cloud data platform and is available across AWS, Google Cloud, and Microsoft Azure.
  
  
With offices worldwide and over 67,000 customers, including AI-native startups and approximately 75% of the Fortune 100, relying on MongoDB for their most important applications, we’re powering the next era of software.
  
  
Our compass at MongoDB is our Leadership Commitment, guiding how and why we make decisions, show up for each other, and win. It’s what makes us MongoDB.
  
  
To drive the personal growth and business impact of our employees, we’re committed to developing a supportive and enriching culture for everyone. From employee affinity groups, to fertility assistance and a generous parental leave policy, we value our employees’ wellbeing and want to support them along every step of their professional and personal journeys. Learn more about what it’s like to work at MongoDB, and help us make an impact on the world!
  
  
MongoDB is committed to providing any necessary accommodations for individuals with disabilities within our application and interview process. To request an accommodation due to a disability, please inform your recruiter.
  
  
MongoDB is an equal opportunities employer.

title: Admissions Counsellor (Remote) – EdTech Sales
description:
**Location:**
Remote, India

**Employment type:**
Full-time

**Proposed Start date:**
Tuesday, 1st December 2026

**Fixed compensation:**
₹35,000 per month

**Performance incentive:**
10% on eligible net admission revenue generated above the monthly performance threshold

**Working Hours:**

* **Monday to Friday:**
  10:30 AM–7:30 PM IST
* **Saturday:**
  11:30 AM–1:30 PM IST

**The Opportunity**

Cambridge Veritas® is looking for experienced
**Senior Admissions Counsellors**
to join our learner engagement and admissions team. This is an opportunity to represent a specialist education brand and guide teachers, trainers and working professionals who are making important decisions about their careers.

You will receive relevant learner enquiries and take ownership of the complete admissions journey—from the first conversation to programme selection, payment and onboarding.

The successful candidate will combine commercial confidence with sound judgement, professional communication and genuine respect for every learner.
**This is not simply a calling role. It is a position of trust, responsibility and measurable impact.**

**About Cambridge Veritas®**

Cambridge Veritas® is a professional education and teacher-development organisation specialising in:

* TESOL and teacher training;
* IELTS trainer development;
* voice and accent training;
* English communication;
* professional certification and career development.

We support teachers, trainers and professionals who want to deepen their expertise, strengthen their confidence and create better career opportunities. Our reputation is built on structured learning, professional standards and meaningful learner outcomes.

As Cambridge Veritas® continues to grow, we are looking for individuals who can represent the organisation with intelligence, warmth and integrity.

**Purpose of the Role**

The purpose of this role is to help suitable learners make informed programme decisions while contributing consistently to Cambridge Veritas® admissions and revenue goals.

You will act as the main point of contact for prospective learners. You will understand their professional background, identify their goals, recommend an appropriate programme and clearly communicate its structure, value and expected outcomes.

You will be accountable for managing each enquiry professionally and progressing suitable candidates towards enrolment.

**What You Will Be Responsible For**

***Learner consultation and admissions***

* Respond promptly to company-provided learner enquiries.
* Conduct structured discovery conversations before presenting a programme.
* Understand each learner’s background, goals, concerns and career aspirations.
* Recommend suitable programmes based on genuine learner needs.
* Explain programme content, certification, outcomes, fees and admission requirements clearly.
* Guide suitable learners from initial enquiry to payment and onboarding.

***Consultative programme sales***

* Communicate with learners through phone, WhatsApp, email and video meetings.
* Present Cambridge Veritas® programmes confidently and accurately.
* Handle concerns relating to fees, time, confidence and career relevance.
* Communicate value without pressure, overselling or misleading discounts.
* Build trust through professional, honest and learner-focused conversations.
* Work towards individual monthly admission and collected-revenue targets.

***Pipeline and follow-up management***

* Follow the agreed calling and follow-up cadence.
* Prioritise new, hot, warm and long-term enquiries effectively.
* Maintain complete and accurate records in Zoho CRM.
* Record discussion notes, objections, follow-up dates and pipeline stages.
* Manage multiple active enquiries without losing momentum.
* Provide regular updates on pipeline activity, conversions and expected revenue.

***Professional standards***

* Represent Cambridge Veritas® with warmth, confidence and professionalism.
* Protect learner trust throughout the admission process.
* Participate in call reviews, coaching and performance discussions.
* Work collaboratively with programme, marketing and learner-support teams.
* Take ownership of learner communication and service quality.

**The Person We Are Looking For**

You are likely to succeed in this role if you:

* enjoy speaking with ambitious learners and working professionals;
* understand how to discover needs before presenting a solution;
* can communicate programme value without becoming aggressive or transactional;
* take personal responsibility for follow-ups and outcomes;
* are commercially aware but also learner-focused;
* are organised, self-directed and comfortable working remotely;
* value professional standards and long-term reputation.

**Essential qualifications and experience**

* **MBA, PGDM or a comparable business qualification**
  relevant to the role.
* **Minimum three years of experience**
  in EdTech admissions, programme sales, B2C inside sales or learner enrolment.
* Proven experience of converting company-provided enquiries into paid admissions.
* Experience of selling education or training programmes priced at
  **₹30,000 or above**
  .
* Excellent written and spoken English.
* Demonstrated ability to build professional relationships with teachers, trainers and working professionals.
* A strong record of meeting or exceeding individual sales, enrolment or revenue targets.
* Experience of managing the full admissions journey from initial enquiry to payment and onboarding.
* A consultative and needs-based approach to selling.
* Strong follow-up and pipeline-management skills across calls, WhatsApp and email.
* Experience using Zoho CRM or a comparable CRM platform.
* Ability to work independently in a remote and performance-focused environment.

**Particularly Relevant Backgrounds**

Experience with professional learning, certification or high-consideration EdTech brands may be especially relevant. Examples include:

* Cuemath
* upGrad
* Great Learning
* Simplilearn
* Intellipaat
* Scaler
* Hero Vired
* Masters’ Union
* PrepLadder
* Itvedant
* BYJU’S
* Unacademy
* other professional education and certification providers

**Relevant product experience may include:**

* professional certifications;
* teacher-development programmes;
* executive education;
* career-transition programmes;
* technology training;
* premium online education;
* high-ticket B2C learning programmes.

**Important Role Clarification**

**This is a company-provided lead counselling and conversion role.**
It is not primarily a role in:

* university application processing;
* overseas education counselling;
* visa or immigration documentation;
* school admissions administration;
* B2B institutional partnerships;
* lead generation without personal closing;
* customer support without revenue ownership;
* general team management without individual admissions responsibility.

Candidates whose experience is mainly in these areas may not be suitable for this position.

**Performance Expectations**

Relevant learner enquiries will be provided. The successful candidate will be expected to manage enquiries independently and begin contributing to admissions shortly after induction.

Performance will be reviewed through:

* net collected admission revenue;
* enquiry-to-enrolment conversion;
* quality and consistency of follow-up;
* CRM accuracy;
* call quality;
* learner experience;
* reliability and professional conduct.

**The fixed compensation is not negotiable. Candidates should apply only if they are comfortable with this structure.**

**Induction and Support**

A structured induction will introduce you to:

* Cambridge Veritas® programmes;
* learner profiles;
* programme outcomes and fees;
* admissions processes;
* common learner concerns;
* Zoho CRM;
* internal reporting and communication standards.

The successful candidate will be expected to learn quickly, take ownership and begin managing enquiries with limited supervision.

**What Cambridge Veritas® Provides**

* Genuine and relevant learner enquiries
* A respected specialist education brand
* Clear programme information and admissions processes
* CRM access and internal support
* Call coaching and performance guidance
* A professional remote-working environment
* Performance-based earning opportunities
* The opportunity to contribute to the growth of an ambitious education organisation

**Selection Process**

1. Application review
2. Stage 1 interview
3. Stage 2 interview
4. Conditional offer + Reference check
5. Final offer

**Join Cambridge Veritas®**

This role is suited to someone who wants more than another sales position. It is for an experienced admissions professional who wants to represent a credible education organisation, guide serious learners and be recognised for both performance and professional standards.

**At Cambridge Veritas®, learner trust matters as much as commercial success.**

title: Field Application Engineer
description:
**Job Summary**
Drives the design chain value proposition by generating the greatest number of design wins in technologies and registrations for customers engaged in product design resulting in growing business. Interface with the engineering departments of customers and suppliers. Performs a variety of product, technical and engineering functions including but not limited to: pre/post sales support, research, design and development.
  
  
**Principal Responsibilities**

* Proactively develops and implements the technical sales account penetration strategy in each market presenting new products and technologies to current and potential customers; develop knowledge to uncover, understand, compare, and contrast the solutions (pre-component selection). Provide valuable participation in supplier/customer design review.
* Good understanding of customer needs relative to product(s), technology, direction, competition, design process and design cycle.
* Identify and develop relationships with all key technical decision makers and influencers in each account.
* Discover design requirements from the system level down to each individual element collaborating with the design, production and/or engineering departments to develop/execute technical strategies that help solve customer design challenges.
* Market supported lines to sales team by driving adoption of advocated solutions, with supplier partners, that meet customer needs and lead to increased design activity, design wins and sales growth.
* Proactively provides general application and product level sales training, proactively align with sales team in securing business. Communicate account calls with suppliers, account managers and/or inside sales.
* Identifies and tracks largest design opportunities from concept to production, utilizing all supplier resources to assure greatest potential for success.
* Creates presentations and other sales tools to enhance technical value and become a "trusted advisor" to both internal and external customers.
* Manages the product from beginning to end which involves communication and in-depth consultation with customers, sales and vendors.
* Research major industry players to be able to communicate to internal and external customers industry trends and directions.
* A thorough understanding of product lifecycles and the ability to design a full solution based on the customers expectation of product performance, lifecycles and total costs.
* Attend internal and external technical training to complete and maintain certification as necessary.
* Other duties as assigned.

**Job Level Specifications**

* Solid understanding of business, financials, products/services, the market, and the needs of assigned accounts. Understands emerging market trends and interdependencies impacting customers; leverages understanding to expand relationships with own customers. May be recognized as an expert in one area.
* Complexity is high (territory/account, products/services, sales or account management process). Requires developed sales expertise across a defined portfolio of products./services/accounts; applies expertise in a complex sales environment.
* Works independently or may lead teams to identify, pursue or manage accounts/opportunities with large size/strategic importance/risk of loss. Acts as a resource for colleagues with less experience; may serve as team lead and help develop colleagues' and customers' understanding. Has autonomy to set and negotiate product/service terms; plans own territory or account approach.
* Collaborates with team and leadership. Has direct contact with clients and decision makers; participates in team sales for major accounts.
* Leads the negotiations on medium-sized, complex accounts; plans own territory or account approach. Works within broad guidelines and policies to develop business with new and existing customers

**Work Experience**

* Minimum experience required is typically 5+ years with bachelor's or equivalent. It's possible for a career salesperson to plateau for many years at this level.

**Education And Certification(s)**

* Bachelors degree or equivalent experience from which comparable knowledge and job skills can be obtained.

**Distinguishing Characteristics**
The above statements are intended to describe the general nature and level of work being performed. They are not intended to be construed as an exhaustive list of all responsibilities, duties, and skills.

• Analyse tender specifications, eligibility requirements and competitive offerings to develop effective bid strategies.

• Participate in pre-bid meetings and technical consultations to advocate for performance-based, technically justified specifications aligned with customer requirements and procurement norms.

D. EPC, System Integrator & Partner Development

• Develop strategic relationships with highway EPC contractors, ATMS integrators, system integrators, consultants and technology partners.

• Identify qualified bidders and establish early engagement for upcoming highway and mobility projects.

• Drive joint business development, opportunity mapping, partner enablement and coordinated tender participation.

• Monitor partner pipelines and ensure effective follow-up and conversion of identified opportunities.

E. Tender Management & Order Closure

• Own the end-to-end sales cycle, from lead generation and qualification to bid submission, commercial negotiations and order closure.

• Coordinate with internal teams to prepare technical and commercial proposals and ensure timely tender submissions.

• Evaluate competition, identify win strategies and manage commercial negotiations while protecting profitability.

• Track tender outcomes, project awards, purchase orders, invoicing and liquidation milestones.

F. Sales Planning & Business Ownership

• Own assigned order booking, revenue, pipeline and collection targets.

• Maintain accurate CRM data, sales forecasts and opportunity updates.

• Conduct regular reviews of pipeline coverage, opportunity progress, expected closure dates and business risks.

• Provide market intelligence on upcoming projects, competitor activity, pricing trends and customer requirements.

• Coordinate with presales, product, engineering, delivery, finance and partner teams to ensure successful business conversion.

3. Qualifications & Experience

• Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, preferably Electronics, Electrical, Computer Science, IT or a related discipline.

• MBA in Sales, Marketing or Business Management is desirable.

• 8–12 years of experience in solution sales, government business development, highway technology, Intelligent Transportation Systems (ITS), ATMS, surveillance or system integration.

• Experience engaging with NHAI, MoRTH, Central Government agencies, highway concessionaires, EPC contractors or ATMS system integrators is highly desirable.

• Strong understanding of government tendering, RFPs, GeM, CPPP and e-procurement processes. • Proven track record of developing opportunities and closing complex, high-value technology deals.

4. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

• Achievement of annual order booking and revenue targets.

• Qualified pipeline generation and coverage across highways, roadways and mobility.

• Number and value of opportunities developed and converted.

• Tender participation, win rate and order conversion.

• Business generated through EPC and system integration partners.

• Forecast accuracy and timely opportunity tracking.

• Deal profitability, collections and compliance with commercial policies.

5. Ideal Candidate Profile

The ideal candidate is a proactive, result-oriented solution-sales professional with a strong understanding of the highway and mobility ecosystem, established relationships with relevant government stakeholders and industry partners, and the ability to develop and close large technology opportunities. The candidate should demonstrate end-to-end ownership of business development, strong commercial acumen and the ability to position differentiated AI-powered surveillance and traffic analytics solutions to build a sustainable business for Videonetics.

**Job Overview**
The Aftermarket Sales Engineer for Power Tools and Industrial Lifting is responsible for maximizing lifecycle value of customer assets through preventive maintenance, OEM spare parts, repairs, refurbishment, modernization, and long-term service agreements. By leveraging Total Cost of Ownership (TCO) principles, the role helps customers improve safety, reliability, and productivity while reducing downtime and overall operating costs, thereby driving sustainable aftermarket growth and recurring revenue for the business.
  
  
**Responsibilities**

* Recommend replacement of wear parts before failure occurs.

* Convert inspection findings into spare parts and service orders.
* Educate customers on the financial benefits of planned maintenance versus breakdown repairs.
* Act as a trusted advisor by helping customers understand lifecycle costs associated with equipment ownership.
* Demonstrate how preventive maintenance can reduce:
* Unplanned downtime
* Emergency repair costs
* Production losses
* Overtime maintenance expenses
* Safety incidents
* Equipment replacement costs

**Develop Business Cases Comparing**

* Preventive maintenance vs. corrective maintenance
* OEM parts vs. non-genuine parts
* Repair vs. replacement decisions
* Planned shutdown maintenance vs. emergency breakdown repairs

**Position Services And Parts As Tools To**

* Extend asset life
* Reduce maintenance expenditure
* Enhance productivity
* Improve equipment availability
* Improve return on asset investment
* Conduct equipment condition assessments and site surveys.
* Perform health checks for lifting equipment and power tools.
* Identify worn-out or safety-critical components.
* Generate inspection reports with maintenance recommendations.
* Develop commercial proposals based on audit findings.
* Support customers in complying with safety and statutory inspection requirements.
* Identify opportunities for equipment refurbishment and rebuild projects.
* Promote overhaul programs to restore equipment performance.
* Recommend repair solutions based on equipment condition.
* Provide customers with cost-benefit analysis of repair versus replacement.
* Coordinate repair activities with service centers and field teams.

**Promote And Secure**

* Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMC)
* Preventive Maintenance Agreements
* Inspection Contracts
* Calibration Services
* Repair and Overhaul Agreements

**Responsibilities Include**

* Contract renewals
* Contract profitability
* Multi-year service agreements
* Expansion of service coverage across customer sites
* Prepare technical and commercial quotations.
* Coordinate with service, operations, procurement, and supply chain teams.
* Ensure competitive pricing while maintaining profitability.
* Negotiate contracts and service agreements.
* Follow up quotations and improve order conversion rates.
* Monitor open opportunities through CRM systems.

**Achieve Targets For**

* Spare parts sales
* Service revenue
* Repair revenue
* AMC revenue
* Refurbishment projects
* Upgrade projects
* Improve aftermarket attachment rates.
* Increase recurring revenue through long-term service agreements.
* Manage profitability and gross margin performance.
* Drive sustainable growth within the installed base.

**Collaborate Closely With**

* Service Engineers
* Service Managers
* Product Specialists
* Supply Chain Teams
* Repair Centers
* Operations Teams
* Sales Teams
* Customer Maintenance Teams
* Map key customer assets and maintenance cycles.
* Develop account-specific aftermarket strategies.
* Identify high-revenue lifecycle opportunities.
* Track competitor activities and market trends.
* Position the company as a lifecycle reliability partner rather than simply a spare parts supplier.

**Requirements**

* Qualitification can be BE in Mechatronics, Mechanical or Electrical, MBA an added advantage
* 5-7 years in handling customers

**Travel & Work Arrangements/Requirements**

* Leave Encashments
* Maternity/Paternity Leaves
* Employee Health covered under Medical, Group Term Life & Accident Insurance
* Employee Assistance Program
* Employee recognition via Awardco
* Collaborative, multicultural work environment with a team of dedicated professionals, fostering innovation and teamwork.

* Continuously improve bid processes to reduce rework, errors, and submission risks.

*Incentives are performance-based and subject to the company's approved incentive policy. ₹1 lakh is an earning potential, not a guaranteed salary.*

**1. Your work actually matters.**

Your conversions directly contribute to business growth. You're not just another employee in a massive organisation.

Build your skills, improve your conversions and unlock higher incentive opportunities.

Strong performers can grow into Senior Sales Executive, Team Leader and Sales Manager roles as the business expands.

Master sales, negotiation, communication, lead management and customer relationship building.

**5. Work close to the founders and decision-makers.**

In a startup, good ideas and great performance can get noticed faster.

**6. Be part of a mission that matters.**

Help students make better-informed education decisions and find opportunities that fit their goals.

Who Can Apply?

* Freshers and experienced candidates are welcome.
* Anyone with a strong interest in sales, calling, persuasion and customer interaction.
* Candidates who are confident speaking with people and comfortable working towards targets.
* People who are competitive, coachable, consistent and hungry to earn.
* Immediate joiners based in or willing to work from Gurgaon.

**No fancy degree or big-company background required. Your attitude, communication and performance matter.**

One Last Thing

If you want a comfortable job where nobody expects much from you, this might not be your place.

But if you're ambitious, love competition, want to earn based on performance and have the courage to prove yourself,
**MatchToCollege wants to meet you.**

You bring the energy. We'll give you the opportunity to perform, learn and grow.

**📩 Ready to prove yourself? Apply now and join the MatchToCollege team.**

*Your next big opportunity could start with one call.*

RK Realtors is a boutique real estate agency in Gurugram, specializing in luxury residential and commercial properties. The company focuses on delivering personalized, high-touch service to clients seeking premium homes and investments in a fast-growing market. RK Realtors is known for its deep local expertise, strong negotiation capabilities, and commitment to client satisfaction. title: Business Development Intern
description:
**We’re hiring: Business Development Intern**

Great with people? Curious about the business behind building brands?

At Izart Studio, we work across brand strategy, visual identity, packaging, website design and development, and content. We help businesses define what they stand for and bring that thinking to life through design and communication.

We’re looking for a confident, articulate, and personable intern to be the first point of contact for potential clients and help turn incoming enquiries into meaningful conversations.

**About the role**

When a lead comes in, you’ll call them promptly, understand what they’re looking for, qualify their requirements using our checklist, and schedule a discovery meeting with our team.

You’ll take ownership of that first interaction and the follow-ups that help a prospect move from expressing interest to attending a meeting.

**What you’ll do**

* Call incoming leads promptly during working hours and introduce them to Izart.
* Understand their business, project requirements, budget, timelines, and decision-making process using our pre-qualification checklist.
* Explain Izart’s services and approach clearly, with guidance from the training we provide.
* Schedule discovery meetings and coordinate calendars between prospects and our team.
* Send meeting confirmations and reminders, follow up with unresponsive leads, and reschedule missed appointments.
* Keep our lead tracker or CRM updated with conversation notes, lead status, and next steps.
* Give the team a clear brief before each meeting so they can take the conversation forward.
* Share recurring questions and feedback to help us improve how we engage with prospective clients.

Your focus will be lead qualification and appointment setting. Our senior team will handle proposals, pricing negotiations, and closing.

**Who we’re looking for**

* Excellent command of English and Hindi, especially in conversation.
* A warm, engaging personality and the confidence to speak with new people.
* Someone who listens carefully, asks thoughtful questions, and can navigate a conversation naturally.
* The ability to build rapport with founders, business owners, and marketing professionals.
* Strong organisation skills and the discipline to follow through on calls, reminders, and commitments.
* Curiosity about branding, design, client acquisition, and the creative agency space.
* A willingness to learn, practise, take feedback, and improve.

**No previous experience required**

We’ll train you on Izart’s services, offerings, SOPs, sales process, and prospect qualification checklist. You don’t need an existing understanding of the creative industry to apply.

Bring strong communication skills, confidence, curiosity, and a willingness to learn.

**What you’ll learn**

* How a creative agency operates and works with clients.
* How businesses approach branding, packaging, websites, and content.
* How to understand a prospect’s needs and assess whether there’s a fit.
* How client acquisition and agency sales processes work.
* How to manage professional conversations, follow-ups, and meeting coordination.

This role is ideal for someone who wants practical exposure to business development, client servicing, or agency operations.

**What success looks like**

Responding quickly, asking the right questions, keeping clear records, following up consistently, and helping qualified prospects attend well-prepared meetings.

If you enjoy connecting with people and want to learn how creative work becomes a business relationship, we’d love to hear from you.

title: Sales Lead
description:
**About the Role**

GoerOne is launching a premium membership ecosystem in Manipur. The Area Manager owns day-to-day sales execution across all three tiers and turns a small team, institutional partnerships and a variable field force into a repeatable sales engine.

This is a hands-on leadership role. You will run daily sales operations, personally close high-value relationships and build the systems that let the team scale without proportional headcount growth. As the business matures, this role can grow into the dedicated Sales Head position.

**Key Responsibilities**

**1. Sales execution and revenue**

* Own paid-membership targets across multiple tiers, with day 30, 60 and 90 milestones.
* Run the daily sales rhythm: the 10-15 minute morning huddle, lead allocation, route planning and EOD review.
* Manage sales funnel (named prospects, qualified, meeting, formal invitation, paid, activated, first benefit used). Support the Business Head on the top 100 prospects and personally manage the next 300 alongside the existing members Relationship Executive.
* Drive sales through invitation journeys, professional and family segments, and referrals.
* Drive volume sales through channels, events and merchant-led acquisition, with automation where possible.

**2. Channel and field sales**

* Build and manage the institutional pipeline (corporates, PSUs, hospitals, colleges, associations, clubs) and run institutional outreach and targeted group sessions.
* Plan and execute sponsored events, activation days and individual outreach campaigns.
* Recruit, train and manage variable promoters on a commission model. Scale from 10-15 to 20-30 only when the economics work.
* Operationalise merchant-led acquisition with the Merchant Partnerships Lead: counter QRs, staff scripts, member days and incentives paid only after paid and activated conversions.

**3. Team leadership**

* Lead Inside Sales on warm-lead follow-up, conversion and first-use prompts.
* Coach the team on the approved sale pitches and on objection handling, and keep scripts and FAQs current.
* Enforce discipline: routes logged before departure, CRM updated, EOD reports submitted and zero tolerance for fake visits or data.

**4. Pipeline and CRM hygiene**

* Ensure every lead has an owner, a next action and a probability, and keep lead ageing within SLA.
* Maintain source-to-payment-to-activation tracking with Marketing, and keep referral attribution accurate.

**5. Cross-functional collaboration**

* **Marketing and Growth:**
  give feedback on lead quality and campaign performance, and align on events and launches.
* **Merchant team:**
  feed back on merchant demand and offer relevance, and coordinate Member Days and co-branded campaigns.
* **Customer Operations and CX:**
  hand over smoothly for activation and onboarding, and resolve conversion and activation blockers together.
* **Business Head:**
  share the sales view of pricing, offers, objections and market response.

**6. Reporting**

* Weekly: sales vs plan, funnel conversion, channel performance, lead ageing and promoter productivity.
* Monthly: revenue and paid memberships vs target, CAC by channel, team productivity and a hiring and promoter review.
* Quarterly: channel economics and recommendations on scaling or stopping.
* Consolidate team inputs into the single Business Head dashboard.

**Key Performance Indicators**

**Performance is judged on business outcomes, not activity.**

**KPI**

**What it measures**

**Paid memberships vs plan**

**Core revenue delivery (by tier)**

**Lead-to-paid conversion**

**Funnel quality and sales effectiveness**

**Sales productivity per person**

**Output per team member and promoter**

**Channel and field performance**

**Returns by institution, event and referral**

**Lead ageing**

**Speed of follow-up**

**Institutional sales**

**Pipeline value and closures**

**Activation and first-use rate**

**Quality of sales, with a target of 85%+ first use within 30 days**

**CAC vs ceiling**

**Cost discipline per channel**

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

* 5-8 years in field sales, business development or channel sales, with at least 1-2 years leading a team.
* Proven results selling a high-involvement, relationship-led product. Examples are premium memberships, financial products, hospitality, real estate, education, healthcare services, insurance or luxury and lifestyle offerings.
* Experience with institutional and B2B2C sales (corporates, associations, communities).
* Strong understanding of the Manipur market, networks and decision-makers. Local relationships are a major advantage.
* Comfortable selling to HNI and senior professionals, and equally able to manage volume sales.
* Fluent in English, Hindi and Meiteilon (other regional languages are a plus).
* Graduate degree required. MBA preferred but not mandatory.

**Skills and Attributes**

* Target-driven, with ownership of numbers and a bias for action.
* Disciplined about CRM and reporting, with a habit of reporting exceptions and outcomes, not essays.
* Credible with senior clients and able to coach junior sellers.
* Able to think in funnels, unit economics and CAC, not just top-line sales.
* Integrity: will not hide a weak proposition behind aggressive selling.
* Comfortable in a lean startup where roles are broad and processes are still being built.
* Working knowledge of CRM tools, WhatsApp-based selling and basic dashboards.

**What We Offer**

* Direct access to the Business Head and strategic decisions.
* A founding-team role in a high-growth launch.
* Performance variable linked to paid, activated memberships.
* A clear growth path as the organisation scales

* **How to Apply:**
  Send your resume to hello@goerone.com

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Business Development Manager**

Artist & Celebrity Bookings | Book My Artist India

**Location:**
New Delhi (office based, with some travel for live events)

**Openings:**
3

**Experience:**
1 to 2 years in sales, business development or events

**Fixed Pay:**
₹20,000 to ₹25,000 per month

**Incentives:**
On every booking you close, so the more you close, the more you take home

**A little about us**

Book My Artist India (BMAI) helps people book the artists, singers, performers and celebrities who make an event unforgettable. Our clients range from companies planning their annual day to families planning a wedding, college fest committees, brands launching something new, and hosts of private celebrations across India.

We are a small, driven team, and we are growing. We are now looking for three people who enjoy talking to people, love a good deal, and would like to build a career in the live entertainment space.

**What your day will look like**

•     
**Talking to people who want to book an artist.**
You will call new inquiries quickly, understand their event (date, city, crowd, budget) and suggest the artist who fits best.

•     
**Finding new clients.**
You will reach out to HR teams, corporate event teams, wedding planners, event agencies and college fest committees over calls and WhatsApp.

•     
**Pitching and closing.**
You will share artist profiles, videos and quotes, handle questions about pricing, and see the deal through to confirmation.

•     
**Working with artists and their managers.**
You will check availability, agree on commercials, and sort out travel and technical needs.

•     
**Keeping things organised.**
You will update every call, follow-up and booking in our CRM so nothing falls through the cracks.

•     
**Being there on show day.**
Now and then, you will travel to events to make sure everything runs smoothly for both the client and the artist.

**Your first few months with us**

•     
**In your first month,**
you will get to know our artists, pricing and pitch, and start handling inquiries on your own.

•     
**By your third month,**
you will be closing bookings regularly, meeting your monthly targets, and building your own network of corporate and planner contacts who come back to you.

**You will fit right in if you**

•     Speak English and Hindi comfortably and confidently, since most of your day is spent on calls

•     Have 1 to 2 years of experience in a target based role such as inside sales, B2B sales, events, hospitality, media or ad sales

•     Actually enjoy being on the phone and talking to new people every day

•     Follow up without needing a reminder, and don't get discouraged by a “no”

•     Can speak just as easily with a senior corporate leader as with an artist's manager

•     Have used a CRM like Zoho or HubSpot (nice to have, not a must)

**A quick heads up before you apply**

We want this to be a good fit for you too, so here is what the job honestly involves:

•     Events often happen on evenings and weekends, so your schedule will sometimes need to flex

•     A good part of your day will go into calling people who have not heard of us yet

•     There are monthly targets, and your incentives are tied to them

If that sounds exciting rather than stressful, we would really like to hear from you.

**What you get in return**

•     
**Earnings that grow with you.**
Incentives on every booking you close, with no cap for top performers.

•     
**A seat inside the entertainment world.**
You will work directly with artists, celebrities, their managers and some of India's biggest event buyers.

•     
**Real responsibility early on.**
You will own your clients from day one, with a clear path to senior business development and key account roles.

•     
**Skills that stay with you.**
Event sales, negotiation and artist pricing are things very few people get to learn this closely.

**Ready to apply?**

We read every application ourselves. To help yours stand out, please send:

1.   Your resume to
**Yogesh@bookmyartistindia.com**

2.   With the subject line
**BDM Application | Your Name | Current City**

3.   
**A short voice note or video (about 60 seconds)**
where you pitch a live singer of your choice to an HR head planning an annual day for 500 employees. It doesn't need to be polished. We just want to hear how you sell.

* *Applications that include the voice note will be reviewed first.*

****Administration****

* Prepares and ensures all Events Orders are distributed to concerned department in a timely manner.

****Leadership Profile:****
Hyatt’s Leadership Profile clarifies what is expected of Hyatt’s leaders and the specific behaviors that successful leaders exhibit to achieve business results.
  
  
Be familiar with Hyatt’s Leadership Profile as the expectation and measure of your performance. Additionally, exhibiting these behaviors will help you hire, develop, evaluate and reward talent successfully.
  
  
**Learn & Grow**
Leaders are quick and curious. They are more likely than others to be energized by the challenge of the unfamiliar, to quickly understand new or complex situations and data, and to share that learning with others. They are also likely to be more open to feedback, to reflect and learn from experiences, and to recover quickly from setbacks. They probably also have a higher risk tolerance and greater resilience to recover from mistakes or failures than many of their peers. These behaviors and personal qualities are an adsvantage in becoming more effective as a leader over time.
  
  
**Foster a Culture of Care**
Leaders build trust through listening first, acting ethically and with integrity. They truly care about others and demonstrate that as they display empathy, create an inclusive environment, encourage diverse viewpoints, and recognize and reward excellence. They assume responsibility for the customer experience, prioritize stakeholder needs, and ensure colleagues have the resources and support they need to demonstrate to customers that we really care.
  
  
**Adapt and Thrive with Change**
Leaders look ahead and make needed changes happen. They are comfortable adapting or transforming existing processes or directions to customer needs, and are more proactive in identifying and removing barriers to change and engaging key internal stakeholders. They also tend to be aware of the broader business climate, able to connect trends in the external world to changes needed internally, and more likely to sponsor or coach teams driving change.
  
  
**Achieve Results**
Leaders are action-oriented, understand how to effectively work through others, and are undeterred by challenges. They move quickly to address issues and tend to be comfortable making decisions even when the right answer isn’t totally clear. They are more likely to set clear expectations for colleagues on their team, hold their team to higher performance standards, and give direct feedback. At the same time, they tend to provide support to their team in order to achieve the goals—communicating, coaching and developing, helping them connect their individual work to a greater goal, and entrusting them to act. They are also more likely to see the bigger picture, think longer-term about their team’s talent needs, and to take a longer-term view of results that count.

title: Rxxxx - Sales Manager - North India
description:
**Department: Audiology & Hearing Care Channels**

**1. Job Purpose**

The Sales Manager (SM) drives revenue growth by managing and expanding business with mid-to-high potential hearing aid dealers, independent audiology practices, and regional retail clinics. This role focuses on increasing share-of-wallet within an assigned territory, ensuring high product adoption, and delivering localized sales strategies.

The SSM operates with a focused regional revenue target tailored to premium account management, which is structurally distinct from the macro-level enterprise targets managed by our Business Development Managers (BDMs).

**2. Core Role Demarcation (SSM vs. BDM)**

To maintain structural clarity across our sales vertical, this position is differentiated from the Business Development Manager (BDM) role across three primary pillars:

* **Portfolio Scope:**
  The SSM manages and nurtures existing mid-to-high tier retail dealers. The BDM focuses strictly on untapped corporate chains, hospital networks, and government tenders.
* **Revenue Scale:**
  The SSM target is scaled to regional dealer capacity, sitting structurally lower than national or macro-level BDM revenue targets.
* **Sales Cycle:**
  The SSM handles high-frequency, relationship-driven monthly sales and restocking cycles. The BDM handles long-cycle institutional contract acquisitions.

**3. Key Responsibilities**

**Account Management & Growth**

* **Portfolio Ownership:**
  Cultivate and expand a dedicated portfolio of mid-to-high potential hearing care professionals (HCPs) and independent dealers.
* **Market Share Expansion:**
  Increase product mix and "share of wallet" within accounts currently sourcing from multiple hearing aid manufacturers.
* **Relationship Cultivation:**
  Build deep, consultative partnerships with audiologists, clinic owners, and ENT specialists.

**Sales Execution & Revenue**

* **Revenue Generation:**
  Consistently achieve assigned quarterly and annual sales volume and revenue targets for the specific territory.
* **Commercial Negotiation:**
  Manage commercial terms, discount structures, and volume rebates within pre-approved regional parameters.
* **Promotional Execution:**
  Design and implement hyper-local marketing campaigns, dispensing days, and consumer pull-actions with retail partners.

**Enablement & Market Intelligence**

* **Training Coordination:**
  Partner with internal Audiology Trainers to upskill dealer staff on new software, chip platforms, and fitting rationale.
* **Competitor Intelligence:**
  Monitor competitor pricing, product launch cycles, and dealer incentives to proactively protect market share.

**4. Requirements & Qualifications**

**Experience & Education**

* **Experience:**
  2-3 years of proven B2B sales experience specifically within the hearing aid industry, medical devices, or optical retail.
* **Industry Track Record:**
  Demonstrated success selling to independent audiologists, retail dispensers, or hearing care networks.
* **Education:**
  Bachelor’s degree in business, Marketing, or a related field.
* **Locations**
  : Noida, Gaziabad, Aligarh, Agra, Bareilly and Meerut

**Skills & Competencies**

* **Sales Methodology:**
  Strong relationship builder utilizing a consultative, value-based selling approach rather than transactional sales.
* **Technical Familiarity:**
  Basic understanding of hearing aid fitting concepts and technology platforms.
* **Tools & Planning:**
  Proficiency in territory planning and CRM software usage (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot).
* **Mobility:**
  Willingness to travel up to 50–60% within the assigned territory to maintain high-frequency, face-to-face contact with dealers.

description:

6.
**Objection Handling & Negotiation**

* Anticipate and address concerns about AI adoption, data security, ROI, and implementation challenges.
* Be skilled in pricing and contract negotiations while demonstrating flexibility.
* Handle procurement hurdles and compliance concerns effectively.

**Lead Generation & Pipeline Management**

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Key purpose of the role**
CISS is Redington's IT services business. It delivers deployment, implementation, professional and managed services across Cybersecurity, Software, IDCS (Integrated Data Centre Solutions), Server & Storage, Cisco and Networking. We sell these services through Redington's channel partners, alongside every product deal we distribute.
  
  
We are looking for a driven Business Development Manager to grow CISS services revenue in their region. The role builds a qualified services funnel, works with Redington's sales teams (ASMs) to turn product conversations into services opportunities, and takes those opportunities through to order and billing.
  
  
The ideal candidate has sold IT services or solutions in IT distribution, an OEM, a system integrator or the channel partner ecosystem. They understand that services are sold differently from boxes: by scope, outcome and delivery, not by price list.
  
  
**Key responsibilities**
**Build the services funnel**

* Identify and qualify services opportunities across Cybersecurity, Software, IDCS, Server & Storage, Cisco and Networking: deployment, implementation, migration, professional services, training and managed services, including SOC (security operations).
* Work with ASMs on their partner accounts to generate services leads from product deals, so that services are proposed with the hardware or software, not after it.
* Engage channel partners and system integrators to position Redington as their services delivery arm, and activate new partners for services.
* Turn OEM-generated and large-account leads into services opportunities.

**Take opportunities to closure**

* Qualify every lead on customer, need, timeline and size, and take it through to proposal, order and billing.
* Work with practice leads, presales and delivery teams to scope services, build the bill of quantities and statement of work, and prepare proposals and commercials.
* Run joint customer calls with partners and ASMs, and handle negotiation through to purchase order.
* Track every order in hand through delivery so that it converts into billing on time.

**Enable the sales teams and partners**

* Brief ASMs and partners on the CISS portfolio and how to pitch services, using the practice playbooks.
* Support partner enablement sessions, webinars and partner round tables in the region.

**Run the business with discipline**

* Keep the funnel accurate and current in RediCRM: every lead tagged with customer, branch, practice and stage.
* Publish weekly funnel and forecast updates. Track win/loss and record a reason for every loss.
* Monitor the market, competitor services offerings and partner needs to spot new opportunities.

**How Success Is Measured**

* Qualified services funnel built, and its conversion to orders
* Services revenue billed against target
* Partners activated for services, and leads generated with ASMs
* Services attach on product deals in the region
* Funnel hygiene and forecast accuracy in RediCRM

**Preferred Candidate Profile**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Information Technology, Business Administration, Commerce or a related field. An MBA is an advantage.
* 2–6 years of B2B sales or business development in the IT industry, with at least 2 years selling IT services or solutions.
* Experience in IT distribution, an OEM, a system integrator or a managed services provider is preferred.
* Exposure to one or more of these areas:
* Cybersecurity services (SOC, managed security, implementations)
* Data centre, server and storage deployment and migration(Dell, HPE, Lenovo & others)
* Networking services (Cisco, Juniper, HPE Aruba and others)
* Software, platform and AI services(IBM, Redhat, Oracle )
* Managed services and IT outsourcing
* Understanding of how services are scoped, priced and delivered: SOW, BOQ, time and material versus fixed price, and recurring revenue.
* Good grasp of the channel ecosystem and how to win partners' trust as a delivery partner.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation and relationship skills.
* Comfortable working across sales, presales, practice and delivery teams without direct authority over them.
* Target-driven, organised, and disciplined with CRM and reporting.
* Willing to travel for partner and customer meetings within the region.

  Present value clearly, address concerns about pricing and scope, ask for the sale and close within approved commercial terms.
* **Ensure proposal accuracy:**
  Check figures, inclusions, exclusions and payment terms. Obtain approval and document any discounts, exceptions or additional commitments before promising them.
  Prior knowledge of estimation in interior fit-outs is necessary.
* **Maintain CRM discipline:**
  Record client interactions, objections, decisions and commitments on the same working day, with clear next actions and follow-up dates.
* **Deliver complete handovers:**
  Provide the project designer with the client brief, approved scope, payment status and all sales-stage commitments.
* **Own client relationships:**
  Handle concerns and difficult conversations professionally, coordinate with designers and project managers, and follow through to resolution.
* **Grow referrals and repeat business:**
  Nurture client relationships, actively seek introductions and convert them into new opportunities.

What We’re Looking For

* A
  **graduate in Interior Design, Architecture**
  or related streams
  is mandatory.
* **3–4 years of target-driven sales or business-development experience**
  , with evidence of achieving targets and independently closing business.
* Excellent
  **PowerPoint skills, with the ability to create visually compelling sales pitch**
  presentations and skilld to prepare
  **accurate, detailed interior project estimates,**
  are a must.
* A past experience in
  **interior design sales, luxury residential real estate, premium furniture, modular kitchens, luxury retail or related high-value lifestyle products and services is a must.**
* Proven ability in
  **high-value B2C consultative selling**
  —understanding discerning clients, presenting tailored solutions and managing considered purchase decisions.
* Experience generating business independently through prospecting, referrals, networking or collaborations.
* Strong negotiation and objection-handling skills, with the confidence to ask for a decision and handle rejection constructively.
* Excellent verbal and written communication, numerical accuracy and disciplined CRM usage.
* Ability to manage multiple opportunities and coordinate effectively with clients, designers and project managers.
* High ownership: you follow through without repeated reminders and take responsibility for difficult conversations.
* Willingness to independently drive initial client site visits and business-development meetings.

**An interior design qualification or relevant interiors industry experience is mandatory.**
Candidates from luxury or real estate sales should demonstrate an aptitude for learning materials, finishes, scope and budget considerations.

What Success Looks Like

* Consistently achieving agreed revenue, booking, conversion and initial collection targets.
* Building a healthy pipeline that includes self-generated opportunities.
* Generating referrals, repeat business and qualified leads through collaborations.
* Maintaining timely follow-ups, accurate records and realistic client commitments.
* Ensuring smooth project handovers and dependable resolution of client concerns.

title: Account Executive
description:
About Us

The Work In Progress (WIP) is an integrated communication and branding agency focused on building brands that create impact. We partner with businesses across industries to craft communication strategies, campaigns, and experiences that drive growth, engagement, and long-term brand value.

At WIP, we believe great communication is built on strategy, creativity, culture, and execution. From brand building and digital communication to campaign management and storytelling, we help organisations evolve into meaningful and memorable brands.

Role Description

The Account Executive – Social Media is a full-time, on-site role based in Delhi, India. This role is responsible for managing social media accounts for multiple clients, including planning and executing campaigns, creating and briefing content, and coordinating with design and copy teams. The Account Executive will monitor performance metrics, optimise content and posting strategies, and prepare regular reports and insights for clients. Daily tasks include client communication, managing approvals, ensuring timely delivery of posts and campaigns, and staying updated on platform trends and best practices. The role also involves collaborating with internal stakeholders to maintain brand consistency and support integrated communication initiatives.

Qualifications

* Strong social media management skills across major platforms (e.g., Instagram, Facebook, LinkedIn, X), including content planning and scheduling.
* Experience in client servicing or account management within advertising, digital, or communication agencies.
* Ability to analyse social media performance data, prepare reports, and derive actionable insights.
* Solid communication and presentation skills for managing client expectations and internal coordination.
* Understanding of brand building, audience targeting, and integrated marketing communication.
* Demonstrated ability to manage multiple projects, prioritise tasks, and meet deadlines in a fast-paced environment.
* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Communications, Media, Business, or a related field; agency experience is preferred.
* Understanding of Meta Ads and its metrics

Why Join WIP?

* Opportunity to work with growing and established brands across industries
* Fast-paced and creatively driven work environment
* Exposure to strategy, branding, digital campaigns, and content production
* A culture that values ownership, creativity, and ideas
* Space to grow professionally while contributing meaningfully to impactful projects

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Company Description**
Hudle is India’s largest sports community platform, enabling more than 2 million players across 110+ cities to play regularly, join communities, and make sport part of everyday life. The platform has grown from simplifying sports venue discovery and booking into a full ecosystem that powers how India plays, connects, and experiences sport. Hudle connects 4,000+ venues and 40+ sports with community-led play, events and tournaments, coaching, and curated player experiences. The company also focuses on content, highlights, and stories that extend beyond the game, reflecting sport as a social ritual and lifestyle. Hudle is a Series A-funded startup backed by leading investors including Sky Impact Capital, Physis Capital, Inflection Point Ventures, and Survam Partners.

**Experience: 3 -6 Years**

**About Hudle:**

At Hudle, work is literally Play! We are a sports tech company on a mission to enable 100 million Indians to play active sports as a way of life through a combination of cutting-edge technology and on-ground expertise.

We are a fast-growing platform with Indian cricket legend Ajinkya Rahane as a brand ambassador.

**About the Role:**

You will own Hudle's business development outcomes for Mumbai. That means hitting the city's partner acquisition and revenue targets, making sure every new venue is onboarded well and starts generating bookings, and building long-term relationships with the city's most important partners. You'll run the full sales cycle yourself on key deals while coaching a small team to do the same.

**What You'll Own:-**

**Mumbai targets and pipeline**

- Deliver monthly and quarterly targets for partner acquisition and venue activation for the region

- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline through market mapping, outbound outreach, referrals and on-ground prospecting

- Personally lead high-value and strategic deals, including multi-venue operators, premium clubs, institutions and real estate developers

**Onboarding and activation**

- Drive end-to-end onboarding of new partners: commercials, agreements, listing setup, pricing and inventory, and handover to Partner Growth

- Make sure onboarded venues go live quickly and start receiving bookings, and fix whatever stands in the way

- Coordinate with internal teams (Partner Growth, Product, Ops, Hudle Vision) for smooth launches

**Key relationships**

- Own relationships with Mumbai's top partners and decision-makers, serving as their senior point of contact

- Find opportunities to deepen partnerships: additional courts or sports, exclusive listings, premium products such as Hudle Vision, and co-marketing

- Stay close to the local market: new venues, competitor activity, pricing trends and emerging sports

**Team leadership**

- Coach and manage 1–2 BD Executives, including setting targets, doing joint field visits and running regular pipeline reviews

- Build repeatable playbooks for prospecting, pitching and closing in the Mumbai market

**Process and reporting**

- Keep Zoho CRM accurate and current for yourself and your team

- Share weekly and monthly progress reports with leadership, covering pipeline health, closures, activation and forecasts

- Suggest improvements to sales processes, pitch materials and commercial structures

**How Success Is Measured**

- New venues and courts onboarded against target

- Time from signing to first booking, and early booking volume of new partners

- Team productivity and target achievement

- CRM hygiene and forecast accuracy

**What We're Looking For**

- 4–7 years in B2B sales or business development, with at least 1 year leading or mentoring others.

- ⁠Experience in marketplaces, SaaS, sports, fitness, hospitality or real estate is a plus.

- A strong network in Mumbai, or the ability to build one quickly

- A track record of owning and hitting targets in a field-sales role

- Comfort selling to very different people, from tech-savvy founders and club committees to traditional, first-time business owners

- Excellent communication in English and Hindi. Marathi is a strong plus.

- Confident at running app demos, building presentations and negotiating commercials

- Organised and data-driven, comfortable with CRMs, Google Sheets and Excel

- Resilient, self-driven and at ease in a fast-moving startup

- A genuine interest in sports is a bonus

**Benefits:**

* Start-up environment with plenty of learning and growth opportunities
* Great exposure as the candidate will be working closely with the senior management
* Employee-first culture
* Market Salary
* Potential ESOPs in future
