title: Business Development Manager - Electronics
description:
About BRITONE

BRITONE is an Indian electronics brand with a presence in the audio products category, including speakers, woofers, subwoofers and tweeters.

We are focused on expanding our national distribution network, strengthening our product portfolio and building a scalable, profitable electronics business.

We are looking for a commercially minded, entrepreneurial professional who can contribute across business development, product planning and sourcing. This is an opportunity to work closely with the Director and participate in important decisions that shape the company's growth.

Role Overview

The Business Development Manager will be responsible for expanding BRITONE's dealer and distributor network across India while working closely with the Director on product selection, new product development, supplier identification, sourcing strategy, pricing and market positioning.

The ideal candidate will combine strong offline channel-sales experience with commercial understanding of consumer electronics products and the ability to identify market opportunities, evaluate suppliers and build a competitive product portfolio.

This is a hands-on role in a growing business, requiring ownership, initiative, market understanding and the ability to work across functions.

Key Responsibilities1. Business Development and National Distribution

* Develop and execute a pan-India dealer and distributor expansion strategy.
* Identify, evaluate and appoint distributors, wholesalers and dealers in priority markets.
* Build relationships with channel partners and develop a pipeline of new business opportunities.
* Develop territory-wise sales plans and achieve agreed revenue and gross-profit targets.
* Increase product penetration, repeat orders and sales productivity across the distribution network.
* Analyse competitor activity, channel margins, market pricing and customer requirements.
* Monitor primary sales, secondary sales, stock movement and channel-partner performance.
* Develop strategies to improve BRITONE's market presence and competitiveness.

2. Product Strategy and Portfolio Development

* Work closely with the Director to identify new product categories and expansion opportunities.
* Research market demand, emerging trends, competitor products, price points and customer preferences.
* Gather structured feedback from dealers, distributors, retailers and end customers.
* Identify product gaps and opportunities within BRITONE's existing and potential categories.
* Evaluate product concepts based on market potential, expected selling price, landed cost, gross margin and competitive differentiation.
* Recommend new products, product variants, features and specifications that meet market requirements.
* Help prioritise product launches based on commercial viability, sourcing feasibility and channel demand.
* Monitor product performance after launch and recommend improvements or discontinuation where appropriate.

3. Sourcing and Supplier Development

* Identify and evaluate domestic and international manufacturers, OEMs and contract suppliers.
* Research potential suppliers in India and overseas, including China where appropriate.
* Compare suppliers on product quality, pricing, minimum order quantities, production capacity, lead times and reliability.
* Obtain and evaluate quotations, samples, product specifications and commercial terms.
* Work with the Director to negotiate pricing, payment terms, minimum order quantities, exclusivity and other supplier arrangements.
* Coordinate product sampling, evaluation and testing before commercial orders.
* Develop a reliable supplier base while managing cost, quality, delivery and supply risks.
* Explore opportunities to improve sourcing costs and product competitiveness without compromising quality.

4. Product Economics and Commercial Analysis

* Prepare product-level costing and profitability analyses.
* Evaluate purchase costs, freight, duties where applicable, packaging, compliance costs and other relevant expenses.
* Recommend selling prices and channel margins based on market conditions and profitability requirements.
* Assess the financial viability of new products before launch.
* Monitor product-wise sales, margins, inventory movement and returns.
* Work with management to improve working-capital efficiency and avoid slow-moving inventory.
* Ensure product and sourcing decisions support sustainable profitability rather than revenue growth alone.

5. Market Research and Competitive Intelligence

* Conduct structured research into the Indian electronics and audio markets.
* Identify competitors, comparable products, retail prices, dealer economics and distribution practices.
* Visit relevant trade markets, dealers, distributors, retailers and industry events.
* Maintain an organised database of prospective channel partners, suppliers and product opportunities.
* Translate market feedback into actionable recommendations for product development, sourcing and sales strategy.
* Prepare concise business cases for new products, categories and territories.

6. Channel Partner and Supplier Relationships

* Build long-term relationships with distributors, dealers, wholesalers, manufacturers and suppliers.
* Understand channel-partner needs and identify opportunities to improve BRITONE's product proposition.
* Support partners with product information, commercial proposals and approved sales initiatives.
* Maintain professional supplier relationships and ensure clear commercial communication.
* Coordinate with internal stakeholders to resolve product availability, quality and delivery issues.

7. Business Planning and Reporting

* Prepare annual and quarterly business development plans.
* Maintain a sales pipeline and provide realistic revenue forecasts.
* Present product proposals and sourcing recommendations with supporting data.
* Report on distributor appointments, sales, collections, product performance, sourcing opportunities and market developments.
* Track agreed business objectives and recommend corrective action where required.
* Work closely with the Director on strategic priorities and execution.

Required Qualifications and Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Commerce, Marketing, Engineering or a related field.
* Approximately 5–10 years of relevant experience in consumer electronics, audio products, electrical goods, home appliances or related physical-product categories.
* Proven experience in offline channel sales and dealer/distributor development.
* Exposure to product management, category development, OEM sourcing, procurement or supplier management.
* Strong commercial understanding of pricing, gross margins, costing and product profitability.
* Experience evaluating market opportunities and translating them into business decisions.
* Strong negotiation, analytical, communication and relationship-management skills.
* Good working knowledge of Excel and presentation tools.
* Willingness to travel across India and, where required, undertake supplier visits overseas.

title: Sr Sales Specialist, Reproductive & Genetic Health
description:
What if the work you did every day could impact the lives of people you know? Or all of humanity?
  
  
At Illumina, we are expanding access to genomic technology to realize health equity for billions of people around the world. Working at Illumina means being part of something bigger than yourself. Every person, in every role, has the opportunity to make a difference. Surrounded by extraordinary people, inspiring leaders, and world changing projects, you will do more and become more than you ever thought possible.

The individual will develop strategic customer relationships, drive clinician engagement and demand generation, support adoption of sequencing and library preparation solutions, and lead commercialization of new applications and initiatives within the reproductive and genetic health segment.

* Achieve annual revenue, consumables, and growth targets within the assigned territory.

* Identify, qualify, and convert new business opportunities across hospitals, diagnostic laboratories, fertility centers, genetic testing laboratories, and healthcare institutions.

* Build strong relationships with obstetricians, gynecologists, fetal medicine specialists, reproductive medicine specialists, geneticists, laboratory directors, and key opinion leaders.

* Promote new products, applications, and workflow innovations to accelerate market penetration.

Market Development & Strategic Initiatives
  
  

* Lead commercialization of new reproductive and genetic health applications and solutions.

About Us

We are a business advisory firm providing specialized advisory and consulting services to Indian businesses, multinational corporations, foreign investors, entrepreneurs and companies seeking to establish or expand their operations in India.

Our service portfolio includes:

* Corporate and business advisory

We are looking for an ambitious, commercially driven Business Development Manager who can independently develop business opportunities, acquire clients and contribute directly to the firm's revenue growth.

The Role — What We Expect

**This is a complete business development and client acquisition role, not merely a lead-generation position.**

The selected candidate will be responsible for the entire business development cycle, from identifying potential clients to converting qualified opportunities into confirmed business engagements.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Generation & Prospecting**

* Generate business for India market-entry, foreign company incorporation, regulatory compliance and corporate structuring services.

**4. Strategic Partnerships**

* Develop relationships with corporate consultants, financial advisers, law firms, professional networks, chambers of commerce and other relevant institutions.
* Identify opportunities for strategic alliances and business collaborations.
* Generate repeat business and long-term client relationships.

**5. Revenue Ownership & Reporting**

* Take ownership of agreed monthly and quarterly business development targets.
* Maintain an active CRM pipeline of leads, opportunities, proposals and conversions.
* Track revenue generated and fees collected.
* Provide regular business development reports and forecasts to management.

Required Qualifications & Experience

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Commerce, Finance, Management, Law or a related field. MBA preferred.
* 5–8 years of experience in B2B business development or client acquisition.
* Demonstrated experience in independently generating leads and closing business.
* Strong communication, negotiation, presentation and relationship-building skills.
* Experience dealing with business owners, CXOs, promoters, investors and corporate decision-makers.
* Strong working knowledge of LinkedIn prospecting, CRM systems and B2B sales processes.
* Excellent written and spoken English.

Highly Preferred Experience

Candidates from any of the following backgrounds will be preferred:

* Corporate advisory and management consulting firms
* Legal and financial consulting organizations
* CA / CS / professional services firms
* International business setup and company incorporation consultancies
* FEMA, FDI and regulatory advisory businesses
* Cross-border consulting and corporate services firms

Performance Expectations

The successful candidate should be capable of:

* Independently building and managing a qualified business pipeline.
* Generating approximately 20–30 qualified leads per month after the initial ramp-up period.
* Conducting 10–15 prospective client meetings monthly.
* Converting qualified opportunities into revenue-generating engagements.
* Working toward mutually agreed monthly and annual revenue targets.

Targets will be finalized based on the firm's service mix, average engagement value and sales cycle.

Compensation & Benefits

* Competitive fixed salary based on experience.
* Performance-linked incentives based on eligible business generated and revenue collected.
* Opportunity to work with Indian and international corporate clients.
* Direct interaction with senior management.
* Opportunity for long-term professional and career growth.

Who Should Apply?

We are particularly interested in candidates who:

* Have an established record of bringing business to professional services firms.
* Can independently generate opportunities rather than depend entirely on company-provided leads.
* Are comfortable approaching senior corporate decision-makers.
* Understand consultative selling and long-term relationship development.
* Can take accountability for business conversion and revenue generation.

**Candidates with only telecalling, digital marketing or lead-list generation experience, without demonstrated B2B business conversion experience, may not be suitable for this position.**

How to Apply

Interested candidates should share their updated CV along with:

1. Current and expected CTC.
2. Notice period.
3. Relevant business development experience.
4. Industries and services for which they have generated business.
5. A brief summary of their business acquisition achievements over the last 12 months.

title: Peoplesoft Sales SME
description: ROLE OVERVIEW • Act as the PeopleSoft Sales domain Subject Matter Expert (SME) for the data platform modernization program. • Provide deep functional and technical knowledge of PeopleSoft Order Management, Billing, Pricing, Contracts, and related Sales modules. • Drive source-to-target mapping from PeopleSoft Sales tables to the canonical enterprise data model for Sales 360 data products. • Collaborate with business SMEs (Sales VPs, Directors, Territory Managers) to validate business rules, KPIs, and reporting logic. • Support the data engineering team in building accurate, high-quality data pipelines from PeopleSoft Sales modules into the GCP data lake. KEY RESPONSIBILITIES 1. PeopleSoft Functional & Technical Expertise • Provide end-to-end functional expertise across PeopleSoft Order Management, Billing, Pricing, Contracts, Customer Management, and related Sales modules. • Explain PeopleSoft Sales module configurations, setups, business processes, and transaction flows in the context of specific implementation. • Identify and document PeopleSoft customizations, bolt-Ons, and extensions that impact Sales data structures and business logic. • Map PeopleSoft Sales transactions end-to-end — from order entry through fulfilment, billing, invoicing, and revenue recognition. • Articulate how -specific business rules (territory assignments, pricing tiers, distributor hierarchies, warranty/guarantee logic) are implemented in PeopleSoft. 2. Enterprise Data Modelling & Source-to-Target Mapping • Lead source-to-target mapping (STM) for PeopleSoft Sales tables to the canonical Sales 360 enterprise data model. • Document PeopleSoft record definitions, field structures, translate/prompt tables, tree structures, and SetID-based configurations for Sales modules. • Identify primary keys, foreign keys, join conditions, and cardinality across PeopleSoft Sales tables. • Define data dictionaries and business glossaries for all Sales-related PeopleSoft fields being mapped to the data lake. • Collaborate with the Enterprise Data Model (EDM) team to validate entity relationships, resolve naming conflicts, and ensure source-agnostic harmonization. 3. Data Product Design & Validation • Support the design and validation of 57 Sales 360 data products — including Orders, Pricing, Territory, Warranty Claims, Sales Hierarchy, Contractor Certifications, and Leads. • Validate transformation logic, business rules, and calculated fields as PeopleSoft Sales data moves through Raw → Transform → DaaP layers. • Perform source-to-target reconciliation to ensure data completeness, accuracy, and consistency between PeopleSoft source and data lake targets. • Support UAT by providing expected results, test scenarios, and validation criteria based on PeopleSoft Sales business logic. • Define data quality rules (null checks, referential integrity, value range validation) specific to PeopleSoft Sales datasets. 4. Cross-System Harmonization • Collaborate on the PeopleSoft-to-SAP S/4HANA data merge strategy for Sales entities — defining which source masters each field, handling ID crosswalks, and resolving conflicting business rules. • Support harmonization of Sales data across PeopleSoft, SAP, and Salesforce CRM into a unified canonical model. • Map PeopleSoft Sales hierarchies (territory, customer, product) to the enterprise-wide hierarchy model. • Support Salesforce Data Cloud integration readiness by mapping PeopleSoft CRM-adjacent data (Leads, Contacts, Opportunities) to Salesforce object models. 5. AI Tools & Modern Discovery • Leverage AI-powered tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate discovery of PeopleSoft configurations, customizations, and data flows. • Use AI tools to reverse-engineer undocumented PeopleSoft implementations — including stored procedures, SQR programs, Application Engine logic, PeopleCode, and integration points. • Apply AI-assisted techniques for automated documentation generation, code analysis, and schema discovery to reduce manual investigation time. • Proactively explore how AI can accelerate source-to-target mapping, data profiling, and anomaly detection across PeopleSoft datasets. 6. Stakeholder Engagement & Communication • Interface directly with leadership — including VPs, Directors, and Senior Managers — to gather requirements, validate business rules, and present findings. • Translate complex PeopleSoft technical concepts into business-friendly language for non-technical stakeholders. • Participate in solution forums, design reviews, sprint demos, and steering committee meetings as the domain authority. • Collaborate with Kloud9 data engineers, data architects, data analysts, and QA teams to ensure accurate implementation of PeopleSoft business logic in the new data lake. • Produce clear, comprehensive documentation — including functional specification documents (FSDs), data dictionaries, business glossaries, and entity relationship diagrams (ERDs). DOMAIN-SPECIFIC PEOPLESOFT KNOWLEDGE REQUIRED The candidate must demonstrate deep, hands-on expertise in the following PeopleSoft Sales areas: Order Management & Fulfilment • PeopleSoft Order Management module — sales orders, order types, order lines, order status lifecycle, order holds, and fulfilment processing. • Tables: PS\_ORD\_HEADER, PS\_ORD\_LINE, PS\_ORD\_SCHEDULE, PS\_ORD\_LINE\_SHIP, PS\_DEMAND\_INF and related order tables. • Order-to-cash (O2C) process flow — from order capture through picking, shipping, delivery, and invoice generation. • Backlog management, available-to-promise (ATP), and delivery scheduling logic. Billing & Invoicing • PeopleSoft Billing module — billing plans, bill headers, bill lines, invoice generation, pro-forma billing, and credit/debit memos. • Tables: PS\_BI\_HDR, PS\_BI\_LINE, PS\_BI\_LINE\_DST, PS\_PENDING\_ITEM, and related billing/AR tables. • Integration between Order Management and Billing — how fulfilled orders trigger billing events. • Revenue recognition rules and their implementation in PeopleSoft. Pricing & Contracts • PeopleSoft Pricing module — price lists, price rules, price adjustments, promotions, and buying agreements. • Tables: PS\_PRICE\_LIST\_HDR, PS\_PRICE\_LIST\_DTL, PS\_PRICE\_RULE, PS\_BUYING\_AGR\_HDR, PS\_BUYING\_AGR\_LN. • Contract management — contract headers, lines, terms, renewal logic, and pricing overrides. • Standard pricing vs. negotiated pricing vs. rebate structures as configured in PeopleSoft. Customer & Territory Management • PeopleSoft Customer module — customer master, customer groups, ship-to/bill-to hierarchies, customer contacts. • Tables: PS\_CUSTOMER, PS\_CUST\_ADDRESS, PS\_CUST\_OPTION, PS\_CUST\_GRP\_DTL and related customer tables. • Territory management — territory definitions, territory-to-customer assignments, sales rep assignments. • Distributor and contractor hierarchies, certification tracking, and rewards/loyalty program data structures. Sales Reporting & Analytics • PeopleSoft query structures and reporting trees used for Sales analytics — sales by territory, product, customer, and region. • Sales backlog reporting, daily order intake, shipment tracking, and sales pipeline data structures. • Warranty claims and guarantee data — claims history, validity periods, processing status, and related historical tables. • Integration points with external systems — market share feeds (ARMA, SPRI, RCMA), weather data, storm data, and distributor POS feeds. MANDATORY REQUIREMENTS • 12–15 years of hands-on PeopleSoft experience with deep expertise in the Sales domain. • Extensive knowledge of PeopleSoft schemas, record definitions, field structures, tree structures, and table relationships for Sales modules. • Experience with PeopleSoft query tools, SQR reporting, Application Engine, PeopleCode, Component Interfaces, and Integration Broker. • Proven track record working on large-scale data migration, data lake, or data warehouse projects involving PeopleSoft as a source system. • Hands-on experience with PeopleSoft data extraction — including full snapshots, incremental/delta extracts, and Change Data Capture (CDC) patterns. • Ability to work with US Eastern Time (EST/EDT) for real-time collaboration with stakeholders. • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with demonstrated ability to interact with senior leadership (VP/Director level) and explain technical concepts clearly. • Experience with source-to-target mapping (STM), data dictionary creation, and business rule documentation. PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS • Experience using AI tools (GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or similar) to accelerate discovery, documentation, or code analysis. • Familiarity with cloud-based data platforms — Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Data Fusion, Dataform, Cloud Composer) or equivalent. • Experience working in Agile/Scrum delivery models with sprint-based delivery. • Exposure to SAP S/4HANA or Salesforce data models — helpful for cross-system harmonization and canonical data model design. • Experience in manufacturing, building materials, or industrial sectors. • PeopleSoft certifications or Oracle certifications in relevant modules. • Experience with data governance frameworks, data cataloging, and data quality tooling. • Familiarity with SQL, Python, or PySpark for data profiling and validation. TOOLS & TECHNOLOGIES ECOSYSTEM • PeopleSoft: People Tools, Application Designer, People Code, Application Engine, SQR, Query, Integration Broker, Component Interfaces. • Cloud Platform: Google Cloud Platform (BigQuery, Cloud Data Fusion, Cloud Composer, Dataform, Pub/Sub, Cloud Functions). • Data Integration: CDC (Change Data Capture), DataStream, batch/streaming ingestion patterns. • Collaboration: JIRA, Confluence, Lucid chart, Google Workspace. • AI Tools: GitHub Copilot, ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, or equivalent AI-assisted development and discovery tools. • Data Quality: Custom DQ frameworks, Dataplex, Data Catalog, profiling engines. INTERVIEW EVALUATION CRITERIA Candidates will be evaluated on the following dimensions during the interview process: • Depth of PeopleSoft Knowledge: Ability to articulate PeopleSoft Sales module architecture, table structures, key fields, and inter-module relationships without referring to documentation. • Schema & Table Walkthrough: Live walkthrough of key PeopleSoft tables, their relationships, primary/foreign keys, and how business transactions flow through them. • Data Migration Experience: Demonstrated experience extracting PeopleSoft data for downstream consumption — CDC, delta loads, full snapshots, and reconciliation strategies. • AI Tool Proficiency: Practical examples of using AI tools to discover, document, or analyze PeopleSoft implementations. • Communication & Stakeholder Readiness: Assessed through scenario-based questions on explaining PeopleSoft data flows to non-technical business leaders

title: Business Development Executive (Work From Home)
description:
About ReadyForGCC

ReadyForGCC Consultants helps people land good jobs in India, the Gulf and around the world. Our biggest strength is the UAE, where most of the people we help find work in Dubai, Abu Dhabi and Sharjah. We offer career coaching, ATS resumes, LinkedIn profile building and interview preparation. Website: www.readyforgcc.com

About the founder

ReadyForGCC was founded by Mohd Aamir Siddiqui, who spent over 14 years working in the UAE and Saudi Arabia in fleet and car rental operations. He has lived and worked in the Gulf, knows how hiring really works there, and has built strong professional connections across the region. Since 2018, he has personally guided job seekers from India to build their careers in the Gulf. You will be working directly with him and learning from that experience.

About the role

We are looking for one City Growth Partner for Delhi to grow our business in the city. You will find people and companies who need our services, talk to them, and bring them on board. This is fully work from home, with the option to join our Delhi office after probation.

What you will do

You will reach out to job seekers, colleges, coaching centres and local businesses across Delhi. You will explain our services, follow up with interested people, and help close sales. You will also build partnerships with institutes and companies that can send us regular clients.

What you will earn

The first 3 months are a probation period on revenue share. You earn 20% of every sale you bring in, going up to 40% as your sales grow. There is no fixed salary during probation. After a performance review, strong partners move to a fixed salary plus higher commission, with a path to a leadership role.

We are a highly competitive team, and we reward hard work. If you perform, you get the best pay. Simple as that.

Growth to Dubai

After one successful year with us, top performers will get the option to move to our Dubai office. This is based purely on performance.

Who should apply

We welcome freshers and experienced people alike. Graduates and undergraduates can both apply, and an MBA is a plus. What we need most is excellent spoken and written English, confidence in talking to people, and the will to work hard. Your degree matters less than your drive and communication. Women are strongly encouraged to apply.

Shortlisted candidates will get a short phone call, followed by a video interview with the founder. We aim to reply to every shortlisted applicant within 7 days.

title: Sales caller
description:
**Company Description**
BrandShala is a curated collective of skilled freelancers, including video editors, graphic designers, performance marketers, and web developers, focused on helping brands, startups, creators, and coaches grow without building full-time in-house teams. The team operates as an extended in-house partner, delivering fast, affordable, and reliable execution across video editing, Meta ads, graphic design, and web development. BrandShala supports a wide range of clients, such as startup founders, coaches, consultants, D2C brands, content creators, and agencies needing white-label execution. Work is organized through transparent communication, simple processes, and a result-driven approach, with project-based or monthly support available. The company emphasizes verified talent, flexible scalability, and a single streamlined process centered on client growth.
  
**Role Description**
This is a full-time remote role for a Sales Caller at BrandShala. The Sales Caller will engage prospective clients via phone and online calls, introduce BrandShala’s services, understand their business needs, and clearly communicate how the team can support their growth. Day-to-day tasks include making outbound calls, handling inbound inquiries, qualifying leads, scheduling discovery calls or demos, and maintaining accurate records in CRM tools or spreadsheets. The role involves following up with warm leads, coordinating with internal teams to understand service offerings and pricing, and supporting the closing of project-based or monthly contracts. The Sales Caller is expected to meet call and conversion targets while providing a professional, consultative experience to every potential client.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Strong communication and interpersonal skills, including clear spoken and written English and the ability to build rapport quickly over calls.
* Experience in telesales, inside sales, or customer outreach, preferably in digital services, marketing, or creative industries.
* Basic understanding of digital marketing, creative services (video editing, graphic design), or web development to explain offerings confidently.
* Proficiency with CRM tools or spreadsheets for tracking leads, follow-ups, and call outcomes.
* Ability to work independently in a remote environment, manage daily call targets, and stay organized with multiple leads and follow-ups.
* Goal-oriented mindset with resilience, persistence, and comfort with high-volume calling.
* High level of professionalism, ethical conduct, and a client-focused, consultative approach to selling.
* Prior experience in B2B sales or working with founders, creators, or agencies is an advantage.
* Minimum high school diploma; a degree in business, marketing, communications, or a related field is a plus but not mandatory.

title: Channel Manager, India
description:
**At AlgoSec, What you do matters!**
AlgoSec helps the world’s leading organizations secure application connectivity across hybrid and multi-cloud environments. Trusted by more than 2,300 global organizations, our platform delivers visibility, security policy management, risk reduction, and compliance automation across complex enterprise networks.
  
  
As we continue to expand our cloud and enterprise business globally, we are looking for a
**Channel Manager**
to drive incremental sales and foster the growing AlgoSec channel ECO-System. In this role, you will work closely with our partners to successfully ensure customer satisfaction and that business goals are met within the territory.
  
  
**Reporting to:**
Regional Sales Director
  
  
**Location:**
Mumbai /Bangalore, India (Home office)
  
  
Direct employment
  
  
**What You’ll Do**

* Drive the creation of partner-initiated pipeline and New ARR across India, generating incremental opportunities beyond those originated by the direct sales organization.
* Build and execute joint business plans with AlgoSec’s strategic distributors, leveraging their reseller ecosystem, enterprise relationships and market reach to create new business.
* Identify and activate high-potential Tier 1 and Tier 2 partners, SIs and large account resellers capable of generating meaningful pipelines.
* Drive structured account mapping and whitespace exercises with RSMs, distributors and strategic partners to gain access to AlgoSec’s target enterprise accounts.
* Build sustained AlgoSec mindshare across the India cybersecurity partner ecosystem, positioning AlgoSec around application connectivity, network security policy management and automation across hybrid and multi-cloud environments.
* Establish quarterly business plans, pipeline targets and joint GTM initiatives with strategic partners and measure their performance against pipeline and revenue outcomes.
* Enable partner sales and technical teams to independently identify, position and qualify AlgoSec opportunities within their customer base.
* Collaborate closely with RSMs from opportunity identification through closure, while maintaining clear accountability for the partner-generated component of the pipeline.
* Develop opportunities through strategic technology alliances and routes to market including Cisco, AWS/cloud marketplaces and other relevant ecosystem partners.
* Drive partner-led new-logo acquisition as well as expansion opportunities within the AlgoSec installed base.
* Manage deal registration, partner engagement and channel conflicts while maintaining appropriate partner governance.
* Regularly review partner productivity and focus AlgoSec resources on partners capable of delivering sustainable pipeline and revenue.

**What We’re Looking For**

* 7+ years of enterprise technology/channel experience, preferably within cybersecurity, network security or adjacent infrastructure software.
* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Business, Management, Marketing, or related field
* through account planning with Tier 1 and Tier 2 Channels/Partners
* Experience in selling B2B SW technology. Experience in selling cybersecurity solutions directly through channels is an added advantage
* Track record of success in establishing new strategic partnerships in India region and helping partners in scaling their business revenue
* Experience using Salesforce
* Self-starter, business-driven, positive and with an energetic attitude
* Great communicator, ability to work with various organizational levels and stakeholders
* Demonstrated ability to exceed quarterly quota
* Strong written and interpersonal communications and presentation skills
* English written and verbal skills at a very high level
* Willingness to travel up to 50% of the time
* Proven track record of personally building partner-initiated pipeline and delivering closed revenue through distributors, Tier 1/Tier 2 resellers and system integrators in India.
* Strong existing relationships across the Indian cybersecurity channel ecosystem, with demonstrated ability to activate partners and gain access to large enterprise accounts.

AlgoSec is an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating a friendly, diverse, and inclusive company culture.

title: Business Development & Sales Intern
description:
**Business Development & Sales Intern**

**B2B Sales | AI & IT Services | Daphnis Labs**

**Location:**
New Delhi (Work From Office)

**Stipend:**
₹10,000–₹18,000/month + Performance Bonus

**Working Days**
: 6 Days/Week

**Flexibility:**
Option to work from home 1 day per week after completing the first month, subject to approval

**Experience:**
Freshers / 0–1 Year

**About Daphnis Labs**

Daphnis Labs is a technology solutions company helping businesses build, automate, and scale through AI, custom software development, SaaS, web and mobile applications, and digital transformation. We work with businesses across industries to solve real problems using technology. We’re looking for someone who doesn’t just want to learn sales — but wants to become genuinely good at it.

**The Opportunity**

This is not an internship where you simply copy-paste emails, collect random leads, or wait for instructions.

You’ll learn how to identify business opportunities, connect with founders and decision-makers, understand their challenges, and turn conversations into real business opportunities. You’ll get exposure to B2B sales, international client acquisition, AI-powered prospecting, and the complete business development process.
**Pre-Placement Offer (PPO): High-performing interns will be eligible for a Pre-Placement Offer (PPO) for a full-time position at Daphnis Labs upon successful completion of the 6-month internship, based on performance, skills, and overall contribution.**

**What You’ll Actually Do**

1. Find the Right Businesses

\* Research potential clients in India and international markets.

\* Identify founders, CEOs, CTOs, and other decision-makers.

\* Understand businesses, their challenges, and where Daphnis Labs can add value.

\* Use LinkedIn, Google, AI research tools, and other prospecting platforms to discover opportunities.

2. Start Meaningful Conversations

\* Reach out through cold emails, LinkedIn messages, calls, and professional networking.

\* Write personalized messages instead of sending generic sales pitches.

\* Confidently introduce our services and communicate our value.

\* Follow up consistently and professionally to build interest.

3. Turn Leads Into Opportunities

\* Qualify prospects based on their business needs and potential fit.

\* Schedule discovery calls and meetings with interested clients.

\* Support proposals, presentations, and client discussions.

\* Maintain accurate lead records and follow-up schedules.

4. Use AI to Work Smarter

\* Use tools like ChatGPT, Claude, and Perplexity for prospect research, market intelligence, and outreach preparation.

\* Identify business opportunities using AI-assisted research.

\* Experiment with different outreach approaches and improve messaging based on results.

\* Explore ways to automate repetitive sales tasks without compromising personalization.

5. Own Your Results

\* Track outreach, responses, follow-ups, qualified leads, and meetings.

\* Understand what works, what doesn’t, and continuously improve.

\* Take responsibility for your pipeline and assigned targets.

**The Mindset We’re Looking For**

Sales Mindset: You enjoy conversations, understand that sales is about solving problems, and are motivated by measurable results.

Perseverance: You don’t give up after hearing “no.” You understand that rejection and follow-ups are part of sales.

Excellent Communication: You can speak and write clear, professional English and confidently engage with new people.

Confidence & Initiative: You’re comfortable approaching strangers, asking questions, and taking the first step.

Curiosity: You genuinely want to understand businesses, technology, customer psychology, and why people buy.

Ownership: You don’t need constant reminders to follow up, complete tasks, or improve your work.

Adaptability: You’re excited to learn new tools, especially AI, and find smarter ways to achieve results.

**Who Can Apply?**

\* Students, recent graduates, and freshers from BBA, MBA, B.Com, Marketing, or any relevant background.

\* Candidates with strong spoken and written English.

\* People comfortable with cold calling, outreach, and interacting with professionals.

\* Individuals interested in B2B sales, technology, startups, and AI.

\* Basic knowledge of LinkedIn, Excel/Google Sheets, and AI tools is an advantage.

\* Previous sales experience is appreciated but not mandatory.

We value communication, attitude, perseverance, and willingness to learn more than your degree.

**Compensation & Performance Rewards**

\* Month 1: ₹10,000 fixed stipend

\* Month 2: ₹12,000 fixed stipend

\* Month 3 Onwards: ₹12,000–₹18,000 based on performance

\* Additional Performance Bonus: Earn incentives for achieving defined sales milestones, qualified meetings, and successful client conversions.

Performance bonuses are additional to the monthly stipend and depend on the company’s incentive policy.

**Work Arrangement**

\* Full-time, primarily in-office role in New Delhi.

\* 6 working days per week.

\* First month: Work from office.

\* From the second month: Option for 1 work-from-home day per week, subject to approval and work requirements.

**What You’ll Gain**

\* Hands-on experience in real B2B and international sales.

\* Exposure to AI, SaaS, software engineering, and technology consulting.

\* Practical training in prospecting, outreach, negotiation, and client communication.

\* Experience with modern AI-powered sales and research tools.

\* Opportunity to contribute directly to business growth.

\* Potential full-time employment opportunity based on performance.

Good communication gets you noticed. Perseverance, curiosity, and execution will help you succeed here.

Minimum 3+ years of experience in business development, international sales, fashion sourcing, apparel manufacturing, garment exports, or a related industry.

Existing relationships with European fashion brands and apparel buyers.

Familiarity with international B2B sales cycles and export business requirements.

Ability to work independently, develop market-entry strategies, and take ownership of business growth.

title: High-Ticket Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist
description:

Full-Time

Remote – India

About FBCI

Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI) is a premium business coaching and consulting company that helps fitness coaches, nutritionists, and health professionals build, grow, and scale profitable online coaching businesses.

We help entrepreneurs improve their client acquisition, sales processes, marketing strategies, business positioning, and operational systems.

Our mentorship programs range from ₹90,000 to ₹5,00,000+.

As we expand, we're looking for a highly motivated and communication-driven
**Lead Qualification & Appointment Setting Specialist**
to join our sales team.

Important: This Is NOT a Traditional Telecalling Job

We are not hiring someone to simply make calls, read scripts, or fill our sales team's calendar.

**Your primary responsibility is to pre-qualify every incoming lead before they are connected with our sales department.**

You'll speak with fitness coaches and business owners, understand their current situation, identify their challenges, assess their investment readiness, and determine whether they're a suitable fit for our premium mentorship programs.

You must be someone who
**genuinely loves talking to people, enjoys understanding their problems, and is passionate about helping them find the right solutions.**

This role requires strong communication skills, business understanding, patience, persistence, and excellent follow-up discipline.

Key Responsibilities

**1. Lead Qualification**

* Contact incoming leads through phone calls and WhatsApp.
* Conduct structured pre-qualification conversations.
* Understand prospects' current monthly revenue, business challenges, goals, and growth expectations.
* Assess their financial readiness and ability to invest in premium mentorship programs.
* Identify serious prospects who are genuinely interested in growing their businesses.
* Ensure only qualified leads are forwarded to the sales department.

**2. Appointment Setting**

* Book strategy consultations with the sales team for qualified prospects.
* Clearly communicate the purpose and expectations of the consultation.
* Coordinate appointment timings and ensure proper scheduling.
* Confirm appointments and maximize show-up rates.

**3. Follow-Ups & Relationship Building**

* Conduct multiple follow-ups with prospects through calls and WhatsApp.
* Maintain consistent communication with interested leads.
* Re-engage prospects who haven't responded or booked their consultations.
* Build genuine relationships rather than using aggressive sales tactics.
* Ensure no qualified lead is neglected due to poor follow-up.

**4. CRM & Sales Coordination**

* Maintain accurate lead information and conversation notes in the CRM.
* Update lead statuses, qualification details, and follow-up schedules.
* Coordinate with the sales closers to ensure smooth handovers.
* Provide regular updates on lead quality, appointment bookings, and follow-up performance.

Who We're Looking For

* Someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and building relationships.
* Excellent communication skills in English and Hindi.
* Strong listening, questioning, and interpersonal skills.
* Minimum 1 year of experience in appointment setting, inside sales, lead qualification, or a similar role.
* Comfortable making multiple calls and follow-ups daily.
* Ability to understand business problems and ask intelligent questions.
* Confident discussing revenue, business growth, and premium investments with entrepreneurs.
* Highly organized, self-motivated, disciplined, and target-oriented.
* Comfortable using CRM software, Google Sheets, and WhatsApp.
* Someone who takes ownership instead of waiting for instructions.

**Preferred:**
Experience in business coaching, consulting, premium mentorship, digital marketing agencies, or high-ticket service businesses.

Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Your performance will be measured by:

* Lead response time
* Number of leads contacted and qualified
* Qualified appointments booked
* Appointment show-up rate
* Follow-up completion rate
* Quality of appointments passed to the sales team
* CRM accuracy and lead management
* Contribution to overall sales conversions

**We value qualified appointments over the total number of appointments booked.**

Who Should NOT Apply

* Someone looking for a basic telecalling or scripted calling job.
* Someone who dislikes speaking with people or making follow-up calls.
* Candidates who book appointments without understanding the prospect's needs.
* Individuals who give up after one or two unsuccessful contact attempts.
* Someone who prioritizes quantity over quality.
* Candidates who are uncomfortable with accountability and performance targets.

What We Offer

* Fixed salary with performance-based incentives.
* Inbound leads generated through our marketing campaigns.
* Opportunity to work directly with fitness entrepreneurs and business owners.
* Training in business consultation, qualification, and premium sales processes.
* A performance-driven and growth-focused working environment.
* Career growth opportunities in Sales Operations, Senior Appointment Setting, and Sales Leadership.

How to Apply

Please submit your updated resume along with answers to these questions:

1. How much experience do you have in lead qualification or appointment setting?
2. How many leads or calls have you handled daily in your previous role?
3. Have you worked with high-ticket services or premium coaching programs?
4. How do you handle prospects who don't respond after multiple follow-ups?
5. Why do you believe you're a good fit for this role?

Our Hiring Philosophy

**We don't need someone who just makes 100 calls a day.**

We need someone who can turn meaningful conversations into qualified business opportunities.

Someone who listens carefully, asks the right questions, follows up consistently, and genuinely enjoys helping people.

**At FBCI, your success is not measured by how many appointments you book, but by how many of the right prospects you bring to our sales team.**

If you're a people person who loves conversations, takes ownership, and thrives in a performance-driven environment, we'd love to hear from you.

* **Apply now and become part of Fitness Business Coaching India (FBCI).**

title: Lead Generation Specialist

We measure meetings, not activity.

* Qualified meetings booked and held (your headline number)
* Reply rate and booking rate by channel
* Healthy sending domains and low bounce rates
* Cost per qualified meeting
* Clean, complete CRM records

  and starting real conversations.

  **numbers**
  : you test, measure and improve.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
About Us
  
PurpleBits is a Gujarat-based healthcare IT company with 15 years of experience and 250+ hospitals served across India. Our flagship product, PurpleIPD, is an ABDM-certified, tablet-based inpatient documentation system. It helps hospitals go paperless, improve documentation quality, and stay compliant with national digital health standards.
  
The Role
  
We're looking for field sales executives who can walk into a hospital, get time with a doctor, and earn their trust. You will own the sales cycle in your city, from finding prospects to running demos and moving them toward closure.
  
Key Responsibilities
  
• Lead generation: Identify nursing homes, multi-specialty hospitals, and clinics in your territory and build a steady pipeline through field visits, referrals, medical associations, CMEs, and local networks.
  
• Lead validation: Qualify prospects on bed count, decision-makers, current documentation practices, budget, and readiness for digital adoption. Keep the CRM/tracker up to date.
  
• Product demos: Run in-person PurpleIPD demos for hospital owners, doctors, nursing heads, and administrators, tailored to their workflows and pain points.
  
• Follow-up and closure: Follow up consistently, handle objections, and work with the internal team on proposals and pricing.
  
• Market feedback: Share insights on competitors, customer needs, and feature requests.
  
• Targets: Meet monthly targets for visits, qualified leads, and demos.
  
Must-Have
  
• 1–3 years of hands-on, in-person field sales experience selling to doctors or hospitals in India (pharma, medical devices, diagnostics, healthcare software, or hospital services). Tele-sales or online-only experience will not be considered.
  
• A real understanding of how Indian doctors think, decide, and buy.
  
• Strong communication, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
  
• Fluency in English and Hindi; Gujarati preferred for Vadodara.
  
• Own two-wheeler and willingness to travel within the territory.Good to Have
  
• An existing network of doctors or hospital owners in the city.
  
• Exposure to hospital software (HIS/EMR) or ABDM/digital health.

title: Account Executive
description:
**About The Opportunity**

* We are seeking a detail-oriented Accountant to manage the financial operations of our D2C/E-commerce business. The role is critical for ensuring accurate financial reporting, compliance, and reconciliation across multiple online sales channels and payment gateways.
* The ideal candidate will have hands-on experience with e-commerce accounting, including marketplace settlements, GST compliance, inventory valuation, and vendor reconciliation.

Role & Responsibilities
  
  

* Maintain day-to-day accounting records including sales, purchases, expenses, and journal entries.
* Manage accounts payable and accounts receivable, including vendor and marketplace payment reconciliations.
* Prepare and maintain the general ledger, trial balance, and monthly/quarterly financial statements.
* Ensure accurate revenue recognition across multiple sales channels (own website, Amazon, Flipkart, Myntra, Nykaa, etc.).
* Reconcile marketplace settlements, commissions, TCS/TDS deductions, and payment gateway statements (Razorpay, PayU, Cashfree, etc.).
* Track COD (Cash on Delivery) collections, RTO (Return to Origin), and refund/return adjustments.
* Reconcile inventory movement with sales data across warehouses and fulfillment centers (own/3PL/FBA-type models).
* Monitor and account for discounts, coupons, cashback, and marketing spend impact on net revenue.
* Ensure timely and accurate GST filing (GSTR-1, GSTR-3B, GSTR-9), including e-commerce specific TCS reconciliation (GSTR-8).
* Handle TDS computation, deduction, and return filing.
* Support statutory audits, tax audits, and internal audits.
* Ensure compliance with e-invoicing and e-way bill requirements.
* Maintain accurate stock valuation (FIFO/weighted average) and coordinate periodic stock reconciliation.
* Track landed costs, freight, and logistics expenses per SKU/channel.
* Monitor and report on inventory write-offs, damages, and shrinkage.
* Perform end-to-end vendor reconciliation.

**Skills & Qualifications**
Must-Have
  
  

* Bachelor's/Master's degree in Commerce, Accounting, or Finance (CA Inter / M.Com / MBA Finance preferred).
* 3–5 years of accounting experience, preferably in D2C, e-commerce, or retail industry.
* Strong knowledge of GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance relevant to online businesses.
* Proficiency in accounting software (Tally, Zoho Books, QuickBooks, or similar ERP).
* Working knowledge of MS Excel/Google Sheets (VLOOKUP, Pivot Tables, etc.).
* Familiarity with e-commerce marketplace panels (Amazon Seller Central, Flipkart Seller Hub, etc.) is a strong plus.
* Experience with reconciliation tools or platforms (e.g., ClearTax, GSTHero, Increff, Vinculum) is a plus.

**Preferred**

* Strong attention to detail and accuracy in high-volume transaction environments.
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, growing startup environment.
* Good communication skills to coordinate with marketplaces, vendors, and internal teams.
* Analytical mindset with the ability to translate numbers into business insights.

description:
**Technical Sales and Operations Lead – 3D Bioprinters**

**Location:**

New Delhi, India

**Employment Type:**

Full-time

**Reports to:**

Founders and Management

**About NITS Engineering**

NITS Engineering is a biomedical technology company building the next generation of biomedical devices, in vitro disease models, and engineering systems for drug discovery, regenerative medicine, and diagnostics. We combine precision hardware engineering with biomedical research to build the tools that take science from the lab bench to real world application.

**About the Role**

We are looking for a technically proficient and execution-oriented professional to manage the sales and production coordination of our 3D bioprinters. The role combines technical sales and business development with hands-on operational management, ensuring that customer requirements are translated into orders and that printers are built and delivered within agreed timelines.

You will engage with prospective customers, understand their technical requirements, conduct product demonstrations, prepare proposals, and drive sales opportunities. In parallel, you will coordinate printer builds, manage vendors and procurement, track tasks and deadlines, and resolve bottlenecks affecting production and delivery.

This role requires someone who can work independently across customer-facing and engineering activities, take ownership of deliverables, and ensure that both commercial opportunities and ongoing builds progress to completion.

**What You Will Do**

* **Technical Sales and Business Development:**

  Identify and develop opportunities with pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, research institutions, universities, and other relevant customers. Manage enquiries, follow up on leads, and drive opportunities towards closure.
* **Customer Consultation and Product Demonstrations:**

  Understand customer requirements, explain the capabilities and applications of our 3D bioprinters, and coordinate product demonstrations and technical discussions.
* **Proposals and Commercial Coordination:**

  Prepare quotations, technical proposals, and commercial offers. Coordinate negotiations, follow up on purchase orders, and maintain an active sales pipeline.
* **Production Planning and Tracking:**

  Coordinate individual printer builds, define tasks and milestones, assign responsibilities, establish completion dates, and track progress against delivery commitments.
* **Vendor and Procurement Management:**

  Coordinate with suppliers, fabrication vendors, and component manufacturers. Track purchase orders and delivery schedules, ensure component availability, and resolve delays, quality issues, and specification mismatches.
* **Bottleneck Resolution:**

  Identify dependencies, resource constraints, component shortages, and technical issues affecting production. Coordinate with the relevant teams and vendors to resolve outstanding issues and minimise delays.
* **Assembly and Delivery Coordination:**

  Work with engineering, electronics, controls, and software teams to coordinate assembly, integration, calibration, testing, and delivery of completed printers.
* **Cross-functional Coordination:**

  Translate customer requirements into actionable inputs for engineering and coordinate internally to ensure that product capabilities, delivery timelines, and customer expectations are aligned.
* **Documentation and Reporting:**

  Maintain sales pipeline records, quotations, BOMs, procurement trackers, build schedules, and delivery status reports. Keep management informed of sales progress, production risks, and outstanding actions.

**What We Are Looking For**

* Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Biomedical Engineering, Biotechnology, or a related technical discipline.
* 3–6 years of relevant experience across technical sales, manufacturing operations, project execution, or technical product management.
* Experience selling or supporting technically complex products, preferably scientific instruments, laboratory equipment, machinery, automation systems, or 3D printers.
* Practical experience coordinating physical product builds, procurement, vendors, assembly, or delivery schedules.
* Ability to understand technical requirements, communicate product capabilities, prepare commercial proposals, and manage customer relationships.
* Demonstrated ability to track tasks and deadlines, follow up with internal teams and external vendors, and resolve issues that delay delivery.
* Strong communication, negotiation, organisational, and problem-solving skills.
* Ability to work independently in a small, multidisciplinary engineering environment.

**Nice to Have**

* Experience with 3D printing, bioprinting, biomedical devices, or laboratory equipment.
* Familiarity with mechanical assemblies, electronics, pneumatic systems, or electromechanical products.
* Experience selling capital equipment to pharmaceutical companies, biotechnology companies, universities, or research laboratories.
* Familiarity with BOMs, engineering drawings, procurement systems, and project tracking tools.

**Why Join**

* Take ownership of both the commercial growth and operational execution of advanced 3D bioprinting systems.
* Work directly with the founders and engineering teams in a growing biomedical technology company.
* Contribute to bringing innovative bioprinting technologies from development to commercial adoption.

title: Pre Sales Intern
description:
**About Atlys**
Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
  
  
Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
  
  
Atlys is changing that.
  
  
We’re building an AI-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
**1M+ travellers across 127 countries**
. But we’re still early.
  
  
**The Role**
We’re looking for a
**Pre-Sales Intern**
to help turn customer interest into confident decisions and successful conversions.
  
  
You’ll be among the first people travellers speak to at Atlys, understanding their needs, helping them navigate their visa options, and building trust through clear, thoughtful conversations.
  
  
This is a hands-on role for someone who communicates well, enjoys interacting with people, and wants to learn how sales works in a fast-paced, high-volume environment.
  
  

* Duration: 6 months
* Stipend & Incentives: ₹25,000/month plus uncapped incentives. The more you sell, the more you earn!
* Full-Time Opportunity: Perform well, and you could receive a PPO for a full-time role at Atlys.

**The Job**

* Engage and qualify potential customers across calls, chats and email by understanding their travel needs and guiding them towards the right Atlys solution.
* Explain our products and visa processes clearly so customers understand their options, feel confident in their decisions and know what happens next.
* Support lead conversion through timely follow-ups, addressing customer questions and objections, and helping move potential customers towards a decision.
* Learn from customer conversations by identifying recurring questions, pain points and opportunities to improve conversion and the overall customer experience.
* Work closely across teams with Sales, Marketing, Fulfilment and Product while maintaining accurate lead and interaction data.

**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**

* Have 1+ years of experience in pre-sales, sales, customer success or another customer-facing role.
* Communicate clearly and confidently, and can simplify complex information into easy, human conversations.
* Are persuasive without being pushy, with strong empathy and the ability to understand what a customer actually needs.
* Are proactive, organised and comfortable managing multiple conversations and follow-ups in a fast-paced environment.
* Are comfortable working a 6-day schedule, with Monday to Friday in-office and a rotational WFH shift on either Saturday or Sunday.

*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
  
  
**Here’s What You Can Expect**

* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.

* Solid organizational skills, including time management, territory planning, and accurate record-keeping.
* Minimum of a diploma or bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Business, or a related field is preferred; relevant work experience in industrial product sales is highly beneficial.
* Comfortable working on-site and traveling locally to client locations in and around Ghaziabad.
* Ability to work independently, meet targets, and collaborate with internal teams in a fast-paced, customer-focused environment.

ability to navigate them for demo purposes.

title: Pre-sales Associate
description:
**Company Description**

The platform covers virtualization, hyperconverged infrastructure, storage, networking, Kubernetes, disaster recovery, migration and log management. Our customers include central government bodies, state utilities, public-sector undertakings and large enterprises in India.

title: Business Development
description:
* **Job Description – Business Development (Real Estate – Land Acquisition & Distressed Assets)**
* **Designation: Manager / Senior Manager / AGM – Business Development**
* **Department: Real Estate**
* **Job Location: Gurugram, Haryana**

**Project Focus**
: Residential, Commercial, Distressed Assets & Stalled Projects

Geographical Coverage: Haryana, with a focus on Gurugram and adjoining markets

**Job Summary**

We are seeking a dynamic and result-oriented Business Development professional for our Real Estate business, responsible for identifying, evaluating, structuring, and closing land acquisition and real estate investment opportunities across Haryana.

The candidate will focus on sourcing dead and distressed land assets, stressed real estate projects, stalled or stuck residential and commercial projects, and opportunities arising through banks, financial institutions, insolvency proceedings, and MCLT/NCLT-related matters, wherever applicable.

The role involves developing strategic relationships with banks, financial institutions, insolvency professionals, landowners, developers, investors, and other stakeholders to identify commercially viable opportunities. The candidate will drive transactions through land aggregation, outright acquisition, joint ventures, joint development agreements, strategic tie-ups, and other suitable transaction structures.

The ideal candidate should have a strong network in the Haryana real estate market, an understanding of distressed asset transactions, and a proven ability to convert complex opportunities into successfully executed deals.

**Key Responsibilities**
:

**1. Land Acquisition & Identification of Dead Assets**

Identify dead, distressed, underutilised, and non-performing land assets across Haryana that offer potential for residential and commercial development.

Source land parcels with clear development or monetisation potential through landowners, property consultants, aggregators, developers, investors, and institutional channels.

Identify land parcels facing financial stress, delayed development, ownership-related challenges, or underutilisation, subject to legal and commercial feasibility.

Evaluate opportunities for land aggregation, outright purchase, redevelopment, joint development, and strategic partnerships.

Build and maintain a comprehensive database of available land parcels, including ownership, location, size, indicative valuation, land use, development potential, and transaction status.

**2. MCLT/NCLT & Insolvency-Linked Opportunities**

Identify land and real estate assets available through insolvency proceedings, corporate distress situations, and tribunal-linked processes.

Explore opportunities involving assets of stressed companies, corporate debtors, and real estate entities undergoing insolvency or restructuring.

Develop relationships with insolvency professionals, resolution professionals, liquidators, legal advisors, asset reconstruction companies (ARCs), and other relevant stakeholders.

Track relevant proceedings, public announcements, expressions of interest, resolution plans, asset sale opportunities, and applicable bidding processes.

Evaluate potential acquisitions, project takeovers, and strategic investments, coordinating legal, financial, and technical due diligence before recommending a transaction.

Ensure all opportunities are pursued through the applicable legal, regulatory, and tribunal-approved processes.

**3. Banking & Financial Institution Tie-Ups**

Establish and strengthen relationships with banks, NBFCs, financial institutions, ARCs, and other lenders to source distressed land and real estate assets.

Identify assets under stress, non-performing exposures, secured properties, and real estate collateral that may present acquisition, redevelopment, or resolution opportunities.

Explore opportunities arising from loan defaults, enforcement proceedings, settlements, restructuring, and asset monetisation.

Coordinate with bank officials, recovery teams, stressed asset divisions, and institutional asset management teams to understand available opportunities.

Facilitate discussions on asset acquisition, settlement-led transactions, project resolution, and other commercially viable arrangements.

Develop a structured pipeline of bank- and institution-sourced opportunities and drive them towards closure.

**4. Identification & Revival of Stuck Real Estate Projects**

Identify stalled, delayed, abandoned, or financially stressed residential and commercial projects across Haryana.

Evaluate projects facing funding constraints, incomplete construction, developer distress, land disputes, approval issues, or other execution challenges.

Explore project revival opportunities through developer tie-ups, investor partnerships, joint ventures, joint development agreements, project acquisitions, and structured investment arrangements.

Assess the commercial feasibility of taking over, completing, redeveloping, or monetising stalled projects.

Coordinate with existing developers, lenders, landowners, investors, and other stakeholders to develop viable transaction structures.

Work with internal legal, finance, technical, and project execution teams to assess liabilities, pending approvals, completion costs, and potential returns.

Drive negotiations and stakeholder alignment to facilitate the revival or successful acquisition of viable projects.

**5. Strategic Tie-Ups & Deal Structuring**

Identify and negotiate strategic tie-ups with landowners, developers, distressed asset holders, investors, lenders, and institutional partners.

Structure transactions through outright land purchases, joint ventures, JDAs, development management arrangements, project acquisitions, or other suitable commercial models.

Evaluate partnership proposals based on project viability, land valuation, investment requirements, risk exposure, and expected returns.

Negotiate commercial terms, revenue-sharing arrangements, payment milestones, consideration structures, and other transaction conditions.

Drive opportunities from initial sourcing and discussions through internal approvals, documentation, agreement execution, and final closure.

**6. Commercial Evaluation & Due Diligence**

Conduct preliminary assessments of land parcels and distressed projects based on location, market demand, pricing, development potential, and commercial feasibility.

Coordinate with internal teams and external consultants for title verification, ownership checks, encumbrances, litigation, land-use permissions, regulatory approvals, and other due diligence requirements.

Evaluate project liabilities, outstanding lender dues, pending statutory obligations, construction costs, and other financial exposures, as applicable.

Coordinate the review and vetting of documents received from land acquisition teams, landowners, developers, banks, and other stakeholders.

Prepare investment proposals, deal comparison statements, preliminary feasibility reports, and business cases for management approval.

Identify transaction risks and ensure appropriate legal, financial, and technical assessment before commitments are made.

**7. Liaisoning & Stakeholder Management**

Maintain effective relationships with local authorities, revenue departments, planning authorities, government bodies, and other relevant stakeholders.

Coordinate the collection and verification of land records, approvals, permissions, and supporting documents.

Facilitate coordination between landowners, developers, banks, legal advisors, investors, and internal teams.

Ensure that all acquisition, liaisoning, and transaction activities are conducted in accordance with applicable laws and company policies.

**8. Pipeline Management & Reporting**

Maintain a structured pipeline of land acquisition opportunities, distressed assets, bank-sourced properties, insolvency-linked assets, and stalled projects.

Track each opportunity from identification and preliminary assessment through negotiation, due diligence, approval, and closure.

Submit periodic reports covering land inventory, project status, deal pipeline, expected investment, transaction risks, and closure timelines.

Provide management with market intelligence on land prices, distressed asset opportunities, stalled projects, and emerging investment prospects.

Achieve agreed business development, acquisition, tie-up, and transaction closure targets.

**Desired Candidate Profile**
:

Graduate or postgraduate in Business Administration, Real Estate, Finance, Commerce, Civil Engineering, or a related discipline.

**Approximately 5–12 years of relevant experience in real estate business development, land acquisition, distressed assets, project acquisition, or real estate investments.**

Strong understanding of the Haryana real estate market, particularly Gurugram and adjoining locations.

Proven experience in land sourcing, landowner negotiations, project tie-ups, or closure of real estate transactions.

Experience dealing with banks, NBFCs, ARCs, insolvency professionals, lenders, or distressed asset teams will be highly preferred.

Exposure to stalled real estate projects, insolvency proceedings, NCLT-related transactions, or stressed asset resolution will be an added advantage.

Understanding of land title documentation, due diligence, zoning, land-use regulations, project feasibility, and transaction structuring.

Strong networking, negotiation, commercial evaluation, and deal-closing capabilities.

Ability to independently source opportunities, build institutional relationships, and convert leads into executable transactions.

Willingness to travel across Haryana as required

title: Key Account Manager (Airline Sales) - Delhi
description:
**Job Description**

**Ready to take your airline sales career to the next level?**

At Etihad Airways, we’re looking for a commercially driven and relationship-focused
**Key Account Manager**
to join our sales team in Delhi.

As we continue to expand our global network and deliver on our ambitious Journey 2030 growth strategy, we’re looking for talented sales professionals who can help strengthen our presence, develop valuable commercial partnerships, and drive revenue growth in one of our important markets.

This is an opportunity for someone who thrives on building relationships, identifying new business opportunities, and turning commercial potential into measurable results.

You’ll take ownership of a portfolio of key accounts, working closely with travel trade and commercial partners to grow Etihad’s market share, strengthen customer loyalty, and deliver against ambitious sales targets.

We’re looking for someone who brings energy, commercial curiosity, strong relationship-building skills, and the confidence to represent Etihad in a competitive and evolving market.

**What you’ll do**

As a Key Account Manager, you’ll play an important role in driving Etihad’s commercial performance across your assigned portfolio, developing existing partnerships while actively identifying opportunities to grow our business.

You’ll build trusted relationships with customers, understand their commercial needs, and develop tailored sales approaches that deliver value for both our partners and Etihad.

Using sales performance data, market intelligence, and customer insights, you’ll identify opportunities, influence commercial decisions, and take ownership of delivering results.

**You’ll also:**

* Develop and execute account plans and sales strategies to achieve revenue targets and grow market share.
* Build, manage, and strengthen relationships with key travel trade partners, corporate accounts, and prospective customers.
* Identify and convert new business opportunities while maximizing revenue from existing accounts.
* Position yourself as a trusted commercial partner, understanding customer needs and delivering solutions that create long-term value.
* Monitor market trends, competitor activity, and customer performance to identify opportunities and inform sales strategies.
* Promote Etihad’s expanding network, products, services, and commercial initiatives to customers and partners.
* Negotiate and manage commercial agreements in line with Etihad’s policies and business objectives.
* Use sales data, CRM tools, and commercial insights to track performance, manage opportunities, and improve results.
* Collaborate with colleagues across Sales, Revenue Management, and the wider Etihad organization to support commercial objectives.
* Represent Etihad professionally at customer meetings, industry events, and other commercial engagements.

**Qualifications**

**What we’re looking for**

We’re looking for an experienced sales professional who combines strong commercial instincts with the energy, initiative, and determination to deliver results.

You’ll ideally bring:

* A bachelor’s degree and at least 4 years of relevant experience in sales, account management, business development, or a related commercial role.
* A proven track record of achieving sales targets, growing revenue, and developing successful customer relationships.
* Strong commercial awareness and the ability to identify, develop, and convert business opportunities.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills, with the confidence to engage and influence a range of stakeholders.
* An analytical mindset, with the ability to interpret sales performance, market intelligence, and customer data to support decisions.
* Experience managing multiple accounts, commercial priorities, and stakeholder relationships.
* A proactive, results-oriented approach, with the motivation to take ownership and consistently deliver against objectives.
* The ability to work effectively within a large, international organization and collaborate across different teams and functions.

**Previous experience in airline passenger sales is strongly preferred**
, particularly within travel trade sales, key account management, or airline business development. Candidates with an established network of travel industry relationships and a proven track record of delivering revenue growth in the Indian market will be particularly attractive.

We will also consider high-performing sales professionals from other industries who demonstrate exceptional commercial ability, strong relationship management skills, and the drive to succeed in the aviation sector.

**Additional Information**

**Recruitment Process**

The recruitment process for this position will involve the following steps:

1. Applications will be reviewed by a human-member of our Recruitment Team
2. Shortlisted applicants will be invited to complete an AI-lead video interview via our third-party platform. This interview will allow you to record your responses to a range of questions related to the position and will allow you to demonstrate your knowledge and experience in a way that just your CV alone would not be able to. It also ensures fairness for you and all candidates, as all of our shortlisted candidates are asked the same questions and assessed on their responses.
   **Whilst AI is utilized as part of the process, all responses will be reviewed by a human member of our recruitment team**
3. After a review of completed AI interviews, shortlisted candidates will be invited to an initial technical interview with the hiring manager. This interview will involve the completion and presentation of a relevant business case.
4. Finalists may be invited to a follow-up interview with additional members of the hiring team.
5. All candidates will be notified as to the status of their application as soon as is possible.

Etihad Airways is more than the UAE’s national airline - we’re shaping the future of global aviation. From our hub in Abu Dhabi, we connect people across continents and cultures, while driving our “Journey 2030” ambition to double our fleet, expand our network and grow our people for a new era of excellence. Join us and become part of a vision where the world is your workplace and extraordinary experiences take flight.

To learn more visit www.etihad.com

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**
  
Beware of fraudulent job offers from individuals or organizations claiming to represent the Etihad group. We will never ask for personal information, bank details, or payment during the recruitment process. Interviews are conducted face-to-face or via video/telephone before any formal offer. If you are asked for money, please treat it as fraudulent.

Iksha Labs is looking for a results-driven Sales Representative with experience in B2B SaaS sales and a strong interest in healthcare technology.

In this role, you will be responsible for driving revenue growth by identifying and acquiring healthcare clients, building relationships with key decision-makers, and selling AI-powered solutions that address their operational challenges.

You will work closely with hospital management teams, fertility clinic owners, healthcare administrators, and other decision-makers to understand their requirements and demonstrate how Iksha Labs' solutions can improve patient communication, automate routine processes, and enhance operational efficiency.
