title: Business Development Manager, Enterprise Support
description:
**Description**
AWS Global Services includes experts from across AWS who help our customers design, build, operate, and secure their cloud environments. Customers innovate with AWS Professional Services, upskill with AWS Training and Certification, optimize with AWS Support and Managed Services, and meet objectives with AWS Security Assurance Services. Our expertise and emerging technologies include AWS Partners, AWS Sovereign Cloud, AWS International Product, and the Generative AI Innovation Center. You’ll join a diverse team of technical experts in dozens of countries who help customers achieve more with the AWS cloud.
  
  
AWS is one of Amazon’s fastest growing businesses, servicing customers in more than 190 countries, reshaping the way global enterprises consume information technology and powering the developers who are building the next generation of global industry leaders. AWS customers include some of the most innovative Startups like Netflix, Pinterest, Spotify, Airbnb, and Instagram as well as some of the largest global enterprises like Shell International, Unilever, Hitachi, Sharp, Bristol-Myers Squibb, and Samsung. We help global and local enterprises to use cloud to remediate their technical debt and build new innovative businesses.
  
  
AWS Enterprise Support provides our customers with one-on-one, fast-response support channel that is staffed 24x7x365 with experienced and technical support engineers; Enterprise support provides a designated technical account manager to the customer and provides entitlements such as architecture review, operations support to design, build, and operate cloud environments leveraging AWS best practices; and a designated Support Concierge for administrative and billing inquiries.
  
  
Enterprise customers rely on Support when running their business critical workloads on the AWS platform, and our technical account managers and cloud support engineers are the primary daily touch-point for those customers. Customers include very large Enterprises, Public Sector companies, as well as fast growing businesses and Internet companies. Unlike most support organizations, AWS Support is a self-standing business with revenue and P&L responsibility and one of the fastest growing businesses within AWS.
  
  
Key job responsibilities
  
  

* Engage customers, partners, and field teams to deeply understand and measure customer value and pain points in adoption of Enterprise Support
* Analyze drivers of Enterprise Support adoption and identify levers for improvement
* Identify, design and execute controlled experiments in driving Enterprise Support adoption
* Review and analyse Enterprise Support pricing and costing, ensuring savings are passed on to our customers
* Quantify impact of Enterprise Support adoption on AWS Platform adoption, estimate the ROI of Support investments in accelerating AWS platform adoption
* Develop and refine sales collateral, reference cases and value proofs for customers and partners
* Drive commercial innovation in Support, e.g. differentiated support offerings per customer segment
* In conjunction with Field Enablement, create Support related training programs and material for the India field team so that they can properly articulate the Support value proposition
* Work with stakeholders across India Commercial/Public Sales, Premium Support, and Enterprise
* Prepare and present business reviews to the senior Sales and BD management team
* Drive Enterprise Support deals end to end with Sales

A day in the life
  
  
As Enterprise Support BDM, you will be part of the AWS India Enterprise Support organization. You will define the strategy and own the go-to-market (GTM) efforts for Support, with the objective to increase adoption for paid support offerings amongst Enterprise customers while maintaining target margin performance, and using Support to accelerate AWS platform adoption for the customers. You will engage our customers to understand why they need Enterprise Support (or why not), what are the pain points and obstacles in their current support offering. You will identify areas for sharpening our Support proposition (e.g. a differentiated offering, pricing) and design and execute controlled experiments driving commercial innovation. You will quantify the impact of Support in driving AWS platform adoption, estimate the ROI, and design and execute initiatives to help accelerate our customer cloud adoption journey. You will enable the sales team to drive the day-to-day interactions with prospects, selling the Support value proposition, in order to build long-term business opportunity. You will engage partners to develop and pilot new Support offerings via the partner ecosystem.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a keen business sense and exceptional analytical skills, is able to articulate and communicate a clear value proposition across customers, partners, and within the AWS organization, and its comfortable working across internal functions and geographies. The candidate will be naturally curious, going beyond the obvious to discover unexpected insights and translate those into tangible business value.
  
  
**About The Team**
Diverse Experiences
  
  
AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. Technical Pre-SalesProposals & SOWsCRMPipeline ManagementClient DiscoveryNegotiation // WHAT MAKES YOU A FIT

A key, front-line role with direct impact on growth.

Work with an agency that delivers real, high-quality products (easy to sell with confidence).

Exposure to Indian and international clients.

Competitive salary plus performance incentives.

This is a Gurugram, India (On-site / Hybrid) role. You would be based with the team in Gurugram, working on-site or hybrid rather than fully remote.

2+ years. 2+ years in technical sales / business development, preferably in IT services. We care more about what you have actually shipped than about exact years.

Technical Pre-Sales, Proposals & SOWs, CRM, Pipeline Management, Client Discovery, Negotiation.

Yes. This is a full-time position based in Gurugram, India.

title: B2B Sales Executive
description:
**Experience:**
2–5 years in B2B sales, preferably in the food, FMCG, HoReCa, or food service industry

**Reporting To:**
Business Head

**About CookSafari:**

CookSafari provides ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat Indian food products and kitchen solutions for the food service industry. Its offerings help restaurants, hotels, cafés, cloud kitchens, caterers, and institutional kitchens deliver consistent food quality while reducing preparation time, kitchen complexity, and dependency on skilled manpower.

CookSafari combines authentic Indian flavours with convenient food preparation solutions to help food businesses improve kitchen efficiency and maintain consistency across outlets.

**Website:**
https://www.cooksafari.co.in/

**Role Purpose:**

We are looking for a result-oriented B2B sales professional to expand CookSafari's presence across the HoReCa and institutional food service markets.

The person will be responsible for identifying potential customers, generating leads, arranging product demonstrations and sampling sessions, converting prospects into paying customers, and developing long-term business relationships.

The role requires someone who can independently approach customers, explain the commercial benefits of CookSafari's products, negotiate business terms, and build a consistent pipeline of new orders.

**Key Responsibilities:**

1. New Business Development

• Identify and acquire new customers across hotels, restaurants, cafés, cloud kitchens, catering companies, corporate cafeterias, hospitals, hostels, and other institutional kitchens.

• Build a database of prospective customers, restaurant chains, multi-outlet operators, and food service businesses.

• Generate leads through cold calling, field visits, referrals, LinkedIn, industry networks, and direct outreach.

• Schedule meetings with restaurant owners, chefs, procurement managers, F&B managers, and business decision-makers.

• Develop new accounts and achieve assigned sales and revenue targets.

2. Product Sales and Demonstrations

• Present CookSafari's ready-to-cook and ready-to-eat products to prospective customers.

• Arrange product sampling, kitchen trials, and demonstrations to showcase taste, preparation convenience, and consistency.

• Explain how CookSafari's products can reduce preparation time, kitchen wastage, and dependence on skilled cooks.

• Identify opportunities for standardising menu items and maintaining consistent taste across multiple outlets.

• Understand customer menus, consumption patterns, kitchen operations, and product requirements to recommend suitable products.

3. B2B Account Acquisition and Order Conversion

• Convert product trials and customer discussions into commercial orders.

• Prepare quotations, product proposals, and commercial offers.

• Negotiate pricing, order quantities, delivery schedules, and payment terms within approved company guidelines.

• Follow up on samples, quotations, trials, and pending orders until closure.

• Build repeat business by maintaining regular contact with existing customers and monitoring their product requirements.

4. Market Development and Channel Sales

• Explore new markets and customer segments for CookSafari's products.

• Identify opportunities with restaurant chains, franchise operators, distributors, food service suppliers, and institutional buyers.

• Develop relationships with distributors and channel partners where required.

• Track competitor offerings, pricing, customer preferences, and market demand.

• Share market feedback with the management team to improve product positioning and identify new business opportunities.

5. Customer Relationship Management

• Maintain regular contact with customers to understand satisfaction levels and future requirements.

• Coordinate with operations and dispatch teams to support timely order fulfilment.

• Follow up on repeat orders, payment collections, and outstanding receivables.

• Identify opportunities to expand product sales within existing accounts.

• Address customer concerns and coordinate internally for timely resolution.

6. Sales Reporting and Pipeline Management

• Maintain accurate records of prospects, meetings, product trials, quotations, orders, and collections.

• Prepare weekly sales pipeline and activity reports.

• Track customer conversion rates, order frequency, average order value, and account growth.

• Provide market intelligence and sales forecasts to management.

• Ensure that sales activities and customer commitments are documented and followed through.

**Required Qualifications and Experience**

• Graduate in any discipline; an MBA in Sales or Marketing is an advantage.

• 2–5 years of experience in B2B sales or business development.

• Experience in HoReCa, FMCG, food products, food service, institutional catering, or hospitality supplies will be preferred.

• Experience selling to restaurant owners, chefs, procurement teams, or multi-outlet food businesses is desirable.

• Strong communication, negotiation, presentation, and customer relationship skills.

• Comfortable with cold calling, field sales, customer visits, and product demonstrations.

• Ability to work independently, manage a sales pipeline, and achieve measurable targets.

• Basic proficiency in Excel, sales reporting, and CRM tools.

• Willingness to travel locally for customer meetings and product trials.

title: Field Sales Executive
description:
**Company Description**
Justdial is India’s leading local search and services platform, offering more than 25 service verticals that help users manage everyday tasks such as booking tables, cabs, movie tickets, flights, groceries, and more. Founded in 1996 as a phone-based local directory, it has evolved into a comprehensive digital ecosystem accessible via web, app, and WAP. Justdial’s cloud-based business management solution, JD Omni, supports business owners with real-time sales insights, inventory management, billing, customer retention, promotions, and employee management. With offices across 11 Indian cities, a workforce of over 10,000 employees, and 21 million business listings, Justdial provides services across major cities, making “Anything, Anytime, Anywhere” easily accessible to users.
  
**Role Description**
The Field Sales Executive role at Justdial is a full-time, on-site position based in South Delhi. In this role, the executive is responsible for visiting prospective and existing business customers, presenting Justdial’s service offerings and JD Omni solutions, and demonstrating how these can support their growth and operations. Day-to-day activities include generating leads, conducting sales meetings and product demos, negotiating and closing deals, and ensuring accurate documentation of client information. The role also involves maintaining ongoing relationships with clients, providing post-sales support, gathering market feedback, and coordinating with internal teams to ensure service activation and customer satisfaction. The Field Sales Executive is expected to meet defined sales targets, follow company processes, and represent Justdial professionally in the local market.
  
**Qualifications**
  

* Candidates should possess strong sales, business development, and negotiation skills to identify opportunities and close deals effectively.
* Candidates should possess excellent communication, interpersonal, and presentation skills to engage with diverse business clients and explain solutions clearly.
* Candidates should possess basic digital literacy and comfort with mobile apps, web platforms, and cloud-based solutions to demonstrate Justdial and JD Omni products.
* Candidates should possess skills in customer relationship management, follow-up, and problem-solving to ensure client satisfaction and retention.
* Candidates should ideally have prior field sales or retail sales experience, preferably in digital services, technology, or business solutions.
* Candidates should have a minimum of a high school diploma; a bachelor’s degree in business, marketing, or a related field is an advantage.
* Candidates should be willing to travel locally within South Delhi, work in a fast-paced environment, and meet performance and target-based objectives.

About Hubhopper

Hubhopper is a leading content and podcast company specializing in the creation, production, distribution, and growth of premium audio and video content for brands, creators, founders, and businesses.

We work with brands to develop compelling content-led properties across podcasts, video, branded content, and digital media. As we continue to expand our content solutions business, we are looking for an experienced Content Sales Manager who can build strong client relationships, identify content opportunities, and drive revenue through high-value branded content and production partnerships.

About the Role

We are looking for a Content Sales Manager with 4–6 years of relevant experience in media, content sales, video production, or audio-visual businesses.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of how brands evaluate and invest in content, and should be comfortable selling solutions rather than simply selling media inventory. You will be responsible for identifying prospective clients, developing relationships with marketing and business leaders, understanding their content requirements, and converting those opportunities into high-value projects.

You will own the sales cycle end-to-end from prospecting and relationship building to pitching, negotiation, closure, and account handover.

Key Responsibilities1. Content Sales & Business Development

* Drive new business for Hubhopper's branded content, podcast, video production, and content marketing solutions.
* Build and maintain a strong pipeline of prospective brands and clients.
* Identify organizations with potential content, video, podcast, and digital storytelling requirements.
* Own the sales process from initial outreach through negotiation and closure.

2. Client Relationship Management

* Build relationships with senior stakeholders across marketing, brand, communications, digital, partnerships, and business teams.
* Understand client objectives, budgets, audiences, and content requirements.
* Develop long-term relationships that lead to repeat business and larger accounts.
* Act as a trusted content partner rather than a transactional salesperson.

3. Pitching & Solution Development

* Work closely with internal creative, production, and strategy teams to develop customized client proposals.
* Translate client business objectives into relevant content solutions.
* Lead client presentations, pitches, and commercial discussions.
* Develop compelling proposals across podcasts, video series, branded content, creator-led content, and other digital formats.

4. Market & Client Development

* Identify emerging content trends, categories, and industries with strong potential for branded content.
* Build a target list of brands and decision-makers across relevant sectors.
* Track competitor offerings and understand evolving brand-content requirements.
* Develop new avenues for revenue through partnerships, content properties, and integrated campaigns.

5. Sales Pipeline & Reporting

* Maintain an accurate and healthy sales pipeline.
* Track leads, opportunities, proposals, negotiations, and closures.
* Forecast revenue and provide regular updates on pipeline performance.
* Work against defined monthly, quarterly, and annual revenue goals.

Ideal Candidate Profile

* 4–6 years of professional experience in content sales, branded content, media sales, video production, digital media, or related fields.
* Prior experience in- media, video production, PR agency, creative agency, digital content, advertising, or similar company.
* Strong understanding of the branded content and digital media ecosystem.
* Demonstrated experience in B2B sales and closing high-value deals.
* Existing relationships with brands, agencies, marketing teams, or relevant decision-makers will be an advantage.
* Strong communication, presentation, negotiation, and relationship-building skills.
* Comfortable engaging with senior marketing and business stakeholders.
* Ability to understand a client's business problem and translate it into a content solution.
* Strong commercial orientation with a demonstrated track record of meeting or exceeding revenue targets.
* Comfortable working in a fast-paced, entrepreneurial environment with significant individual ownership.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for someone who understands content as a business solution, someone who can identify a brand's communication objective, develop the right content proposition, build the business case, and close the deal.

The ideal candidate is:

* Relationship-driven, but commercially sharp.
* Consultative, rather than transactional.
* Comfortable selling creative and content-led solutions.
* Hungry to close and grow accounts.
* Comfortable working with ambiguity and taking ownership of outcomes.

Why Join Hubhopper?

* Work with leading brands, creators, founders, and businesses on high-impact content projects.
* Own a significant revenue mandate with direct visibility into business outcomes.
* Work across podcasts, video, branded content, and emerging digital formats.
* Collaborate closely with creative, production, strategy, and business teams.
* Opportunity to build and manage long-term relationships with senior brand stakeholders.
* Performance-linked earning potential in addition to fixed compensation.
* High-ownership role in a growing content and media business

title: Business Development - Associate / Senior Associate
description:
**Business Development (Associate / Senior Associate)**

📍On-site | Delhi | Full-time

*Inside Sales • Business Development • Admissions Counseling • B2C Sales • Consultative Sales*

**Compensation:
Typical CTC range:**
₹6,00,000 - ₹10,00,000 including incentives.

**Seniority:**
This role is open to both entry-level and experienced candidates, with evaluation for Senior Associates as well during the process.

**The short version:**

**Who we’re looking for:**
People who can influence. You're the kind of person who doesn’t shy away from tough conversations - someone who listens deeply, understands what’s holding a person back, and knows how to guide them to take action. If you’ve done Business Development, Inside Sales, B2C Sales, Admissions Counseling, or Consultative Sales, you’ll find this role both challenging and meaningful.

**What this role is about:**
As part of the Admissions & Inside Sales team, you’ll speak to students and professionals exploring Kraftshala’s programs - understanding their goals, tackling their doubts, helping them evaluate program fit, and guiding them toward confident career decisions. Every lead you convert into an enrolment directly contributes to student outcomes and Kraftshala’s growth.

**Why you should apply:**
Sales is one of the fastest ways to build skills that set apart great professionals. Here, you’ll learn to communicate with impact, run structured consultative sales conversations, stay disciplined under pressure, and help people make decisions that genuinely change their careers. The learning curve is steep, the growth is fast, and the rewards - in both skills and incentives - are well worth the effort.

**About us:**
Kraftshala is India’s largest skilling institution in terms of marketing & sales placements, with a 94% placement rate. We’re building the world’s most effective career launchpad across domains, backed by leaders from RedBus, NoBroker, Nestlé, and Performics.

**The detailed version:**

As a Business Development Associate / Senior Associate, you’ll be the first point of contact for people exploring Kraftshala’s programs. This is a 50% consultative admissions counseling + 50% structured inside sales role, where you guide applicants through clarity, empathy, and disciplined execution - while meeting your monthly enrolment, revenue, and pipeline conversion targets.

Responsibilities:

* Speak with students who show interest in our programs and guide them on whether the course is right for them.
* Run structured consultative sales conversations covering curriculum, learning outcomes, faculty, fees, placements, and expectations.
* Handle objections confidently and thoughtfully - supporting applicants through doubts on finances, program fit, career paths, and timelines.
* Follow up consistently so prospective students don’t miss deadlines or lose interest.
* Maintain accurate and timely CRM updates for all conversations and pipeline stages.
* Share insights from student conversations with marketing to improve lead quality and messaging.
* Represent Kraftshala with empathy, clarity, and professionalism in every interaction.
* This role mirrors the expectations of Inside Sales Representatives, Senior Business Development Executives, and Enrollment Advisors in fast-paced education and B2C sales teams.

**Monthly Outcomes**

* **Month 1:**
  Learn the ropes — understand our programs, shadow calls, and start taking your first few admissions with guidance.
* **Month 2:**
  Run independent admission calls, handle objections confidently, and begin hitting individual enrollment targets.
* **Month 3+:**
  Own your pipeline end-to-end — consistently close admissions, exceed revenue goals, and help improve our processes.

Experienced candidates may transition faster into responsibilities typical of Senior Inside Sales roles.

**Must Haves**

* Strong English communication skills (spoken & written)
* Comfort working with targets, follow-ups, and structured sales processes
* Basic computer skills (email, spreadsheets, simple tracking tools)
* Motivation to build a career in sales, admissions, or education counseling

**Good-to-Haves**

* Prior experience in Inside Sales, B2C Sales, Admissions, Enrollment Counseling, or Edtech Sales
* Student leadership experience, volunteering, or side projects showing initiative

**Recruitment Process**

As a small team, we must get to know each other before taking the leap. We want to ensure you succeed in your role within our team. Each conversation with us will last about 30-60 minutes, and will be a mix of online and in-person interactions.

* **Conversation 1:**
  This will be a virtual call with the HR team to understand your profile briefly and share the details of the selection process to set expectations about what you’re signing up for
* **Technical Exercise:**
  This is a specific assessment designed to evaluate your fit for this role
* **Conversation 2:**
  This will be a conversation with a senior member of the Admissions Team where you can expect to be evaluated on the competencies needed for the job (mentioned above).
* **Conversation 3:**
  This will be a detailed assessment review conversation with the Admissions Lead to go over your submission for the technical exercise where you can expect to be further evaluated on the competencies needed for the job (mentioned above).
* **Conversation 4:**
  A conversation with our CEO to ensure that there is a fit with the Kraftshala Kode (read below about it).
* **Reference Check:**
  We’ll speak with references provided by you, to learn about their experience of working with you, your strengths, and where you shine
* **Extending an offer:**
  If all goes well, we will extend an offer that will mention the relevant details.

**Location**

Delhi (On-site)

**Know more about Kraftshala’s philosophy, culture and investors
here
.**

title: Sales Governance Manager
description:
**Job Title**
 Sales Governance Manager
   

  

**Location**
 Gurgaon, India
   

  

**Role Description**
 The Sales Governance Manager will lead and embed global deal governance frameworks across the Commercial function. This role ensures governance policies are current, legally aligned, and effectively integrated into commercial processes to enable compliant, efficient, and risk\-mitigated deal execution.
   

  

 The role will act as the subject matter expert (SME) for global deal governance, partnering closely with Sales, Legal, Company Secretariat (CoSec), Finance, and senior stakeholders to maintain policy integrity, manage governance forums, and drive continuous improvement across Commercial Office activities.
   

  

**Organisational Design**
**Key Responsibilities**
* Deal Governance
* Own and manage the global deal governance framework.
* Ensure governance policy is fully integrated into commercial deal workflows.
* Maintain oversight of deal approval processes and ensure adherence to delegated authorities.
* Establish and maintain a non\-compliance register and governance reporting mechanisms.
* Manage governance committees including agenda setting, stakeholder coordination, documentation, and communications.
* Policy Management
* Maintain and update governance policies in line with evolving business needs and legal requirements.
* Ensure policies are aligned with legal updates, entity execution requirements, shareholder/investor consent protocols, and delegated authority structures.
* Drive professional policy documentation and version control standards.
* Develop process maps and guidance notes to support compliance\-by\-design integration.
* Process Management
* Integrate governance controls into commercial processes to ensure seamless adoption.
* Embed policy adherence into CRM/workflow tools and operational procedures.
* Monitor effectiveness of governance processes and recommend enhancements.
* Drive standardisation to improve consistency, quality, and turnaround time of deal execution.
* Legal \& CoSec Alignment
* Establish and maintain strong working relationships with Legal and Company Secretariat teams.
* Ensure deal approvals and contract execution processes meet legal and regulatory requirements.
* Support entity\-specific execution and consent protocols.
* Act as a coordination point between Commercial and Legal during complex deal reviews.
* Change Management
* Lead change management initiatives related to governance tools, policies, and processes.
* Support rollout and adoption of new governance frameworks across global teams.
* Develop communication plans and stakeholder training materials to ensure smooth implementation.
* Stakeholder Engagement \& Continuous Improvement
* Build strong relationships with global commercial stakeholders.
* Establish credibility as the go\-to SME for deal governance matters.
* Display non\-authority\-based influence to drive policy adherence and operational discipline.
* Ideate and execute continuous improvement initiatives to enhance governance efficiency and effectiveness.


**Experience Required**
* 7–12 years of experience in Sales Governance, Commercial Governance, Deal Desk, Risk, Legal Operations, or Sales Operations.
* Strong understanding of deal approval processes, delegated authority frameworks, and commercial controls.
* Experience working closely with Legal and Company Secretariat teams.
* Proven ability to manage governance forums and senior stakeholders.
* Strong policy drafting and documentation skills.
* Demonstrated change management experience.
* Excellent communication, influencing, and stakeholder management skills.


**About FNZ**

*We created wealth’s growth platform to help. We provide a global, end\-to\-end wealth management platform that integrates modern technology with business and investment operations. All in a regulated financial institution.*
*We partner with the world’s leading financial institutions, with over US$2\.4 trillion in assets on platform (AoP).
   

  

 Together with our clients, we empower nearly 30 million people across all wealth segments to invest in their future.*

 INR. 3\.5LPA \- 6 LPA

 DRIPLABS is a rapidly growing medical wellness and longevity company focused on personalized, physician\-guided wellness solutions.
 



 The company operates at the intersection of
 **healthcare, preventive wellness, longevity, medical aesthetics, nutrition, recovery and performance** 
 , delivering premium experiences designed around individual health and wellness objectives.
 



 DRIPLABS works with consumers, physicians, wellness centers, clinics and other healthcare stakeholders to create a clinically guided and professionally managed patient journey.
 



 Our approach combines
 **medical expertise, evidence\-informed wellness protocols, personalized counseling and premium customer experience** 
 .
 



 As we continue expanding across Delhi\-NCR and other markets, we are looking for professionals who can understand healthcare, communicate medical concepts effectively and build meaningful relationships with consumers and healthcare stakeholders.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a
 **Medical Advisor \& Counselor** 
 who can act as a trusted first point of contact between DRIP LABS and prospective clients, existing members, physicians and healthcare partners.
 



 This is
 **not a conventional telesales or call\-center position** 
 .

 **healthcare ecosystem**

 **consultative sales and business development** 
 , including lead conversion, follow\-ups, treatment/protocol pitching and relationship management.

* Speak with prospective and existing clients to understand their wellness objectives, concerns and expectations.
* Educate consumers about DRIP LABS' wellness services, protocols and consultation pathways using approved medical and clinical information.
* Explain the purpose, process and general benefits of relevant wellness protocols in a clear and responsible manner.
* Communicate complex healthcare and wellness concepts in simple, consumer\-friendly language.

* Explain treatment/protocol journeys, consultation processes and relevant service information.

* Address consumer objections related to efficacy, safety, process, pricing, commitment and expectations using approved information.
* Convert qualified prospects into consultations, appointments and eligible bookings.
* Maintain structured follow\-ups with prospects who require additional time or information.
* Build long\-term relationships rather than relying on transactional sales.
* Consistently work toward agreed conversion, revenue and customer acquisition objectives.

* Consumers / patients
* Doctors and physicians
* Dermatologists
* Aesthetic practitioners
* Wellness professionals
* Clinic owners
* Healthcare entrepreneurs
* Hospital / clinic personnel
* Wellness center partners
* Distribution and channel partners

* Communicating DRIP LABS' services and protocols to healthcare professionals and relevant stakeholders.
* Supporting physician and clinic conversations with accurate product/service information.
* Understanding stakeholder requirements and coordinating internally with medical and commercial teams.
* Supporting onboarding and relationship development with relevant healthcare partners.
* Building credibility through professional, medically responsible communication.



  





**5\. Product \& Protocol Learning** 




 DRIP LABS operates in a rapidly evolving segment.
 



 Therefore, the candidate must be a
 **fast learner with strong curiosity about healthcare and emerging wellness science.** 




 You will be expected to quickly develop working knowledge of areas such as:
 


* IV wellness therapy
* Nutritional IV protocols
* NAD\+ and cellular wellness
* Recovery and performance
* Healthy aging and longevity
* Vitamins and micronutrients
* Antioxidant and nutritional protocols
* Wellness optimization
* Medical aesthetics
* Preventive wellness
* Lifestyle and performance wellness
* Emerging longevity technologies



 Prior knowledge of every category is
 **not mandatory** 
 .
 



 However, the ability to understand new scientific concepts quickly, learn protocols systematically and communicate them accurately is essential.
 



  





**7\. CRM \& Reporting** 



* Maintain accurate customer and lead information in the CRM.
* Document call outcomes, customer requirements, follow\-ups and appointment status.
* Maintain systematic follow\-up schedules.
* Track lead movement through the sales funnel.
* Maintain daily and weekly activity reports.
* Monitor consultation and conversion performance.



**Key Performance Areas / KRAs** 




 Performance will be evaluated across
 **both commercial performance and quality of healthcare communication.**




**Medical Counseling** 



* Quality of client conversations
* Accuracy of information communicated
* Understanding of customer requirements
* Appropriate escalation to clinical teams
* Customer trust and satisfaction



**Sales \& Conversion** 



* Qualified leads handled

**Operational Excellence** 



* CRM accuracy

* Appointment coordination
* Reporting quality

 **already worked within a healthcare or healthcare\-adjacent ecosystem**

* Healthcare\-aware

**About Minimalix** 




 Minimalix is building a technology\-enabled growth platform for the interior design and home renovation ecosystem.
 



 We help interior designers, contractors and professionals grow their businesses through pre\-qualified project leads, design services and growth solutions.
 



 As an early\-stage company, we are looking for people who don't just want to "do an internship" — but want to build, sell, experiment and learn how a real business grows from the ground up.
 



  





**About the Role** 




 We are looking for a Founding Sales \& Growth Intern to work closely with the founder and take ownership of key parts of our sales and growth engine.
 



 You will be involved in everything from prospecting and customer conversations to sales strategy, experiments, partnerships, CRM, growth campaigns and revenue generation.
 



 This is a highly hands\-on role. You will get the opportunity to understand how an early\-stage company actually works — from finding the right customer to closing the deal and building repeatable growth systems.
 



  





**What You’ll Do** 




 Sales \& Revenue
 


* Identify and research potential customers across the interior design ecosystem.
* Build and manage prospect lists and sales pipelines.
* Reach out to prospects through calls, WhatsApp, email, LinkedIn and other channels.
* Conduct discovery conversations and understand customer requirements.
* Follow up with prospects and move opportunities through the sales funnel.
* Assist in closing deals and achieving monthly revenue targets.
* Track sales activities, conversions and customer feedback.



 Growth \& Experimentation
 


* Identify new channels to acquire customers.
* Design and execute small growth experiments.
* Test different messaging, offers, pricing and outreach strategies.
* Analyze what is working and double down on high\-performing channels.
* Support Meta, Google, WhatsApp and other growth campaigns where required.
* Research competitors, market trends and customer behavior.



 Founder’s Office / Business Building
 


* Work directly with the founder on high\-priority business problems.
* Help create sales processes, SOPs and growth playbooks.
* Turn customer feedback into actionable business insights.
* Assist with partnerships and strategic initiatives.
* Take ownership of projects from idea → execution → results.
* Bring new ideas instead of waiting for instructions.



  





**What We’re Looking For** 




 You don't need a perfect resume. We care more about hunger, ownership and ability to execute.
 



 You could be a great fit if you:
 


* Are highly ambitious and genuinely interested in startups and entrepreneurship.
* Are comfortable speaking with strangers and starting conversations.
* Have strong communication and persuasion skills.
* Are proactive and don't need constant supervision.
* Think commercially and understand that revenue matters.
* Are comfortable with rejection and persistent with follow\-ups.
* Can work with spreadsheets, CRM tools and basic analytics.
* Learn quickly and are willing to figure things out independently.
* Prefer execution over endless discussions.



  





**Bonus Points If You Have** 



* Previous experience in sales, business development, growth or startups.
* Experience with WhatsApp/LinkedIn outreach.
* Experience with CRM tools.
* Basic understanding of Meta Ads or Google Ads.
* Experience running cold outreach or lead\-generation campaigns.
* Strong Excel/Google Sheets skills.
* A track record of building something independently — a business, community, project, college initiative or side hustle.



  





**What You’ll Learn** 




 This isn't an internship where your primary responsibility is making reports.
 



 You will learn:
 


* How to build a sales pipeline from zero.
* How to qualify and convert customers.
* How to conduct real sales conversations.
* How startups acquire and retain customers.
* How to design and test growth experiments.
* How pricing and offers influence conversion.
* How to use data to make business decisions.
* How to work directly with a founder.
* How a business moves from idea → customer → revenue → scale.



  





**Why Join Minimalix?** 



* Work directly with the Founder
* High ownership from Day 1
* Real exposure to sales, growth and business strategy
* Performance\-based incentives
* Opportunity for full\-time conversion
* Fast learning environment with minimal bureaucracy
* Build something meaningful instead of doing repetitive internship work
* Your work will directly contribute to company revenue and growth



  





**Performance \& Growth** 




 We believe high performers should grow quickly.
 



 Candidates who consistently demonstrate ownership, execution and revenue impact may be considered for a full\-time role with increased responsibility and compensation after the internship.
 



  





**Who Should NOT Apply** 




 This role may not be for you if you:
 


* Need step\-by\-step instructions for every task.
* Are uncomfortable with sales or cold outreach.
* Give up quickly after rejection.
* Prefer a predictable 9\-to\-5 internship with limited responsibility.
* Are primarily looking for a certificate rather than experience.



  





**Who Should Apply** 




 If you want to learn how to sell, build and grow a real company — this is for you.
 



 We are looking for someone who can say:
 


 “Give me a problem. I’ll figure it out.”
   

**How to Apply** 

 Send your CV \+ a short introduction explaining:
 



 “Why do you think you can help Minimalix grow?”
 



 📩 internships@minimalix.in

title: Business Executive - Delhi
description:

By 2031, we aim to deliver £40 billion in annual sales, leveraging our existing strong performance momentum to significantly increase our positive impact on the health of billions of patients globally. Our Ahead Together strategy is centred on early intervention to prevent and alter the course of disease, thereby protecting people and supporting healthcare systems.
   

  

 Our diverse portfolio consists of vaccines, specialty medicines, and general medicines.
   

  

 Through continuous innovation and a dedicated focus on scientific and technical excellence, we strive to develop and launch new, groundbreaking treatments that address critical health challenges. Position Summary You will lead commercial growth and customer engagement across an assigned territory in India. You will build trusted, professional relationships with healthcare teams and institutional partners. You will design and deliver territory plans that drive business results and support better patient outcomes. We value clear communicators who act with integrity, curiosity and practical commercial thinking. This role offers visible impact, strong learning, and the chance to work with colleagues uniting science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. Responsibilities This role will provide YOU the opportunity to lead key activities to progress YOUR career. Why You? Basic Qualification We are seeking professionals with the following required skills and qualifications to help us achieve our goals: \- Bachelor’s degree in any discipline; science, pharmacy or medical background is an advantage. \- 1–3 years of customer\-facing experience in sales, field roles or account management. \- Strong verbal and written communication skills in English and relevant local languages. \- Comfortable using everyday digital tools such as Word, Excel and mobile apps. \- Valid driver’s license and willingness to travel regularly within the assigned territory. \- Customer\-focused mindset with integrity and a commitment to ethical behaviour. Preferred Qualification If you have the following characteristics, it would be a plus: \- Prior experience in healthcare, hospital or pharmaceutical field roles. \- Ability to interpret and explain clinical or scientific information clearly to different audiences. \- Planning and analytical skills to develop and monitor territory performance. \- Experience organising professional meetings or educational events. \- Comfortable working independently and as part of a team. \- Fluency in additional local languages. Work pattern and location This role is on\-site in India with regular travel across the assigned territory. **Why GSK?**

 GSK is a global biopharma company with a purpose to unite science, technology and talent to get ahead of disease together. We aim to positively impact the health of 2\.5 billion people by the end of the decade, as a successful, growing company where people can thrive. We get ahead of disease by preventing and treating it with innovation in specialty medicines and vaccines. We focus on four therapeutic areas: respiratory, immunology and inflammation; oncology; HIV; and infectious diseases – to impact health at scale.
   

  

 People and patients around the world count on the medicines and vaccines we make, so we’re committed to creating an environment where our people can thrive and focus on what matters most.  Demould is a fast\-growing bakery brand that began as a home\-based venture and now serves the wider Delhi\-NCR region with a central kitchen in Mayapuri, Gifting Studio in Kirti Nagar (Delhi Gifting Company) and a store in Rohini Sector 7\. Founded by Shiv Kumar Madan, Demould is driven by a strong passion for baking and a commitment to quality at every stage of production. The team focuses on delivering exceptional taste, innovative offerings, and appealing packaging, all centered around customer satisfaction. Applicants joining Demould will be part of a growing brand that values creativity, reliability, and consistent service excellence.
 



  





**Role:\-** 
 The Business Development Manager role at Demould is a full\-time, on\-site position based in Delhi, India. This role is responsible for identifying and pursuing new business opportunities, including corporate clients, event planners, and institutional partners, to drive sales growth across the Delhi\-NCR region. Day\-to\-day responsibilities include building and maintaining client relationships, conducting market research, negotiating contracts, and creating proposals and presentations that reflect Demould’s product range and brand values. The Business Development Manager will collaborate closely with the operations, marketing, and product teams to design promotional campaigns, plan seasonal offerings, and ensure that customer feedback informs business decisions. This role also involves monitoring performance metrics, preparing regular sales reports, and recommending strategies to expand market presence and enhance revenue.
 



  





**Detailed Description:\-** 



* Business Development – Generate leads through corporates, event/wedding planners, hotels, cafés, schools, hospitals, co\-working spaces, gifting companies, and luxury brands. Develop new sales channels for bakery products, premium gifting, customized hampers, desserts, and corporate solutions.
* Relationship Management – Build and maintain long\-term client relationships; negotiate terms and drive repeat business.
* Sales Ownership – Manage the end\-to\-end pipeline alongside the Sales Head, personally handle key accounts, and consistently exceed monthly/quarterly/annual targets.
* Strategic Planning – Plan ahead for festive and gifting seasons (Diwali, Christmas, Valentine's, weddings, etc.); create monthly action plans and sales calendars to maximize seasonal revenue.
* Marketing \& Brand – Liaise with marketing on updated collateral; represent Demould at trade shows, exhibitions, and networking events.
* Events \& Activations – Identify and execute pop\-ups, flea markets, corporate activations, and experiential events; evaluate ROI for future opportunities.
* Team Leadership – Mentor the BD team, review daily/weekly/monthly performance, and conduct regular coaching sessions.
* CRM \& Reporting – Maintain lead records, submit weekly/monthly sales reports with insights, and track conversion ratios to refine the sales process.
* Cross\-functional Coordination – Partner with operations, production, design, kitchen, and gifting teams to ensure timely, high\-quality delivery.



  





**Key Metrics** 
 : Revenue targets, conversion ratios, seasonal campaign performance, team productivity, and client retention.

* Minimum
 
**1–3 years** 

 of experience in Business Development, Sales, or Corporate Sales.

 will be preferred.
* Strong networking and relationship\-building abilities.
* Excellent negotiation and presentation skills.
* Leadership experience with the ability to manage and motivate a team.
* Highly organised with strong planning and execution skills.
* Comfortable with field sales, client meetings, and business travel across Delhi NCR.
* Self\-driven, target\-oriented, and capable of working independently.
* Familiarity with CRM software, Microsoft Office/Google Workspace and
 
**AI tools.**

title: Business Development Manager
description:
**Business Development Manager – B2B Partnerships (Marketing Agency experience mandatory) \|** 




 4–7 years experience \| \| Location: Paschim Vihar, New Delhi
 



  





**About Social Bird Media** 




 Social Bird Media is a fast\-growing, new\-age influencer marketing agency connecting brands with impactful creators. We focus on building strong brand narratives through creator\-led campaigns and performance\-driven digital strategies across lifestyle, D2C, fintech, and other growing sectors.
 



  





 Our approach combines creativity with data to ensure campaigns not only look good but also deliver measurable results. We work closely with both brands and creators to create meaningful collaborations that drive long\-term value.
 



  





**Role Overview** 




 We are looking for a
 **Business Development Manager – B2B Partnerships** 
 who can take complete ownership of generating new business opportunities and converting them into long\-term partnerships.
 



 In this role, you will be responsible for
 **identifying potential clients, initiating conversations, understanding their business and marketing needs,** 
 and
 **offering relevant solutions** 
 through influencer marketing and digital campaigns. You will also work closely with internal teams to ensure smooth execution and maintain strong relationships with clients even after deal closure.
 



  





**Key Responsibilities** 




  




* **Lead Generation and Pipeline Building**
* You will be responsible for consistently identifying and adding new potential clients to the pipeline. This includes researching brands and agencies, understanding their category, and evaluating whether they are a good fit for influencer or digital marketing campaigns. The goal is to maintain a steady and high\-quality pipeline that can convert into business.



  




* **Outreach and Initial Engagement**
* You will initiate conversations with decision\-makers such as founders, marketing heads, and brand managers through LinkedIn, email, and other channels. The focus will be on introducing Social Bird Media’s capabilities, creating interest, and setting up meaningful discussions.



  




* **Understanding Client Requirements**
* During conversations, you will be expected to understand the client’s objectives, target audience, campaign expectations, and budget. This step is important to ensure that the solutions proposed are relevant and aligned with what the client is looking for.



  




* **Pitching and Proposal Creation**
* Based on client requirements, you will create customised proposals that clearly explain the campaign approach, creator strategy, deliverables, and expected outcomes. The goal is to present ideas in a structured and easy\-to\-understand manner that builds client confidence.



  




* **Deal Closure and Negotiation**
* You will handle commercial discussions, pricing, and negotiations with clients. This includes aligning on deliverables, timelines, and commercials, and ensuring both parties are clear before closing the deal.



  




* **Client Onboarding and Relationship Management**
* After closing a deal, you will ensure a smooth onboarding process by aligning the client with internal teams. You will continue to stay connected with the client to build trust, encourage repeat business, and explore opportunities for long\-term collaboration.



  




* **Collaboration with Influencer Marketing Team**
* You will work closely with the influencer marketing team while preparing campaign approaches. This includes ensuring that creator suggestions are relevant, campaign plans are practical, and the final output shared with clients is well\-structured and professional.



  




* **Coordination with Finance Team**
* You will coordinate with the finance team for generating invoices, tracking payments, and following up with clients when required. This ensures there are no delays in collections and that financial processes run smoothly.



  




* **Tracking and Performance Monitoring**
* You will maintain proper records of all activities including outreach, meetings, proposals, and deals. This helps in understanding what is working, where improvements are needed, and how conversion rates can be improved over time.



  




* **Reporting and Founder Collaboration**
* You will regularly share updates with the founders on business performance. This includes updates on pipeline status, ongoing discussions, deals closed, and revenue generated. You will also be part of review discussions to plan next steps and improve results.



  




* **Market and Industry Awareness**
* You will stay updated with trends in influencer marketing, digital campaigns, and brand collaborations. This will help you have more informed conversations with clients and position Social Bird Media as a knowledgeable and reliable partner.



  





**Required Skills \& Profile** 




  




* **4–7 years of experience** 
 in B2B business development, preferably in a marketing or influencer agency
* Strong understanding of
 **influencer marketing** 
 and how brand collaborations are structured
* Experience in handling the
 **complete sales cycle** 
 from lead generation to closure
* Hands\-on experience with
 **LinkedIn outreach, cold emailing,** 
 and
 **client communication**
* **Good communication** 
 and presentation skills with the ability to explain ideas clearly
* Comfortable
 **handling negotiations** 
 and managing client expectations
* Familiarity with
 **Google Workspace and CRM tools** 
 for tracking and reporting
* Self\-driven, organised, and comfortable working in a target\-oriented environment



  





**Why Join Social Bird Media** 



* Work closely with the founders and be directly involved in business growth
* Opportunity to work with brands across different industries
* High ownership role where your work directly impacts revenue
* Fast\-paced environment with strong learning opportunities
* Competitive fixed compensation along with performance\-based incentives

**Company:**

 Fully Remote

 5 days a week (part\-time)
 



**Openings:** 
 2

 Freshers and college students welcome

 Performance\-based internship
 



**Stipend:** 
 ₹1,000 per month
 



**Performance Incentive:** 
 10% commission on successfully converted PR client deals
 



**Potential:** 
 Opportunity for conversion to a permanent role based on performance
 


 About Romit PR
 
 Romit PR is a Delhi\-based public relations and digital PR consultancy helping startups, SMEs, founders and organisations build media visibility, thought leadership and credibility.
 



 We work with businesses and founders to develop newsworthy stories, secure media visibility and strengthen their reputation through strategic public relations and digital communications.
 



 We are looking for ambitious college students who want practical exposure to
 **business development, sales, PR, founder branding and client acquisition** 
 .
 



 This is not a traditional desk\-based internship. You will work on real prospects, communicate with business owners and decision\-makers, build a sales pipeline and contribute directly to acquiring PR clients.
 


 About the Role
 
 As a
 **Business Development \& Client Acquisition Intern** 
 , you will help Romit PR identify potential clients and initiate conversations with founders, entrepreneurs, startups, SMEs and organisations that may require PR, media visibility, founder branding or digital PR services.
 



 You will work remotely and closely with the founder to understand prospects, develop outreach approaches and follow up with potential clients.
 



 This role is particularly suitable for students interested in:
 


* Business development
* Sales
* Public relations
* Marketing
* Communications
* Media
* Entrepreneurship
* Startups



 The role will give you practical exposure to how a professional services company identifies prospects, approaches decision\-makers, develops relationships and converts opportunities into paying clients.
 


 Key ResponsibilitiesLead Generation \& Prospect Research
 * Research and identify potential PR clients across startups, SMEs, founders and growing businesses.
* Build and maintain a qualified prospect list.
* Identify founders, CEOs, marketing heads, communications professionals and other relevant decision\-makers.
* Research companies to understand their business, growth plans, announcements and potential PR requirements.
* Identify businesses and founders that could benefit from media visibility and thought leadership.

 * Conduct professional outreach through LinkedIn, email, WhatsApp and other appropriate channels.
* Initiate conversations with potential clients.
* Introduce Romit PR and its services to relevant prospects.
* Understand a prospect's business and communication requirements.
* Follow up consistently with potential clients.
* Maintain professional relationships with prospects throughout the sales process.
* Coordinate qualified prospects with the founder for further discussions, meetings and proposals.


 Sales Pipeline Management
 * Maintain accurate prospect and follow\-up information in Google Sheets or the company's CRM.
* Track outreach, responses, meetings, follow\-ups and conversions.
* Ensure that no qualified prospect is missed due to inadequate follow\-up.
* Provide regular updates on outreach activity and business development progress.
* Work towards agreed lead\-generation and outreach targets.


 PR \& Market Research
 * Research startups, SMEs, founders and emerging businesses.
* Identify potential PR opportunities and newsworthy business developments.
* Research industry trends, company announcements and relevant business stories.
* Support the team with basic research for PR pitches and client acquisition.


 Performance \& Incentive Structure
 
 This is a
 **performance\-driven internship** 
 .
 


 Fixed Stipend
 
**₹1,000 per month** 



 Client Conversion Commission
 
 You will receive
 **10% commission on the value of every PR client deal successfully converted through your efforts.** 




 For example:
 



 Client Deal Value10%
 



 There is
 **no upper limit on commission earnings** 
 .
 



 Commission will apply when a prospect generated and developed through the intern's efforts becomes a paying Romit PR client. Commission will be payable subject to the client payment being successfully received by Romit PR.
 



 The exact attribution of a client to an intern will be determined based on the prospect's source, outreach activity, communication history and contribution to the conversion.
 


 What You Will Learn
 
 During the internship, you will get practical exposure to:
 


* B2B business development
* Client acquisition
* Lead generation
* Sales prospecting
* LinkedIn outreach
* Email outreach
* Lead qualification
* Founder and CXO communication
* PR and media services
* Client pitching
* Sales pipeline management
* Follow\-up strategy
* Consultative selling
* Startup and SME ecosystem
* Founder branding
* Public relations



 You will get exposure to the
 **early\-stage client acquisition process** 
 , from identifying a prospect and initiating contact to developing the relationship and eventually converting the prospect into a client.
 


 What You Will Receive
 
 Successful interns will receive:
 


 Internship Experience Certificate
 
 An
 **Internship Experience Certificate from Romit PR** 
 upon successful completion of the internship.
 


 Letter of Recommendation
 
 A
 **Letter of Recommendation from Romit PR** 
 , based on the intern's performance, contribution, professionalism and achievements during the internship.
 


 Practical Industry Experience
 
 You will work on real business development opportunities rather than simulated college projects.
 



 You will gain experience communicating with founders, entrepreneurs, business owners and senior decision\-makers.
 


 Professional Exposure
 
 You will understand how a PR consultancy develops its business pipeline, approaches potential clients and converts opportunities into revenue.
 


 Career Opportunity
 
**Successful interns may be considered for conversion into a permanent role with Romit PR** 
 , based on their performance, consistency, client acquisition results and overall contribution during the internship.
 



 High\-performing interns may have the opportunity to continue with Romit PR in a full\-time
 **Business Development, Client Acquisition or PR\-related role** 
 .
 


 Who Should Apply?
 
 We are looking for students who:
 


* Are currently pursuing a college or university degree.
* Are based in
 **Delhi NCR or Bengaluru** 
 .
* Can commit to working
 **5 days a week** 
 .
* Are comfortable working remotely.
* Have good spoken and written English.
* Are confident communicating with new people.
* Are interested in sales, business development, PR, marketing or entrepreneurship.
* Are comfortable using LinkedIn, email and WhatsApp professionally.
* Can conduct basic online research.
* Are willing to make consistent follow\-ups.
* Are self\-motivated and comfortable working with targets.
* Can manage their time effectively while working remotely.
* Are willing to learn and take ownership of their work.



**Students from any academic background can apply.** 




 Students pursuing BBA, B.Com, BA, BJMC, mass communication, journalism, marketing, management, entrepreneurship or related courses may find the role particularly relevant, but these are not mandatory requirements.
 


 Who Would Be a Good Fit?
 
 You may be a good fit for this role if you:
 



**Enjoy talking to people.** 




**Are curious about businesses and startups.** 




**Are comfortable approaching someone you don't know.** 




**Can handle rejection without losing motivation.** 




**Are willing to follow up instead of giving up after one message.** 




**Want to understand how businesses actually acquire clients.** 




 Prior sales or PR experience is
 **not required** 
 . We are more interested in your communication skills, curiosity, consistency and willingness to learn.
 


 Important Note About the Compensation
 
 This is
 **not a conventional fixed\-stipend internship** 
 .
 



 The fixed stipend is
 **₹1,000 per month** 
 , supplemented by a
 **10% commission on successfully converted PR client deals** 
 .
 



 Candidates should apply only if they are genuinely interested in business development, sales and client acquisition and are comfortable with a performance\-linked compensation structure.
 



 The earning potential through commission will depend on the number and value of clients successfully converted.
 


 Location \& Working Arrangement
 
**2 positions available:** 




**Position 1:** 
 Delhi NCR
 



**Position 2:** 
 Bengaluru
 



 The internship is
 **fully remote** 
 .
 



 Candidates must be based in or around Delhi NCR or Bengaluru.
 



 You will be required to work
 **5 days a week** 
 (part\-time) and maintain regular communication with the Romit PR team.
 


 Why Join Romit PR?
 
 This internship is designed for students who want more than a certificate at the end of an internship.
 



 You will get an opportunity to:
 


* Work with a growing PR consultancy.
* Work directly on real business opportunities.
* Communicate with founders and business leaders.
* Learn B2B client acquisition.
* Develop professional sales skills.
* Build confidence in business communication.
* Earn performance\-based commissions.
* Receive an internship experience certificate.
* Receive a performance\-based Letter of Recommendation.
* Potentially transition into a permanent role with Romit PR.


 How to Apply
 
 Send your CV along with a short introduction answering the following to romit@romitpr.com:
 


1. Your college, course and year of study.
2. Why are you interested in business development or PR?
3. How would you find potential PR clients for Romit PR?
4. Why do you believe you would be comfortable approaching founders and business owners?
5. Mention one business, startup or founder you think could benefit from PR and briefly explain why.



  





 Students who are confident, curious and willing to take ownership are encouraged to apply.

description:

 Business Development – Job Description
 




  






 POSITION OVERVIEW
 





 Position Title: Business Development Executive – Events
 





 Department: Atraski Events (Business Development)
 





 Reports To: Head of Business Development – Events
 





 Location: Delhi (Chittaranjan Park / Greater Kailash)
 





 Timings: Monday to Friday and Alternate Saturday
 




  






 About Atraski Events:
 





 Atraski Events is a full\-service experiential marketing and event management division of Atraski, a strategic marketing agency. We design and execute high\-impact corporate events, conferences, product launches, brand activations, and experiential campaigns for marquee clients across technology, FMCG, real estate, finance, and luxury sectors. Our focus is on delivering measurable ROI through strategic storytelling and immersive brand experiences.
 




  






 ROLE PURPOSE:
 





 The Business Development Executive will be responsible for identifying, qualifying, and closing new event and experiential marketing opportunities in the corporate events, conferences, brand activations, and experiential marketing space. This is a hunter role focused on pipeline generation, prospect management, and deal closure in the events vertical.
 




  






 KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
 





 Lead Generation \& Pipeline Development
 



1. Identify and qualify corporate event opportunities, conferences, product launches, and brand activation projects through direct outreach, industry research, and networking
2. Build and maintain a robust pipeline of 40–60 qualified leads at various stages of the sales cycle
3. Conduct market research to identify emerging event categories, corporate restructuring signals, and industry trends
4. Target companies across technology, FMCG, finance, real estate, luxury, pharma, and EdTech sectors with budgets ₹10L–₹1Cr\+



  






 Prospect Engagement \& Relationship Building
 



1. Conduct discovery calls with CMOs, EVPs–Marketing, Event Directors, and procurement stakeholders
2. Present Atraski Events' capabilities through tailored deck presentations and case studies
3. Build executive relationships across client organization (Marketing, HR, Operations, Procurement)
4. Maintain CRM discipline and update deal status, contact notes, and next steps in real\-time



  






 Proposal \& Deal Closure
 



1. Develop tailored event briefs, scope\-of\-work (SOW) documents, and pricing proposals
2. Collaborate with internal delivery, creative, and operations teams to build client\-ready proposals
3. Manage objection\-handling and negotiation cycles through closure
4. Meet quarterly revenue targets (target: ₹2\.5–3Cr annual pipeline contribution)
5. Account Transition \& Stakeholder Alignment
6. Hand off closed deals to Account POC or Vendor with clear delivery briefs and client context
7. Maintain involvement in kickoff meetings to ensure smooth project initiation
8. upport post\-event upsell opportunities and contract renewals



  






 REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS
 





 Experience:
 



1. 3–5 years of B2B sales or business development experience (events, experiential marketing, or agency preferred)
2. Proven track record of closing deals in the ₹15L–₹80L range (event budgets and contracts)
3. Experience managing 40\+ prospect relationships simultaneously with a disciplined pipeline approach
4. Understanding of corporate event ecosystem (conferences, annual meetings, product launches, brand activations)



  






 Education \& Credentials
 



1. Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or related field (MBA preferred but not required)
2. Fluency in English and Hindi (conversational and professional)



  






 Technical \& Tool Proficiency:
 



1. Proficiency in CRM tools (Salesforce, Zoho, or equivalent) and sales methodologies (SPIN, MEDDIC, or similar)
2. Advanced MS Word, Excel, and PowerPoint skills
3. Comfortable with virtual meetings, screen sharing, and remote collaboration tools



  






 CORE COMPETENCIES
 



1. Sales Excellence: Ability to qualify leads, navigate complex decision\-making units, and close deals
2. Resilience \& Persistence: Comfort with rejection; ability to maintain momentum through a long sales cycle
3. Executive Presence: Ability to communicate with C\-suite and stakeholders with confidence and credibility
4. Consultative Approach: Focus on understanding client needs before pitching solutions
5. Organizational Skills: CRM discipline, follow\-up rigor, and ability to manage multiple concurrent negotiations
6. Problem\-Solving: Ability to customize proposals and handle objections creatively
7. Teamwork: Strong collaboration with internal teams to deliver client promises



  






 Benefits:
 





 • 12 PTO days \+ public holidays
 





 • Flexible work arrangement (office\-based with remote flexibility for client meetings)
 





 • Access to Atraski's full suite of tools (CRM, design, analytics, brand resources)
 




  






 WORK ENVIRONMENT \& CULTURE
 





 • Fast\-paced, founder\-driven agency environment with direct visibility to leadership
 





 • Collaborative cross\-functional teams (creative, production, accounts, operations)
 





 • Access to high\-profile clients and marquee event projects
 





 • Focus on results, ownership, and impact over process
 





 • Regular team engagement and professional development opportunities
 




  






 HOW TO APPLY
 





 Interested candidates should submit:
 





 • Detailed resume highlighting sales achievements and deal closure metrics
 





 • Cover letter describing your interest in events/experiential marketing
 





 • 2–3 references from previous employers/clients
 




  






 Email: anish.dhar@atraski.com and hr@atraski.com
 





 Subject: BD – Events Application \| \[Your Name]
 





 Atraski is an equal\-opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to creating an inclusive environment.

description:
About the job
 



  





 Hiring: Fashion Business Consultant
 



  





 Company: LA People
 



 Location: Delhi, India (Remote)
 



 Employment Type: Full\-time
 



 Industry: Apparel / Fashion Manufacturing / Production
 



  





 About LA People
 



  





 LA People is building the manufacturing partner that fashion founders actually need — an end to end studio that takes an idea from a single reference sketch all the way to a finished, dispatched garment, without the minimum order requirements that shut most first\-time founders out.
 



  





 We own our production, our sampling studio, and our QC process ourselves, no middlemen between the client and the people actually making their garment. We're looking for someone sharp, organised, and genuinely good with people to be the first real conversation every founder has with us.
 



  





 Role Overview
 



  





 As a Fashion Consultant, you'll manage the full journey of turning an inbound inquiry into a confirmed, paying client. This role requires someone who can represent LA People with real confidence, communicate our process clearly, and coordinate closely with our design and production teams to make sure every client's onboarding is smooth from the very first message. You'll play a central role in building LA People's client base as we grow.
 



  





 Key Responsibilities
 



  





 • Respond to inbound leads from Instagram, WhatsApp, and Google ads
 



 • Assist the Apparel Brands with the Onboarding process
 



 • Follow up rigorously to make sure no lead goes cold
 



 • Maintain a clean, accurate lead and order pipeline
 



 • Ensure a smooth handover from sales to our design team once an order is confirmed
 



 • Track advance payments and pending balances across every order
 



 • Contribute to building a genuinely scalable sales process for LA People
 



  





 Who are we looking for?
 



  





 We're looking for someone who is:
 



  





 \* 6 months \- 1\.5 years of experience in sales, business development, or client\-facing roles
 



 \*Comfortable engaging with fashion/design terminology — a background in fashion designing or merchandising is a strong plus.
 



 \* Highly organised and genuinely strong with follow\-ups
 



 \* Calm under pressure and comfortable managing sales chaos
 



 \* Detail\-oriented, with a basic understanding of the manufacturing process
 



 \* Practical, solution\-oriented, and execution\-focused
 



 \* Comfortable working in a fast\-moving, hands\-on environment
 



 \* Able to balance speed with hitting real targets
 



 \* Comfortable with Excel/Google Sheets for tracking leads and orders
 



 \* A confident communicator with real client\-handling and negotiation instinct
 



 \* Capable of managing multiple leads at once without letting any slip
 



  





 Why Join LA People?
 



  





 At LA People, you'll be at the intersection of fashion, craft, and real ownership. This isn't a role where you're managing a network of outside vendors — you're selling something we actually build ourselves, which means every conversation you have is backed by a process you can stand behind completely.
 



  





 If you understand how chaotic and unreliable this industry can feel from a founder's side, and you want to be part of building the manufacturer that actually fixes that — we'd love to hear from you.
 



  





 Base Salary: ₹20,000–25000/month, plus performance\-based incentive.
 



  





 How to apply
 



  





 Send your resume to contact@lapeople.in, subject line: "Application – Fashion Business Consultant at LA People"

title: Senior Solutions Lead (Pre-Sales & Implementation)
description:
**About This Job**
**Knowmax**
**Location:** 
 Gurugram, Haryana, India
   

  

**Work Mode:** 
 On\-site
   

  

**Industry:** 
 Technology, Information and Internet
   

  

**Job Description**
 Knowmax is an AI Knowledge Management platform built for enterprise CX teams. Telecom, BFSI, healthcare and BPO leaders use us to turn scattered process documentation into guided, AI\-ready answers their agents and customers can act on, across every channel.
   

  

 Governed knowledge that drives action. That is the whole idea.
   

  

 We are part of the KocharTech group, and we serve enterprise customers across North America, the GCC, Southeast Asia and APAC. The US is our biggest growth bet right now, and this role sits close to it.
   

  

 THE ROLE
   

  

 You win the deal, then you deliver it.
   

  

 Most companies split this into two jobs and lose something in the handover. The promise made in the demo quietly becomes someone else's problem at kickoff. We keep it in one pair of hands. You shape the technical solution during the sales cycle, then own the implementation once the contract is signed.
   

  

 Roughly half your time is pre\-sales: discovery, demos, proofs of concept, RFPs. The other half is implementation: configuration, integrations, go\-live, early adoption. In practice the split flexes week to week with whatever is closing or going live.
   

  

 You will be the technical face of Knowmax to enterprise buyers and the steady hand that gets them live. This is a hands\-on, high\-ownership individual contributor seat, not a people management track.
   

  

**What You Will Own**
 Pre\-sales
   

  

 Run technical discovery. Map the prospect's contact centre stack, content estate and integration surface before anyone promises anythingBuild and deliver tailored demos and proofs of concept against the buyer's actual use cases, not a generic scriptOwn the technical sections of RFPs, RFIs and security questionnairesWork alongside sales as the trusted technical advisor through the deal cycleTranslate requirements into clear solution designs, scopes of work and timelines we can actually holdCall out the deals we should not chase. A clean no early is worth more to us than a messy yes.
   

  

 Implementation
   

  

 Own enterprise implementations end to end, from kickoff to go\-liveConfigure the platform, run integrations across CRM, CCaaS, ticketing, SSO and APIs, and oversee content migrationRun onboarding and enablement so customer teams genuinely adopt what we build, not just receive itCoordinate across customer success, engineering and product to clear blockersBuild the implementation playbooks, templates and documentation that make the next ten deployments faster than the last
   

  

**What The First Six Months Look Like**
 Month 1: fluent in the product. Shadowing live deals and one active implementationMonth 3: running discovery and demos independently, and owning at least one enterprise implementation through to go\-liveMonth 6: the default technical voice on our largest pursuits, with a documented implementation playbook a new joiner can follow
   

  

**What You Bring**
 Must have
   

  

 6 to 10 years in solutions engineering, technical pre\-sales, implementation or customer\-facing technical delivery, ideally in enterprise SaaSWorking command of enterprise integrations: REST APIs, webhooks, SSO and SAML, and the common CX stack (Salesforce, Zendesk, ServiceNow, Genesys, Amazon Connect, Cisco, Freshworks, Microsoft Dynamics)Enough fluency in how modern AI knowledge systems work to lead a credible discovery conversation: retrieval quality, grounding answers in source content, handling accuracy and hallucination concerns, and what it takes to get a customer's content AI\-readyPresence with both technical evaluators and business sponsors, often in the same roomHands\-on configuration ability. You are comfortable in the detail of a deployment, not just the diagram of oneExperience carrying enterprise security and compliance conversations: SOC 2, data residency, access controlWriting that holds up. Solution documents, scopes and responses a CIO will actually readEngineering background is a must
   

  

 Nice to have
   

  

 Contact centre or CX domain backgroundExposure to US, GCC or Southeast Asia enterprise buyersMultilingual or Arabic deployment experienceTime at a company scaling from early traction to repeatable enterprise delivery
   

  

 THE PRACTICAL STUFF
   

  

 Based in Gurgaon, WFOOur customers sit in North America, EMEA and APAC, so part of your day shifts earlier or later to meet them. That is a flexed schedule, not extra hours stacked on top of a full office dayOccasional travel for key customer engagements. Frequency depends on the accounts you support
   

  

 WHY THIS SEAT
   

  

 You report to the CTO and work close to the leadership team. You will see a deal from first call to first value, which is rare in enterprise software and hard to learn any other way. The playbooks and documentation you build become how the company sells and delivers as we scale in the US and the GCC.
   

  

 If you like both selling the vision and making it real, this is the seat.
