title: Technical Sales Executive
description:
**Key Information** 



* **Experience:** 
 4–6 years
* **Industry:** 
 Engineering Systems / Industrial Water \& Wastewater / Industrial Equipment
* **Employment Type:** 
 Full\-time
* **Role Type:** 
 Individual Contributor



**About Pristine Water** 




 Pristine Water is an engineering company providing innovative water and wastewater treatment solutions to industrial, commercial, agricultural and institutional customers. Our solutions include electrochemical water and wastewater treatment systems, disinfection systems, water treatment and process solutions.
 



 We are looking for a Technical Sales Executive who can independently drive sales in an assigned geography—from identifying new opportunities and developing customer relationships to preparing and negotiating offers and closing orders.
 



**The Role** 




 This is a hands\-on individual contributor sales role. The person will be responsible for executing the company’s sales strategy in the assigned region and building a strong pipeline of new and repeat business.
 



 The ideal candidate will be someone who is comfortable selling technical/engineering systems, can understand customer requirements, identify upcoming projects, engage with multiple stakeholders and take an opportunity through the complete sales cycle.
 



**Key Responsibilities** 




**Business Development \& New Customer Acquisition** 



* Identify and develop new customers and business opportunities within the assigned region.
* Prospect through direct outreach, market mapping, references, industry networks, exhibitions, consultants and other channels.
* Meet customers, understand their requirements and identify opportunities where Pristine Water’s solutions can add value.
* Develop and maintain a healthy pipeline of prospective customers and projects.



**Project \& Market Tracking** 



* Identify and track new industrial, infrastructure, commercial and other relevant projects coming up in the region.
* Develop relationships with consultants, EPC companies, contractors, OEMs, project developers and other relevant stakeholders.
* Monitor project timelines, decision\-makers, technical requirements and procurement processes.
* Ensure that Pristine Water is introduced and considered early in relevant projects.



**Technical Sales** 



* Understand customer requirements and work with the technical team to identify appropriate solutions.
* Discuss technical requirements and system configurations with customers and consultants.
* Prepare and present commercial and technical proposals in coordination with the internal team.
* Explain the benefits, applications and commercial value of Pristine Water’s solutions to customers.



**Sales Closure** 



* Follow up systematically on enquiries, proposals and active opportunities.
* Negotiate commercial terms and offers with customers within company guidelines.
* Manage the sales process from initial enquiry through technical discussions, commercial negotiations and purchase order.
* Take ownership of achieving sales targets and converting the assigned pipeline into orders.



**Customer Relationship Management** 



* Maintain regular contact with existing customers and develop long\-term relationships.
* Identify repeat business, upgrades, expansions and additional opportunities within existing accounts.
* Ensure that customer requirements and commitments are communicated effectively to the internal team.
* Maintain accurate records of customers, opportunities, project status and follow\-ups.



**What We Are Looking For** 



* 4–6 years of experience in sales, preferably in technical sales of engineering systems, industrial equipment, water/wastewater treatment systems, process equipment, electrical/mechanical systems, or similar products.
* Experience selling B2B technical or engineered solutions will be strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to independently develop new customers and close sales.
* Ability to understand customer requirements and have meaningful technical discussions with customers and consultants.
* Strong follow\-up and negotiation skills.
* Good understanding of the complete sales cycle—from lead generation to order closure.
* Willingness to travel extensively within the assigned region for customer and project meetings.
* Excellent English communication skills, both written and spoken, are essential.
* Should be confident interacting with customers, consultants, contractors and senior decision\-makers.
* Should be self\-driven, organized and comfortable working independently.



**Education** 




*Educational qualification is not a constraint.* 




 The candidate must have:
 


* Completed schooling, and
* A graduate\-level qualification, diploma or equivalent professional qualification.



 A strong track record in technical sales will be valued more highly than the specific academic discipline or institution.
 



**Who Will Succeed in This Role?** 




 We are looking for someone who:
 


* Is a hunter, not someone who waits for enquiries to come in.
* Enjoys meeting customers and developing relationships.
* Is comfortable understanding and selling technical products.
* Takes ownership of opportunities and follows them through to closure.
* Is persistent with follow\-ups without being overly aggressive.
* Can work independently and manage their own territory and pipeline.
* Is commercially minded and comfortable negotiating.
* Is curious about how engineering systems work and can learn new technologies quickly.
* Is accountable for results and sales numbers.



**What This Role Is Not** 




 This is
 *not a team\-management role* 
 . The position is for an individual contributor who will personally develop the market, manage customer relationships, track projects, build the sales pipeline and close business.
 



**Key Performance Indicators** 




 Success in this role will be measured through:
 


* New customers acquired
* Qualified sales pipeline developed
* New projects identified and converted
* Sales/orders achieved
* Conversion of enquiries and opportunities
* Repeat business from existing customers
* Customer and consultant relationships developed
* Timeliness and quality of opportunity follow\-up



 If you enjoy technical selling, building relationships and taking ownership of a territory from prospecting to closure, we’d like to hear from you.

title: Field Sales Engineer
description:
**Company Description** 
 Aurassure is a climate intelligence company that helps governments, industries, and enterprises monitor and respond to environmental challenges using AI\-powered insights and hyperlocal data. Its integrated platform combines advanced IoT sensing, artificial intelligence, hyperlocal weather modeling, environmental analytics, and predictive forecasting to provide real\-time visibility into air quality, weather, heat stress, industrial emissions, flood risk, indoor environmental quality, and other climate parameters. Aurassure’s solutions support sectors such as Smart Cities, Manufacturing, Mining, Oil \& Gas, Construction, Transportation, Airports, Healthcare, Real Estate, Utilities, Education, and Climate Risk \& Insurance. With deployments in more than 350 cities across over 10 countries, the company processes billions of environmental data points to enable faster, data\-driven decisions. Aurassure is committed to using trusted data and climate intelligence to help organizations build safer, healthier, and more resilient communities while advancing global sustainability.
 



**Role Description** 
 This is a full\-time Field Sales Engineer role based in New Delhi with a hybrid work arrangement, combining on\-site client engagement and limited work\-from\-home flexibility. The Field Sales Engineer will generate new business opportunities, manage the sales cycle, and support existing accounts by presenting Aurassure’s climate intelligence solutions to prospective and current clients. Daily responsibilities include conducting site visits and product demonstrations, understanding customer technical and operational needs, and proposing tailored solutions in collaboration with internal technical and product teams. The role also involves preparing proposals, coordinating pricing and negotiations, maintaining accurate sales and pipeline records, and ensuring timely follow\-up to drive conversions. The Field Sales Engineer will work closely with cross\-functional teams to support implementations, gather customer feedback, and contribute to market insights and sales strategy.
 



**Qualifications** 







* Candidates should possess strong Sales Engineering and Electrical Engineering skills to understand customer environments, interpret technical requirements, and translate Aurassure’s solutions into practical applications.
* Candidates should possess Sales and Sales Management skills to build pipelines, manage end\-to\-end sales cycles, and meet or exceed revenue and growth targets.
* Candidates should possess Account Management skills to maintain long\-term client relationships, support post\-sales engagement, and identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities.
* Relevant experience in climate tech, IoT, environmental monitoring, or related technology\-driven solutions is beneficial.
* Strong communication, presentation, and negotiation skills, with the ability to explain technical concepts to both technical and non\-technical stakeholders.
* Ability to work independently in the field, manage travel within and around New Delhi, and collaborate effectively with remote and on\-site teams.
* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Environmental Sciences, or a related technical discipline is preferred; equivalent practical experience will also be considered.
* Comfort

title: Sales Development Representative
description:
Apply by commenting on this IG Reel → https://www.instagram.com/p/DdT8eV8zZ7w
 




  





 Spur (https://spur.so) is an agentic CRM for businesses that sell to consumers over chat. 600\+ businesses across 50\+ countries run on Spur, around 5 million conversations a month: ecommerce brands first, and increasingly anyone whose customers message them on WhatsApp and Instagram, from real estate and travel to education, clinics and services. Every WhatsApp, Instagram, Facebook, email and live chat message lands in one inbox with AI handling most of it, and the same platform runs their campaigns, lead follow\-up, abandoned cart recovery and website conversion.
 



  





 We're bootstrapped and profitable. Zero external funding, zero marketing spend. Every customer we have today came from product quality, word of mouth, referrals and partnerships. We're 12 people: 2 founders, 3 engineers, 5 in customer success, 1 founding marketer, 1 AE.
 



  





**Role Description** 




 We have never had an SDR. New businesses sign up to Spur every single day, from D2C brands to real estate brokers and coaching institutes. Demo forms come in around the clock from India, the Gulf, Europe and the Americas. Our Instagram DMs fill up whenever the content does its job. Most of it goes cold, because nobody gets to it fast enough.
 



  





 That's this seat. You'll call the signups, the demo requests and the DMs, work out what they're actually trying to fix, and get them onto a demo. You'll call people who have already booked one to make sure they show up, because an AE sitting on an empty call is the most expensive thing we do. You'll call our own customers too: the ones who should be on an annual plan, the ones who have outgrown their tier, and the ones who are paying for Spur and using a tenth of it. And you'll build the automations that make next month faster than this one.
 



  





 This is a founding role in the real sense. There is no playbook to inherit and no manager above you running the process. You write it, and the first version will be wrong, which is fine as long as the second one is better.
 



  





**You'll probably be a fit if you** 



* Have worked inbound before and can tell us how many leads a day you handled and what share of them booked
* Get to a new lead in minutes, not tomorrow morning, and can explain how you made that possible
* Have moved a show\-up rate and know what actually did it
* Use AI daily and have built something, even a no\-code automation, to kill a repetitive task
* Write down what works, so the next person can run it without you in the room



  





**Bonus points** 



* You've sold to Shopify or D2C brands, or worked at a Shopify app
* You've called customers in the UK, Europe, the Middle East or South America. Half our customers are outside India
* You know the WhatsApp Business API world from the inside (ex\-BiteSpeed, AiSensy, Wati, Interakt, etc.)



  





**Logistics** 



* Five days a week in our Green Park, Delhi office
* You'll work with both founders, the AE who takes your demos, and the CS team who talk to customers all day
* Appraisals every 12 months. Our motto: if Spur grows, the team should be the first to benefit



  





**How to apply** 




 Apply by commenting on this IG Reel → https://www.instagram.com/p/DdT8eV8zZ7w
 



  





 The form asks which role you're applying for, so one link covers both. We read every response, and you'll hear back either way.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE
 



 At Buzz \| Atraski India
 



  





  





 ABOUT ATRASKI INDIA
 



  





 Atraski is a multi\-dimensional creative holding company powering a portfolio of consumer, B2B, and experiential brands. We operate at the intersection of strategy, creative excellence, and technology—building sustainable, scalable businesses across diverse verticals.
 



  





 Our verticals include:
 



 \- At Buzz: Digital marketing and creative agency (flagship vertical)
 



 \- Atraski Studios: Fashion marketing and creative production
 



 \- Atraski Experiences: Event management and experiential activation
 



 \- At Stay: Curated travel and hospitality experiences
 



 \- Jheeni: Heritage block\-printed sustainable fashion
 



 \- My City My Voice: Regional talent and community storytelling platform
 



 \- Atraski Tech Transformations (ATT): Digital transformation consulting
 



  





 ABOUT AT BUZZ
 



  





 At Buzz is our core creative agency focused on high\-growth D2C brands, B2B SaaS, FMCG, fashion, and EdTech clients. We deliver end\-to\-end solutions: brand strategy, performance marketing, content production, and media planning. Currently managing 39–45 active accounts with annual revenue in the ₹4–6 Cr range.
 



  





 We're looking for hungry, strategic Business Development leaders to drive our next phase of growth—moving from project\-based engagements to high\-value retainer partnerships.
 



  





 THE ROLE: BUSINESS DEVELOPMENT EXECUTIVE
 



  





 As a Business Development Executive, you will own the full sales cycle for At Buzz—from prospect identification through deal closure and handoff to delivery teams. This is not an intern role; it is a professional, commission\-driven sales position for someone ready to own revenue impact.
 



  





 WHAT YOU'LL OWN
 



  





 1\. STRATEGIC MARKET RESEARCH \& LEAD GENERATION
 



 \- Profile and qualify high\-growth brands that match our core verticals (D2C, B2B SaaS, EdTech, FMCG, Fashion)
 



 \- Build a monthly prospect list of 50\+ targets using LinkedIn, industry databases, and proprietary research
 



 \- Prioritize warm outreach (referrals, mutual connections) and cold outreach (calling, email sequences)
 



 \- Track pipeline health in our CRM—maintaining a clean, real\-time sales funnel
 



  





 2\. SALES EXECUTION \& DEAL CLOSURE
 



 \- Execute 15–20 discovery calls/meetings per month to understand client pain points
 



 \- Develop tailored project briefs and ROI\-focused proposals aligned to each client's business objectives
 



 \- Own the negotiation process from initial scope to contract signature
 



 \- Close ₹15–30L\+ in new project/retainer value per quarter (based on experience level)
 



 \- Partner with creatives and strategists to build winning pitches
 



  





 3\. RELATIONSHIP BUILDING \& ACCOUNT STRATEGY
 



 \- Attend client meetings and site visits to build credibility and deepen relationships early
 



 \- Become a trusted strategic advisor—positioning At Buzz as a long\-term partner, not a vendor
 



 \- Identify upsell and cross\-sell opportunities within the Atraski portfolio (Studios, Events, ATT)
 



 \- Maintain post\-sale relationships to drive renewals and referrals
 



  





 4\. CROSS\-FUNCTIONAL COLLABORATION
 



 \- Conduct market and competitive intelligence to inform agency strategy
 



 \- Work closely with Operations, Delivery, and Finance to ensure smooth project handoffs
 



 \- Provide feedback from the market to guide service development and positioning
 



  





 WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR
 



  





 CORE COMPETENCIES
 



  





 Sales\-Driven Mentality: You live for closing deals. You're energized by targets, competition, and hitting/exceeding quota.
 



  





 Strategic Thinking: You don't just sell—you understand why clients buy. You ask good questions, listen actively, and position solutions around real business outcomes.
 



  





 Relationship Builder: You genuinely enjoy people. You build trust quickly, follow up consistently, and turn prospects into long\-term advocates.
 



  





 Hustle \& Ownership: You're self\-motivated, action\-oriented, and comfortable with ambiguity. You own your pipeline and your results.
 



  





 Communication Excellence: You're articulate on calls, sharp in writing, and can tailor your message to C\-suite, marketing managers, and procurement teams alike.
 



  





 Digital Fluency: You're comfortable with LinkedIn, email sequences, CRM tools, spreadsheets, and can pick up new platforms quickly.
 



  





 EXPERIENCE PROFILE
 



  





 Option A (Mid\-Level – Preferred)
 



 \- 2–4 years in agency sales, B2B SaaS, or consulting sales
 



 \- Proven track record of closing ₹10–50L\+ annual contracts
 



 \- Experience selling professional services (creative, tech, or strategy)
 



 \- Comfortable with 40\-50% cold outreach
 



  





 Option B (Entry/Accelerated)
 



 \- 0–2 years of sales experience OR recent graduate with strong entrepreneurial track record
 



 \- Exceptional communication and grit (we can teach process)
 



 \- Willingness to learn CRM, sales fundamentals, and At Buzz's service offerings from day one
 



 \- Target\-driven mindset
 



  





  





 COMPENSATION \& INCENTIVES
 



  





 Base Salary: ₹3\.5–6\.5L annually (based on experience, interview performance)
 



  





 Performance Commission: 5–8% of first 12 months' retainer value per closed deal
 



  





 Quarterly Bonus: Up to ₹50k–2L if you exceed quarterly targets by 20%\+
 



  





 Benefits: Flexible work\-from\-home policy, professional development budget
 



  





 Example: Close a ₹20L annual retainer → ₹1–1\.6L commission (year 1\). Hit 120% of quarterly target → additional ₹50–100k bonus.
 



  





  





 WORK ENVIRONMENT
 



  





 Location: Chittaranjan Park, Greater Kailash, New Delhi
 



 Schedule: Monday–Friday, 10:00 AM–6:00 PM \+ Alternate Saturdays
 



 Reporting To: CEO
 



  





  





 WHY JOIN AT BUZZ?
 



  





 High\-Growth Trajectory: Join at a pivotal moment. At Buzz is scaling from project work to retainer partnerships—your deals define our trajectory.
 



  





 Uncapped Earning Potential: Base salary \+ performance commission means high performers take home ₹15–25L\+ in year 1–2\.
 



  





 Real Ownership: You own your numbers. No politics, no closed doors—direct accountability and direct reward.
 



  





 Quality Clients \& Work: Work with founders and CMOs at top D2C and B2B brands. See your deals turned into award\-winning work.
 



  





 Career Growth: Fast\-track to Head of BD, Client Success, or Strategy roles within 18–24 months.
 



  





 Agency Ecosystem: Access to creative talent, strategy expertise, and production capabilities across Atraski's verticals for pitches and delivery.
 



  





 APPLICATION \& NEXT STEPS
 



  





 TO APPLY:
 



 Submit resume \+ a 1\-page note on why you're interested in At Buzz
 



 Include 2–3 examples of deals you've helped close (or contributed to)
 



 Email to: anish.dhar@atraski.com and hr@atraski.com
 



  





 INTERVIEW PROCESS:
 



 Initial screening call (20 min) → Sales roleplay scenario (15 min) → Manager interview (45 min) → Final round with leadership
 



  





 TIMELINE:
 



 Decisions made within 2–3 business days of final interview.
 



  





 ATRASKI INDIA \| AT BUZZ
 



 Chittaranjan Park, Greater Kailash, Delhi
 



 anish.dhar@atraski.com/hr@atraski.com

* Develop accurate sales forecasts and business plans.
* Monitor market trends, customer activity, and competitive developments.
* Utilize CRM tools and data analytics to support decision\-making and business growth strategies.


 What We're Looking For
   

  

 Education
   

  

* Bachelor's Degree in Chemical Engineering, Paint Technology, Chemistry, Business, or a related discipline.
* MBA or equivalent postgraduate qualification is desirable.


**Experience**

+ Automotive OEM
+ Commercial Vehicles
+ Automotive Refinish
+ Industrial Manufacturing
+ Agricultural Equipment
+ Construction Equipment

* Strong customer relationship management and networking abilities.
* Proven ability to influence stakeholders and drive business growth.
* Strong analytical and problem\-solving skills.
* Excellent presentation, negotiation, and communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple projects and priorities simultaneously.
* Experience working cross\-functionally in a dynamic business environment.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications and CRM platforms such as Salesforce.
* Ability to work independently while collaborating effectively with internal teams.


**Additional Requirements**
* Fluent in English; knowledge of additional regional languages is advantageous.
* Willingness to travel extensively within India.
* Strong commercial acumen, customer focus, and results orientation.


 Why Join Axalta?
   

  

* Work with a global leader in innovative coatings solutions.
* Partner with some of India's leading automotive and industrial manufacturers.
* Gain exposure to cutting\-edge technologies and strategic customer projects.
* Collaborate with talented commercial, technical, and operational teams.
* Enjoy opportunities for continuous learning, professional development, and career growth.
* Make a direct impact on customer success and business performance.


 Build Your Future With Us
   

  

 This is an evergreen opportunity designed to build our pipeline of sales talent for future Area Sales Manager positions across our Mobility, Industrial, and Refinish businesses. If you're looking to grow your career with a market leader and make a meaningful impact, we encourage you to apply.
   

  

**Our Company**
 Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever\-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.
   

  

 Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia\-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140\+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.

The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

**Research \& Market Intelligence**
* Conduct company, sector and market research across financial services
* Develop sector maps, target lists, buyer/investor universes and market intelligence
* Research company ownership, shareholders, funding history, transaction history and relevant market activity
* Track M\&A and broader financial services market developments
* Turn research and data into concise, actionable insights that can support client conversations and business development


**Thought Leadership**
* Support the development of financial services thought leadership, market reports, sector insights and points of view
* Research emerging trends and themes across financial services and translate them into meaningful client\-facing content
* Help develop compelling narratives and insights rather than simply presenting data


**Pipeline \& Stakeholder Management**
* Maintain accurate business development and opportunity pipeline information
* Prepare materials for pipeline and business development meetings
* Track actions and follow up with relevant stakeholders
* Work directly with senior stakeholders across London, Manchester and Leeds
* Manage multiple requests and deadlines while maintaining quality and attention to detail


 What we're looking for
   

  

 We are looking for someone who combines
 **strong research capability, excellent PowerPoint skills and commercial thinking** 
 .
   

  

**Essential Experience**
* Relevant experience in business development, pitch support, research, strategy, investment banking, corporate finance, transaction advisory or a similar professional services environment
* Demonstrable experience creating high\-quality client\-facing pitch decks, presentations, proposals or credentials materials
* Experience contributing to thought leadership, industry reports, market insights, white papers or similar content
* Strong experience in company, market and sector research and the ability to turn research into meaningful insights
* Strong PowerPoint and Excel skills
* Excellent written and verbal English
* Ability to work with senior stakeholders and manage multiple priorities and tight deadlines
* Willingness to work with UK\-based teams and maintain a daily overlap with UK business hours


**Desirable**
* Experience within the Financial Services sector, including banking, insurance, asset \& wealth management, fintech, payments, specialty lending or related areas
* Exposure to M\&A, Debt Advisory, transaction services or other deal\-related environments
* Experience working with international stakeholders across different locations and time zones
* Familiarity with market and financial databases such as Capital IQ, PitchBook, Bloomberg, Refinitiv, Mergermarket or similar platforms
* CFA, MBA, CA or another relevant professional qualification


 What will make you successful?
   

  

 We are particularly interested in people who can demonstrate three things:
   

  

* Pitch Decks You can take a brief from a senior stakeholder and turn it into a polished, compelling and client\-ready presentation
* Thought Leadership You can understand a market or industry theme, develop a point of view and communicate it through high\-quality written and visual content
* Research You can go beyond collecting information — you can identify what matters, interpret the findings and turn them into insights that support a commercial conversation


 You should be comfortable asking,
 **"What is the question we're really trying to answer?"** 
 and
 **"So what does this mean for the client or the business?"**
 Why join us?
   

  

 This is an opportunity to work closely with senior Financial Services professionals across the UK and gain exposure to the
 **origination side of M\&A and advisory work** 
 .
   

  

 You will have the opportunity to develop your understanding of financial services markets, contribute to high\-profile pitches and thought leadership, and play an important role in supporting the continued growth of our Financial Services practice.
   

  

**If you are someone who enjoys research, storytelling, creating impactful presentations and working closely with senior stakeholders, we'd love to hear from you.**
**Our Values:**
**Embrace different: \-** 
 From cultures to mindsets, we welcome them all. Our global presence means we're inclusive by nature and we believe that people are equal, but not the same.
   

  

**Do the right thing:** 
 \- Our comfort zone is uncomfortable; we always make the right decision not what is simply easy or popular. Always consider how to implement these decisions, people will always remember how you made them feel.
   

  

**All hands on deck:** 
 \- We stand shoulder to shoulder with colleagues and clients, be that physically or from afar. Our individual expertise may find them answers, but it is through teamwork that it is implemented.
   

  

**Passion drives success:** 
 \- The impossible is always possible, we push the boundaries of what is expected because we're never satisfied with the status quo. Our clients expect a positive result when they engage with us, and it's only by delivering this that we win.
   

  

**Benefits**
****Benefits****

* Competitive salary package, aligned with experience and market standards
* International exposure, working with multicultural teams across multiple regions

**Required Qualifications** 



* Bachelor's degree in Business, Marketing, Advertising, or a related field.

* Experience managing the complete sales cycle from lead generation to closure.

* Familiarity with CRM tools such as HubSpot, Salesforce, or Zoho CRM.

**Preferred Qualifications** 



* Experience selling digital advertising, marketing automation, CRM, customer engagement, or SaaS solutions.

* Consistently achieve monthly and quarterly sales targets.

* Maintain high client satisfaction and generate repeat business.

title: Business Development Executive
description:
**Company Description** 
 Nimitai is an AI\-powered, real\-time meeting intelligence platform that helps B2B sales teams rescue deals before they stall and close up to four times more business. The platform uses three specialized AI agents—Audit, Prep, and Live—to strengthen pitch decks, prepare targeted talking points, and provide real\-time sales coaching based on buyer signals. Nimitai delivers measurable results, including higher close rates, increased confidence during calls, and more efficient use of sales team capacity without additional hiring. Unlike traditional call recording tools, Nimitai focuses on live coaching and buyer signal detection, integrating seamlessly with major meeting platforms like Google Meet, Microsoft Teams, and Zoom. With a growing network of partners across SaaS, MedTech, and services, Nimitai offers a dynamic environment for professionals passionate about modern sales technology and AI\-driven solutions.
 



  





**Role Description** 
 The Business Development Executive is responsible for driving new revenue by identifying, qualifying, and closing opportunities with B2B clients who can benefit from Nimitai’s AI meeting intelligence platform. In this full\-time, remote role, the individual will conduct outbound prospecting, manage inbound leads, and nurture relationships through discovery calls, product demos, and follow\-up communications. Day\-to\-day tasks include understanding customer pain points, presenting tailored solutions, coordinating with internal teams to refine messaging, and maintaining an organized pipeline within the CRM. The role also involves collaborating with marketing on campaigns, gathering market feedback, and contributing to sales playbooks to improve win rates and customer experience.
 



  





**Qualifications** 



* Candidates should possess skills in New Business Development and Lead Generation to identify and pursue high\-potential prospects.
* Candidates should possess Business and Account Management skills to manage pipelines, negotiate terms, and maintain strong client relationships.
* Candidates should possess strong Communication skills to deliver clear, persuasive messaging in both written and verbal formats.
* Familiarity with B2B SaaS sales, especially in AI or sales\-tech solutions, is highly beneficial.
* Experience working in a remote, fast\-paced environment with measurable sales targets is preferred.
* Comfort using CRM tools, sales engagement platforms, and video conferencing technologies is advantageous.
* A bachelor’s degree in Business, Marketing, Communications, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience, is desirable.

title: Strategic Enterprise Account Executive - India
description:
Our mission is to automate coding. The first step in our journey is to build the best tool for professional programmers, using a combination of inventive research, design, and engineering. Our organization is very flat, and our team is small and talent dense. We particularly like people who are truth\-seeking, passionate, and creative. We enjoy spirited debate, crazy ideas, and shipping code.
   

  

****About The Role****
 As a Strategic Account Executive for India, you’ll be one of the foundational members of SpaceXAI’s enterprise sales team in the region. You’ll help large engineering organizations discover, adopt, and expand their use of Cursor, owning strategic accounts across APJ and working directly with engineering leaders, CTOs, developer platform teams, and procurement stakeholders.
   

  

 This is a rare opportunity to bring a product engineers already love into some of India's most sophisticated technology, financial services, enterprise, and digital\-native organizations and to help shape how software gets built in the AI era.
   

  

****What You’ll Do****
* Own a named book of strategic enterprise accounts across India, driving new logo acquisition and expansion revenue
* Run a disciplined, full\-cycle sales process from prospecting and discovery through evaluation, negotiation, and close
* Build and execute account strategies that connect Cursor’s capabilities to the technical and business priorities of engineering leaders, CTOs, and developer platform teams
* Create pipeline through outbound prospecting, executive mapping, inbound follow\-up, partner referrals, and your own network
* Partner closely with Sales Engineering, Product, and Customer Success to deliver high\-quality evaluations and ensure customers realize value quickly
* Navigate complex enterprise buying processes, including security reviews, legal negotiations, procurement, and multi\-stakeholder approval cycles
* Serve as the voice of India's enterprise customers internally, sharing market feedback and deal learnings with Product, Marketing, Customer Success, and GTM leadership
* Help establish SpaceXAI’s enterprise presence in India by building repeatable motions, local market insights, and early customer references
* Consistently meet and exceed quarterly and annual revenue targets


**You may be a fit if**
* You have 5\+ years of enterprise B2B sales experience, ideally selling developer tools, infrastructure, cloud, security, AI, or other technical SaaS products to engineering\-led organizations
* You have experience selling into strategic or large enterprise accounts in India
* You’re comfortable navigating complex buying committees across engineering, IT, security, legal, procurement, finance, and executive stakeholders
* You’re a true hunter: you proactively build pipeline from scratch through outbound prospecting, creative sourcing, executive engagement, and persistent follow\-up
* You have strong command of pipeline management, account planning, and forecasting across a strategic book of business

* You’re a self\-starter who thrives in an early\-stage, resource\-constrained environment and can build process, playbooks, and regional learnings as you go
* You care deeply about AI and believe transforming how software is written is one of the most important problems to work on right now

title: Restaurant POS Sales Executive
description:
**About QuickKOT** 




 QuickKOT is a cloud based POS for restaurants in India. A café starts free on Basic — kitchen tickets, GST bills, cash / card / UPI in the browser, no demo and no install. The same tickets scale to food courts and hotels that need one guest bill and many kitchens, and to chains that need distinct tills (tickets never cross cities).
 



 We are hiring a salesperson in Delhi/NCR who already knows how restaurant POS is sold — not someone who will learn hospitality from a slide deck.
 



  





**The role** 




 You own the pipeline from first conversation to a live restaurant on QuickKOT. You sell the product on the floor: café counters, mall food courts, hotel F\&B, and multi\-outlet brands in and around Delhi NCR, plus remote closes anywhere in India.
 



 You report to the founder. You work from home. When a court or hotel wants a walk\-through, you go.
 



  





**What you will do** 



* Build and run a restaurant POS pipeline: cafés, QSR, dhabas, canteens, food courts, hotel F\&B, cloud kitchens and chains.
* Qualify the floor: one kitchen vs many kitchens on one bill vs separate restaurants (that distinction matters here).
* Run demos on the live product (signup is self\-serve; you still walk the manager through KOT, GST bill, kitchen display, token pickup, and reports).
* Close Economy / Premium / Enterprise and help Basic houses start so they can grow.
* Keep a clean CRM: next step, decision\-maker, kitchens, billing model, go\-live date.
* Hand a signed house to onboarding without inventing features we do not ship.
* Feed product with what the floor actually asked for — not a feature wishlist from a competitor’s brochure.



  





**Must have** 



* Prior 2\-4 years’ experience selling restaurant POS / billing / KOT software in India (not generic SaaS, not only printers or payment terminals).
* Based in Delhi / NCR; able to work remotely and visit accounts in the region.
* Comfort talking to owners, F\&B managers, and mall / hotel operations — in Hindi and English.
* Ability to explain GST bills, kitchen tickets, and “one bill, many kitchens” without a script.
* Own laptop, reliable internet, and a phone you will actually pick up during service hours.



  





**Nice to have** 



* Book of restaurants, food courts, or hotel groups in NCR you can reopen (no poaching of confidential lists).
* Food\-court / hotel F\&B deals, not only single\-outlet cafés.
* Experience with a self\-serve or product\-led POS (they can start without you; you still close the paid floor).



  





**What this is not** 



* Not inside sales only, never leaving the desk.
* Not a partner / affiliate role.
* Not hardware sales (printers, drawers) as the main job.
* Not “sell India plus overseas.” QuickKOT plans are billed in Indian rupees.

title: Enterprise Sales Manager
description:
**About Atlys**
 Our mission is to enable every person on Earth to travel freely.
   

  

 Travel should feel exciting. Instead, too much of it is still defined by paperwork, uncertainty, and processes that were never designed for travellers.
   

  

 Atlys is changing that.
   

  

 We’re building an AI\-first platform that removes friction and uncertainty from travel. To date, we’ve processed visas for
 **1M\+ travellers across 127 countries** 
 . But we’re still early.
   

  

**The Role**
 Our partners \- card networks, banks, airlines, travel platforms, fintechs \- are mostly many times our size. The job is to get a decision\-maker to take the call, then build a construct that works commercially for both sides.
   

  

 The second part is the hard part. A visa is a low\-frequency purchase. A partnership only works if you find the moment in the partner's own customer journey where we belong, and structure the economics so they have a reason to care.
 **There's no playbook.**
**The Role**
 Most companies handle business\-travel visas badly — an office manager or travel desk stitching together agents and embassy appointments, nobody owning it until something breaks three days before a flight.
 **Atlys for Business fixes that.**
 The bar is
 **30 new accounts live every month.**
 You won't dial blind. We process visas for over a million travellers, so we already know which companies send people abroad on business. That's your list. The job is working it in the right order.
   

  

 You source, pitch, close and onboard. Ops and support take the day\-to\-day after that; you keep the commercial relationship and grow it.
   

  

**The Job**
* Convert 30 new organisations into active Atlys for Business customers every month.
* Make 50\+ calls a day, alongside email and LinkedIn outreach. The volume isn't optional.
* Run high\-volume demos and keep your calendar consistently filled.
* Adapt your pitch to every prospect \- a travel desk at a 5,000\-person manufacturer and an EA at a 200\-person startup need different conversations.
* Own onboarding through the first transaction \- signed but never booked isn't closed.
* Maintain a disciplined, transparent pipeline with clear next steps and no surprises.
* Grow commercial relationships with customers after they go live.


**The Ideal Candidate**
**You’ll Likely Thrive In This Role If You**
* Have 2–3 years of sales experience, minimum. This is a hard bar.
* Have no degree or institution filter \- what you've done matters more than where you studied.
* Have real phone stamina and are comfortable maintaining a high\-volume calling motion every day.
* Know how to prioritise a large prospect universe: which 50 of 500 companies to work first, and why.
* Have strong commercial judgement and understand what a deal is worth and what it costs to serve.
* Are highly organised and disciplined about pipeline management, follow\-ups and execution.
* Communicate exceptionally well in both verbal and written communication.
* Are comfortable adapting your pitch and approach based on the person, organisation and context.
* Take strong ownership from first outreach through closing and first transaction.


*We hire exceptional people for their craft, not travel enthusiasts. We solve hard problems that happen to touch global travel and government infrastructure.*
**What You Can Expect**
 Atlys is built by a small team with outsized ambition, high ownership, and an obsession with doing great work.
   

  

**Here’s What You Can Expect**
* Competitive compensation and equity so you participate in the value you help create.
* Comprehensive health insurance covering you and your family, plus annual preventive health check\-up on us.
* A thoughtful leave policy with paid time off and company holidays, because great work also requires real time off.
* Lunch, high tea and dinner at the office, so the basics are taken care of while we build together.
* Learning \& development credits to invest in courses, books, conferences and tools that help you get better at your craft.
* Relocation support to make moving closer to the team as seamless as possible.
* Great tools to do your best work, including high\-spec equipment and software.
* An office designed for more than just work, with pickleball, table tennis, PlayStation, an arcade game room, an F1 simulator and even a full flight simulator.


 Our values shape how we make decisions, work together and build for travelers. The bar is high, the pace is fast, and the way we work is deliberate. Read them before you apply. If this environment energizes you, you’ll probably thrive here. If it doesn’t, it’s better to know that upfront.
   

  

*Come build the intelligence layer for global travel*

* Consistently maintain healthy win rates, deal velocity and average deal sizes; keep CRM hygiene and accurate forecasting at all times.



**Solution \& Consultative Selling** 



* Translate client sustainability and compliance needs (GHG inventory, CBAM reports, BRSR/CSRD/GRI/CDP disclosures, decarbonisation roadmaps) into tailored EcoMS platform and service propositions.
* Deliver compelling product demos and executive presentations to CXOs, CSOs, CFOs, EHS and sustainability heads.

**Client Servicing \& Account Growth** 



* Act as the primary relationship owner post\-sale; ensure smooth onboarding hand\-off and high client satisfaction.
* Drive renewals, upsell and cross\-sell (additional modules, geographies, entities, advisory add\-ons) to grow net revenue retention.
* Resolve client escalations promptly in coordination with delivery, product and support teams.



**Market Intelligence \& Collaboration** 



* Track ESG regulatory developments (CBAM phases, CSRD/ESRS timelines, BRSR Core, ISSB adoption) and competitor moves; feed insights into product and pricing strategy.
* Represent EcoMS at industry forums, exhibitions and webinars to build brand visibility and generate leads.
* Work closely with marketing on campaigns, collateral and lead\-generation programs; mentor junior BD team members as the team scales.



**Candidate Profile — Must\-Have** 



* **6–10 years of B2B sales experience,** 
 with a significant majority in selling ESG/sustainability SaaS platforms, GHG accounting tools, CBAM solutions, ESG reporting software or allied sustainability services.
* **Proven hunter with a large new\-clientele track record —** 
 documented history of acquiring substantial new logo bases and building territories/verticals from scratch.
* **Big numbers, verifiable sales record —** 
 consistent achievement/overachievement of large revenue quotas; ability to demonstrate closed ARR/TCV figures, win rates and ramp performance.
* **Strong NBD and closure skills —** 
 end\-to\-end ownership from cold outreach to signed contract; skilled negotiator comfortable with enterprise procurement and legal cycles.
* **Excellent client servicing orientation —** 
 record of high renewal rates, account expansion and long\-standing client relationships.
* **Domain fluency —** 
 working knowledge of GHG Protocol (Scope 1/2/3\), CBAM mechanics, BRSR, GRI, CSRD/ESRS, CDP, TCFD/ISSB and the broader ESG compliance landscape.
* **Global market exposure —** 
 experience selling to or engaging clients in at least one international market (EU, US or Middle East) in addition to India; comfort with cross\-time\-zone engagement.
* Excellent communication, presentation and executive\-engagement skills; proficiency with CRM (Salesforce/HubSpot/Zoho) and modern sales tooling.
* Bachelor's degree required; MBA (Sales/Marketing) or sustainability\-related qualification preferred.

**Desirable** 



* Existing network of sustainability, EHS and CXO decision\-makers across manufacturing, energy, textiles, chemicals, metals, FMCG, BFSI or IT/ITES.

**Key Performance Indicators** 



* New ARR / revenue booked vs. target (quarterly and annual).

 Share your resume along with a brief note on your ESG/sustainability sales track record (targets vs. achievement, key logos won, deal sizes) at jobs@ecomsww.com with the subject line “Application – Senior Manager BD (ESG SaaS)”.

description:
**Company Description** 
 VAI Technologies is an Opthalmology\-focused AI startup building clinical decision support tools for corneal and refractive care.
 
 Our flagship product, Kera AI, uses AI\-driven corneal analysis to support keratoconus detection and refractive surgery planning \- helping surgeons to make faster, safer, and more consistent decisions across the surgical pathway. We work closely with corneal and refractive surgeons across India and are scaling adoption in leading eye hospitals and surgical chains.
 




  





**Role Description** 
 We are hiring a Senior Manager Sales Business Development role to lead field sales and clinical partnerships for our Surgery Decision Support platform for refractive surgeries.
 
 This is a high\-ownership, revenue\-facing role for someone who already speaks the language of cornea and refractive workflows, and who can walk into a hospital and have a credible, peer\-level conversation with a cataract/refractive surgeon or a hospital's clinical/procurement leadership.
 





 You will own the sales pipeline end\-to\-end \- from opening doors with ophthalmologists and hospital decision\-makers, to running clinical demonstrations, to closing and expanding accounts \- while working closely with the founding team on positioning, pricing, and go\-to\-market strategy.
 




  





**Roles and Responsibilites** 



* Build and run the national sales pipeline for Kera AI's surgery decision support offering across corneal/refractive surgery centers, multi\-specialty eye hospital chains, and individual surgeon practices.
* Lead the full sales cycle: prospecting, clinical demos, surgeon and hospital stakeholder management, commercial negotiation, and closing.
* Leverage existing relationships with ophthalmologists, refractive surgeons, and hospital administrators/ procurement heads to accelerate access and shorten sales cycles.
* Represent Visionary AI at ophthalmology conferences, CMEs, and clinical events (e.g. AIOS, state ophthalmological society meets, etc.) to build visibility and pipeline.
* Articulate Kera AI's clinical and workflow differentiation built on top of data from established devices such as Pentacam (Oculus) and other Scheimpflug/topography\-based systems, in conversations with clinically sophisticated buyers.
* Partner with the founding/clinical team to tailor positioning, pricing, and deployment models (capex, subscription, per\-scan, etc.) by account type.
* Gather structured field feedback from surgeons on clinical workflow fit, and feed it back into product and clinical evidence priorities.
* Track and report pipeline, conversion, and revenue metrics; forecast accurately for a seed\-stage, fast\-iterating environment.



  





**What We're Looking For** 



* Prior sales/BD experience selling into ophthalmology — ideally corneal, refractive, or cataract surgery\-adjacent capital equipment, diagnostics, or software.
* Direct experience selling, supporting, or working alongside Pentacam (Oculus) or a competing corneal topography / tomography system (e.g. Sirius, Galilei, Orbscan, MS\-39, Cassia) is strongly preferred.
* An existing, active network of ophthalmologists, refractive surgeons, and eye hospital decision\-makers across India.
* Comfort selling a clinical AI / software product to a technically sharp audience — able to discuss topography metrics, staging systems (e.g. Belin ABCD), and surgical decision workflows credibly.
* Track record of carrying and consistently meeting/exceeding a sales quota in a med\-tech, diagnostics, or healthcare AI environment.
* Willingness to travel extensively across India to meet surgeons and hospital leadership in person.
* Startup mindset — comfortable with ambiguity, wearing multiple hats, and building process rather than inheriting it.
* Has existing relationships within India's major eye hospital networks or refractive surgery chains.
* Bachelor's degree required; a background in life sciences, biomedical engineering, optometry, or an MBA is a plus but not mandatory.



  





**How to Apply** 




 Interested candidates can apply by sending their resume and a brief note on relevant experience to
 **hr@visaionary.ai.**

title: Business Development Consultant (Data Centres)
description:
**Key Responsibilities** 




 · Support principal\-led origination into hyperscalers, sovereign and AI\-native model operators, GCC and Global\-2000 occupiers and credible operator\-partners: build and maintain target lists, research decision\-makers, prepare briefing packs and site packages, and run disciplined follow\-up so that no thread goes cold
 



 · Prospect actively and generate first meetings through self\-directed outreach rather than waiting for inbound enquiry, and report a weekly count of new conversations opened and requirements captured
 



 · Hold and progress working\-level technical\-commercial conversations on the shell\-and\-core proposition: power availability and density, cooling readiness, fibre routes, latency to points of presence, proximity to subsea cable landings and internet exchanges, and delivery timelines
 



 · Capture each customer requirement to a standard template (day\-one MW and expansion rights, redundancy and tier expectation, connectivity and latency thresholds, state preference, lease versus purchase stance, target delivery date), observing the platform’s listen\-first rule: understand the requirement, never broadcast our plans
 



 · Translate land, power and cost evidence into customer\-ready and investor\-ready collateral with the land, power and finance teams: title and possession status, grid connectivity stage (CTU, STU and GNA application status, sanctioned versus applied\-for capacity, voltage level), indicative tariff and delivery date, presented as teasers, site one\-pagers and question responses
 



 · Own pipeline, CRM and data room hygiene: every opportunity, requirement, next action, owner and dated status kept current, with the underlying evidence file for each site version\-controlled and ready for a counterparty’s diligence team
 



 · Support the conversion of conversations into paper: prepare requirement summaries and first drafts of letters of intent, heads of terms and take\-or\-pay pre\-commitment documents for principal and counsel review, and track what each counterparty (and our lenders) must see before signing
 



 · Monitor state data centre and IT/ITeS policies, incentive frameworks, competitor activity and announced hyperscaler and operator commitments across the target states, and produce a written monthly read\-out for leadership
 



 Skills Required
 



**Experience and Qualification** 




 · 3–6 years of experience in a technical\-commercial, business development, pre\-sales, consulting or infrastructure\-advisory role, gained in at least one directly adjacent domain: data centres or colocation, power generation, transmission or grid, cloud or AI compute infrastructure, telecom and fibre networks, or industrial and logistics real estate. A bachelor’s or master’s degree in engineering or a technology discipline is required; an IIT or NIT background is welcomed
 



 · Working command of data centre fundamentals sufficient to hold an unsupervised conversation with a customer’s infrastructure team: what a MW of IT load means commercially, rack power density and the direction it is moving, air versus liquid cooling and what liquid\-cooling readiness requires of a shell, PUE, redundancy and tier expectations, floor loading and MW per acre, and why secured power rather than land is the binding constraint on delivery
 



 · Literacy in AI\-driven demand: why training and inference workloads impose different power density, cooling and latency profiles from traditional enterprise IT, how that reshapes what an occupier asks a developer for, and who buys that capacity in India across hyperscalers, sovereign and AI\-native model operators and GCC and Global\-2000 enterprises
 



 · Grid literacy: the difference between indicated, applied\-for and sanctioned capacity, what document evidences each, what a connectivity or general network access application involves and how long it runs, and why a customer’s diligence team tests sanctioned capacity and the committed drawl date rather than a developer’s stated position
 



 · Demonstrable hunting instinct and sales drive, evidenced by self\-generated outreach that converted into meetings and moved opportunities forward from a cold start, together with comfort operating around an asset still being assembled (land under acquisition, grid applications in process, tariff and delivery date indicative rather than fixed). This is not an order\-taking role and there is no completed facility or rate card to sell from
 



 · Excellent written English and rigorous document, pipeline and CRM discipline, with the reliability to own the detail behind a principal’s relationship; fluency in English and Hindi; willingness to travel across India at short notice and internationally as required

title: Business Development Executive, MSE, GTS
description:
**About this role:**
 Our Business Development teams play a critical role in expanding Gartner’s presence across the global market. Gartner Business Development Executives strategically acquire new clients by cultivating trust\-based relationships with C\-level executives to understand their mission critical priorities and uncover opportunities to deliver client\-value through the lens of the industry in which they operate. Gartner Business Developers drive the full sales cycle, from identifying prospects to closure and transition of new accounts to the account management team.
   

  

**About Gartner Midsize Enterprise (MSE):**
 MSE represents one of Gartner’s largest sales populations across the US, Europe, and Asia\-Pacific. This high\-growth sales organization acquires and supports our High Tech and End User client accounts with annual revenue targets between $10 million and $1 billion per year.
   

  

**Understanding The Work Environment \& Standards Across MSE:**
 Gartner MSE operates in a hybrid work environment. This means working virtually and in the office. We have in\-office experiences which can be as often as several times each week like 1:1’s with your manager, team meetings, and upskilling sessions. Coming together with colleagues in our Gartner office is a great way to build relationships across the business while collaborating, learning, and growing together.
   

  

 At Gartner MSE, our sales associates play a key role in partnering with C\-Level executives. We believe a professional appearance and workspace play a big part in building trust and credibility. As such, we maintain a business casual dress code.
   

  

**What you will do:**
 Business Development Executives will be given a territory of Midsize Enterprise prospects, which may be completely new prospects with no existing spend or could be clients within other Gartner areas. Other role highlights include:
   

  

* Build trust\-based value\-added relationships with C\-Level prospects to quickly uncover the mission critical priorities and determine how Gartner can support success.
* Drive high\-quality activity to build pipeline with multi\-touch prospecting outreach and campaigns.
* Convert viable prospects into active Gartner clients, owning the full sales conversation and negotiation, through to the transition of new clients to the account management team.
* Conduct calls with C\-Level prospects to qualify, showcase capabilities and close the business.
* Partner with internal partners across the business to bring Gartner to life through portal walkthroughs and proof of concepts.
* Transition new accounts to account management to ensure a fast start to new client value.
* Deliver against assigned annual quota for your territory.


**What you will need:**
* 4\+ years’ B2B sales experience, preferably within complex, intangible sales environments.
* Experience selling to and/or influencing C\-Level Executives.
* Proven track record meeting and exceeding sales targets.
* Proven ability to precisely manage and forecast a complex sale process.
* Willingness to live within a commutable distance to the location required for this role.
* Relocation assistance is available for qualifying candidates.
* Bachelor's degree desired


**What you will get:**
* We'll invest in you. At Gartner, you'll get more than just a job. You'll get everything you need to build an exciting, rewarding career.
* Career growth starts here. Take your growth into your own hands by tapping into individual development plans, mentorships, and career progression opportunities.
* Uncapped earnings potential. Our sellers' success is recognized and rewarded accordingly.
* Comprehensive onboarding. All new hires begin their time at Gartner by going through Expedition, a robust training program to help them succeed.
* Rewards and recognition. Annual "Winners Circle" event, an all\-expense paid trip for our top performers each year.
* Consistent quarter over quarter growth. Gartner is purposefully built to adjust, adapt and pivot our strategy when macro\-environmental shifts occur.


**Who are we?**
 At Gartner, Inc. (NYSE:IT), we guide the leaders who shape the world.
   

  

 Our mission relies on expert analysis and bold ideas to deliver actionable, objective business and technology insights, helping enterprise leaders and their teams succeed with their mission\-critical priorities.
   

  

 Since our founding in 1979, we’ve grown to 20,000 associates globally who support over 13,000 client enterprises in \~90 countries and territories. We do important, interesting and substantive work that matters. That’s why we hire associates with the intellectual curiosity, energy and drive to want to make a difference. The bar is unapologetically high. So is the impact you can have here.
   

  

**What makes Gartner a great place to work?**
 Our vast, virtually untapped market potential offers limitless opportunities – opportunities that may not even exist right now – for you to grow professionally and flourish personally. How far you go is driven by your passion and performance.
   

  

 We hire remarkable people who collaborate and win as a team. Together, our singular, unifying goal is to deliver results for our clients.
   

  

 Our teams are inclusive and composed of individuals from different geographies, cultures, religions, ethnicities, races, genders, sexual orientations, abilities and generations.
   

  

 We invest in great leaders who bring out the best in you and the company, enabling us to multiply our impact and results. This is why, year after year, we are recognized worldwide as a great place to work.
   

  

**Gartner is the world authority on AI**
 At Gartner, you’ll join a company at the very center of the AI revolution. Gartner has proactive, objective guidance throughout clients’ AI journeys. We set the standard for how organizations leverage artificial intelligence to drive meaningful impact. You’ll have access to unmatched resources, expertise, and technology, and play a key role in helping Gartner and our clients innovate and grow as we leverage AI to transform business and technology landscapes.
   

  

 It’s an exciting time to be at Gartner, with limitless opportunities to make a real impact, grow your skills, and build a lasting, meaningful career in a field that’s reshaping the way we operate. If you’re passionate about AI and want to be part of a team that’s guiding the leaders who shape the world, Gartner is the place for you.
   

  

**What do we offer?**
 Gartner offers world\-class benefits, highly competitive compensation and disproportionate rewards for top performers.
   

  

 In our hybrid work environment, we provide the flexibility and support for you to thrive — working virtually when it's productive to do so and getting together with colleagues in a vibrant community that is purposeful, engaging and inspiring.
   

  

 Ready to grow your career with Gartner? Join us.

title: Sales & Business Development Intern
description:
Modelens is looking for a proactive, driven and entrepreneurial person to join our sales team and help bring new business to the company.
   

  

 This is a pure sales and business development role where your primary responsibility will be to identify potential clients, reach out to them, pitch Modelens, build relationships and convert opportunities into paying business.
   

  

 You’ll work across online and offline sales, with clear targets and performance\-linked profit sharing.
   

  

**ROLE DETAILS**
 Role: Sales \& Business Development Intern
   

 Duration: 3 months
   

 Work Mode: Remote / Hybrid
   

 Eligibility: Current college students \& freshers
   

  

**ABOUT MODELENS**
 Modelens is a creative production platform that connects brands with models, creators, photographers and other creative professionals through curated talent and end\-to\-end production.
   

  

 We help brands discover the right talent and get their creative work executed end\-to\-end as per their requirements, budget and timelines.
   

  

 As an early\-stage, founder\-led business, every new client directly contributes to our growth. Our sales team plays a key role in making that happen.
   

  

**WHAT YOU’LL OWN**
* Identify potential B2B clients, brands, agencies and businesses for Modelens.
* Reach out to prospects through LinkedIn, WhatsApp, email, calls, networking and offline meetings.
* Initiate conversations and understand potential clients' requirements.
* Pitch Modelens and communicate our services and value proposition effectively.
* Schedule and participate in client meetings and sales conversations.
* Follow up consistently with prospects and move opportunities towards closure.
* Convert leads into paying Modelens clients.
* Build and maintain strong client relationships to generate repeat business and referrals.
* Maintain a structured sales pipeline from lead → conversation → meeting → proposal → negotiation → closure.
* Research new industries, businesses and potential customer segments.
* Work towards defined weekly and monthly sales targets.
* Track outreach, meetings, leads, conversions and revenue generated.
* Experiment with different approaches to improve lead generation and conversion.
* Work directly with the Founder on high\-value prospects and sales opportunities.


**TARGETS \& PERFORMANCE**
 This is a target\-driven role. You will work towards measurable goals around:
   

* Prospects reached
* Conversations initiated
* Meetings booked
* Qualified leads generated
* Clients acquired
* Revenue generated


 Performance will be evaluated based on actual business outcomes and conversions, not simply the number of messages or calls made.
   

  

**WHO WE’RE LOOKING FOR**
* Currently pursuing college or a recent graduate.
* Genuinely interested in sales, business development, startups and entrepreneurship.
* Comfortable with cold outreach, calls, networking, pitching and rejection.
* Confident communicating with business owners, founders and decision\-makers.
* Proactive and willing to take initiative without waiting for instructions.
* Target\-oriented and motivated by results.
* Persistent with follow\-ups and comfortable chasing opportunities.
* Strong communication, interpersonal and negotiation skills.
* Curious, resourceful and quick to learn.
* Able to work independently in an early\-stage startup environment.
* More focused on generating business than simply completing tasks.


**PERKS \& OPPORTUNITIES**
* Direct access and mentorship from the Founder.
* Hands\-on experience in B2B sales and client acquisition.
* Exposure to the creative production and startup ecosystem.
* Ownership of the complete sales cycle.
* Performance\-linked profit sharing on successful business generated.
* Internship certificate.
* Performance recognition / recommendation for strong performers.
* Modelens goodies and other team perks.
* Opportunity to continue with Modelens based on performance and business requirements.


**THIS ROLE IS FOR YOU IF…**
 You see a brand and immediately think, “How can we get them as a Modelens client?”
   

  

 You enjoy talking to people, finding opportunities, pitching ideas, following up and closing deals and generating revenue. You’re comfortable hearing “no,” learning from it and trying again.
   

  

 If you want a conventional internship where you’re simply assigned tasks, this may not be the role for you.
   

  

 If you want to actually learn sales by selling, work directly with a Founder and see your efforts translate into clients and revenue, you’ll fit right in.

As the pharmaceutical industry evolves and undergoes disruption, we see an opportunity – to strengthen our core further (the next steps) and to build the future (the new bets).
   

  





 ‘The Next and the New’ is how we aim to continue to be the partner of choice – purpose\-driven, future\-ready and sustainable. Our aim is to reach over 1\.5 Bn\+ patients across the world by 2030 by growing our core businesses and building for the future with sustainability at the core of our purpose and strategy. Sustainability for us means operating in a manner that respects people, planet and purpose – helping us conserve precious resources, serve our patients, create value for stakeholders, give back to society, fulfil our potential and maintain our integrity and transparency
   

  





 Dr Reddy’s maintains a work environment, free from discrimination and is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to employ \& nurture all qualified diverse workforce without regard to race, colour religion, nationality, sex, age, disability status, genetics, sexual orientation, gender expression, citizenship or any other characteristic or classification protected by applicable law(s) of the country we operate in. We treasure every talent, and recognize merit and diversity in our organization.
   

  

  

  




**Job Description**

**Job Summary**
  

 We are seeking an experienced and dynamic individual for the position of “Territory Manger” for driving the sales strategy and achieving business goals within your designated region, for executing the product management team's strategies, gathering customer feedback, and providing crucial insights for the development of new products. Your key focus will be on establishing and nurturing relationships with key opinion leaders, monitoring competitor information, and understanding prescription trends within the pharmaceutical industry. Additionally, you will be responsible for organizing and managing Continuing Medical Education (CME) events and other initiatives to bolster the company's brand image.
   

  

  

  

**Roles \& Responsibilities**
  

 • You will be responsible for the promotion of the new product. You will be executing the Product Management Team’s marketing strategy, analysing market trends, consulting with doctors on new product potential, and relaying feedback to the Product Management Team. Additionally, responsibilities include identifying key opinion leaders, monitoring product availability, and implementing brand strategies to facilitate a successful product launch.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for monitoring primary and secondary sales through regular visits to stockists and pharmacies, ensuring the accomplishment of doctor and product\-specific sales objectives. Active participation in monthly review meetings to assess coverage, adherence to SOPs, and expense management, all aimed at achieving area\-level, product\-level, and overall sales targets.
   

  

 • You will be responsible for focusing on customer relationship management, the role entails establishing strong connections and addressing queries promptly using Infoginip. It also involves customer classification based on potential, determining meeting frequency accordingly, and tracking return on investment per customer to foster a loyal customer base for the company.
   

  

 • You will responsible to meet Key Opinion Leader (KOL) and Key business leader (KEL) frequently and pursue them to conduct CME with the company; Collect interest areas of key customers and hospitals and conduct CMEs on those topics.
   

  

 • You will responsible to prepare product matrix depending upon doctor's potential \& preference and decide which product will fit doctor's need. Update data on chemist, doctors and Retail Chemist Prescription Audit (RCPA) through palm top to Unnati portal in order to ensure all stakeholders' access to latest information.
   

  

  

  




**Qualifications**

**Educational qualification\-** 
 Graduate with science background.
   

  

  

  

**Minimum work experience\-** 
 6 months of experience in pharmaceutical sales.
   

  

  

  

**Skills \& attributes
   

  

 Technical Skills**
  

 • Basic understanding of pharmaceutical products and marketing
   

  

 • Experience in implementing and analysing sales and marketing strategies.
   

  

 • Basic knowledge of Computers.
   

  

  

  

**Behavioural Skills**
  

 • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills.
   

  

 • Good at building and leveraging relationship.
   

  

 • Strong analytical and problem\-solving abilities.
   

  

 • Strong Decision making skills.
   

  

  

  




**Additional Information**

**About the Department
   

  

 Global Generics India**
  

 Global Generics India business journey began in 1986\. In the last three decades, we have grown as a trusted name in the healthcare industry and rank as one of the top 10 Pharma Companies in the Indian Pharma Market (IPM) as per IQVIA MAT (November 2022\). Our commitment to Lead Ahead has helped us move ranks from 16th position to 10th position (IPM) in the last four years. We are a fast\-growing organisation with double\-digit growth and significant market share in domestic markets. Currently, we rank among the top 5 in oncology, anti\-allergy and gastrointestinal diseases and the top 10 in a few other therapy areas. Our focus is on leveraging our digital capabilities, collaborations, innovations and inorganic opportunities to become the top 5 companies in the Indian Pharma Market.
   

  

  

  

**Benefits Offered**
  

 At Dr. Reddy’s we actively help to catalyse your career growth and professional development through personalised learning programs.
   

  

 The benefits you will enjoy at Dr. Reddy’s are on par with the best industry standards. They include, among other things and other essential equipment, joining \& relocation support, family support (Maternity \& Paternity benefits), learning and development opportunities, medical coverage for yourself and your family, life coverage for yourself.
   

  

  

  

**Our Work Culture**
  

 Ask any employee at Dr. Reddy’s why they come to work every day and they’ll say, because Good Health Can’t Wait. This is our credo as well as the guiding principle behind all our actions. We see healthcare solutions not only as scientific formulations, but as a means to help patients lead healthier lives, and we’re always attuned to the new and the next to empower people to stay fit. And to do this, we foster a culture of empathy and dynamism. People are at the core of our journey over the last few decades. They have been supported by an enabling environment that buoys individual ability while fostering teamwork and shared success. We believe that when people with diverse skills are bound together by a common purpose and value system, they can make magic.
   

  

 For more details, please visit our career website at

 ‎

* Managing of territory through sales activities and developing delightful customers essential.

* Team Player.
